title: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description:
Headquarters:  United States
      URL:   https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ 
 

 Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer 
  Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial  
 Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. 
  This is not a conventional graphic-design role.  We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. 
 You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. 
 The work 
 You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. 
 Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. 
 
 Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. 
 Decide what each batch should test and why. 
 Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. 
 Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. 
 Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. 
 Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. 
 Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. 
 Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. 
 Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. 
 Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. 
 Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. 
 
 What you must be good at 
 
 Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy 
 Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation 
 Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit 
 Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page 
 Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production 
 Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation 
 Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools 
 Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish 
 Fast, organised batch production 
 Reading creative performance and choosing the next test

title: QA Engineer
description:
Who We Are

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced and proactive QA Engineer to own product quality across our AI robotics platform. In this role, you will be responsible for conceptualizing and driving the overall testing strategy, building quality into every stage of our development lifecycle, and ensuring our robotic systems meet the highest standards before reaching customers. You will work across hardware and software boundaries, collaborating closely with engineering, product, and support teams in a fast-paced startup environment.

Your Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Quality Gates

  • Conceptualize, develop, and manage the overall testing strategy and quality gates for the product.

  • Define and enforce release criteria, ensuring that only thoroughly validated builds reach production.

  • Establish and maintain quality metrics and dashboards to provide visibility into product health.

QA Ownership

  • Own QA processes across both hardware and software, ensuring quality is built into the development lifecycle from the start.

  • Design and implement test plans, test cases, and test automation for new features and existing functionality.

description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. You will work with the Audiobooks Analytics Lead to help shape our global audiobooks strategy and improve the experience for listeners, creators, publishers, and authors.

In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to evaluate some of the most important opportunities facing our audiobooks business. Your work will span content and catalog strategy, discovery and recommendations, subscriber growth, and new product and commercial initiatives. You will turn complex questions into clear recommendations and help senior leaders make confident decisions.

You will collaborate with a distributed team of analysts, data scientists, business leaders, product managers, editorial partners, and engineers. At Spotify, you will have access to rich datasets and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will help shape how the world listens to and discovers audiobooks.


What You'll Do
  • Develop data-driven strategies for audiobook catalog, content discovery, listener engagement, and subscriber growth.
  • Evaluate new product, content, licensing, and commercial opportunities through forecasting, scenario modeling, and impact measurement.
  • Partner with Editorial, Personalization, Product, Finance, and Business teams to improve title selection, recommendation quality, and the listener experience.
  • Design and analyze experiments, including A/B tests and quasi-experiments, to measure the impact of product and go-to-market initiatives.

title: S&O Manager - Rider Fraud

About the role

This role will lead our approach to understanding and reducing courier/rider fraud and abuse across Wolt and Deliveroo. Combining data-led investigation with strong operational judgement, you will identify emerging risk patterns, understand the features of our operating models that may contribute to those risks, and assess their potential impact.

A key part of the role is turning insight into action. You will translate analysis into clear, proportionate policies and operational responses that protect platform integrity and customer outcomes, while remaining practical to implement and appropriate for the markets in which we operate. You will work closely with Legal, Public Policy, Product, Data Science and Operations to navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations and ensure our approach is effective, fair and robust.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead a programme of work to identify, assess and prioritise courier/rider fraud and abuse risks across Wolt and Deliveroo.

  • Translate identified risks into proportionate policy, process and operational responses, balancing risk reduction with customer outcomes, courier/rider experience and business practicality.

  • Lead the implementation, monitoring and ongoing refinement of fraud and abuse policies, with clear measures of effectiveness and residual risk.

  • Ensure policy approaches are developed with appropriate consideration of legal, regulatory, compliance and reputational implications.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build a deep understanding of our courier/rider operating models, incentive structures and end-to-end journeys

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. This is a role for someone who'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month planning the perfect system - someone who gets a genuine kick out of making the unglamorous stuff disappear. You’ll bring expertise, energy, and commercial thinking to help us elevate our People processes.

Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions. title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in United Arab Emirates.   This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.  You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.  The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.  You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.  The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.  You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.  This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.  Accountabilities    Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.  Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.  Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.  Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.  Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.  Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.  Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.  Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.  Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.  Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.     Requirements     Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.  Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.  Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.  Practical experience with test automation

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to identify potential issues early, improve testing processes, and ensure high-quality product delivery. Participate in product requirement and interaction reviews, providing quality and user-experience feedback from a testing perspective.  Continuously optimize testing processes, methodologies, and tools to  improve testing efficiency and overall engineering productivity . Requirements    Bachelor's degree or above in  Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field .   1+ year of experience in B2B Web application testing , with hands-on project experience.  Solid understanding of  black-box testing methodologies  and the ability to independently design effective test cases based on requirements and user scenarios.  Familiar with mind-mapping or test design tools and capable of producing clear and structured test documentation and reports.  Hands-on experience with common testing tools, such as  test management, API testing, and automation testing tools .  Basic knowledge of  MySQL, Redis , or other commonly used databases, with the ability to perform basic queries and data validation.  Basic scripting/programming skills in  Python  or other programming languages, with the ability to write simple scripts for testing or efficiency improvement.  Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills, with the ability to proactively drive issues toward resolution.  Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. title: Business Solution Manager
description: BUSINESS SOLUTION MANAGER    Strategisk kundeansvar · SaaS · Forretningsudvikling · Aalborg - Onsite position       Er du stærk på kunder, forretning og relationer – og klar til at tage næste skridt fra klassisk SaaS-salg til strategisk forretningsudvikling?      Hos Homerunner søger vi en Business Solution Manager, der får en central rolle i udviklingen af vores største kunder.  Du skal kunne se længere end den eksisterende kundeaftale. Du skal forstå kundens forretning, være nysgerrig på deres udfordringer og kunne omsætte behov og muligheder til konkrete løsninger, der skaber værdi, både for kunden og for Homerunner.     Du får ansvar, indflydelse og mulighed for at være med helt tæt på, når løsninger bliver udviklet, forretning bliver skabt og kunder vokser.      DIN ROLLE   Du bliver strategisk sparringspartner for en række af Homerunners største kunder og får ansvar for både relationen, udviklingen og den kommercielle vækst.     Din hverdag vil blandt andet bestå af:   udvikle og vækste eksisterende strategiske kunder  opbygge stærke relationer til beslutningstagere på flere niveauer  identificere nye forretningsmuligheder hos eksisterende kunder  forstå kundens forretning og udfordre dem på deres behov og muligheder  drive dialogen fra den første idé til en konkret løsning og kommerciel aftale  være med til at bygge løsningen op, når Homerunner vinder nye kunder  deltage i pris- og kontraktforhandlinger  arbejde tæt sammen med Homerunners specialister om at skabe den rigtige løsning  bruge data, AI og teknologi aktivt til at skabe bedre løsninger og større kundeværdi.      Du bliver med andre ord den, der binder kunde, forretning, teknologi og Homerunners specialister sammen.      DU KOMMER FRA SAAS – OG VIL MERE   Vi forestiller os, at du allerede har bevist dig i en SaaS-virksomhed, hvor du har arbejdet med større kunder, komplekse løsninger og kommerciel udvikling.      Måske kommer du fra en rolle som Account Manager, Key Account Manager, Strategic Account Manager, Customer Success Manager, Customer Success Lead, Channel Manager, Partner Manager, Business Development Manager eller Solution Sales eller en tilsvarende rolle i en SaaS-virksomhed, hvor du har bevist, at du kan udvikle kunder, skabe stærke relationer og omsætte forretningsbehov til kommercielle løsninger.        Det afgørende er ikke din titel.     Det afgørende er, at du har lyst til at tage det næste skridt ind i en moderne tænkende dynamisk virksomhed.      Du er ikke tilfreds med blot at forvalte en kundeportefølje. Du vil forstå forretningen bag kunden, være tættere på beslutningstagerne og få større indflydelse på, hvordan løsningerne bliver skabt.     Du arbejder grundigt og metodisk, er selvledende og har et naturligt drive. Du er god til mennesker, men samtidig skarp på forretning.  Og så er du nysgerrig på AI.     Ikke fordi AI er et buzzword, men fordi du kan se potentialet i at bruge ny teknologi til at arbejde smartere, skabe bedre løsninger og give kundern

description: Company Description  Kreality specializes in helping established B2B service businesses recover opportunities hidden in their existing lead databases. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

description: Appierについて   Appier（エイピア）は、AIネイティブのAgentic AI as a Service（AaaS）企業です。  2012年に「AIの民主化」をビジョンに設立され、「Turn AI into ROI（AIをROIに変える）」をミッションとして掲げています。現在はアジア太平洋地域、ヨーロッパ、アメリカを含む17拠点を展開し、東京証券取引所（証券コード：4180）に上場しています。  Appierは、AI Agentを活用し、企業のマーケティングDX・データ活用・顧客体験（CX）の変革を支援する次世代AIプラットフォームを提供しています。   提供ソリューション    Appier AI Marketing Agent Platform   Appierは、AI Agentを中心としたオールインワンのマーケティングプラットフォームを提供しています。  企業が保有する顧客データをAIが理解・分析し、マーケティング施策の企画から実行、最適化までをAI Agentが支援します。  データ基盤、予測AI、マーケティングオートメーション、マルチチャネルコミュニケーション、生成AIによるクリエイティブ制作までを一つのプラットフォームで提供し、お客様のマーケティングROI最大化を実現します。   AIQUA（アイコア）   AI Agentを活用し、Web・アプリ・メール・LINE・Push通知など複数チャネルにおいて、一人ひとりに最適化された顧客体験を自動で実現するマーケティングオートメーションプラットフォームです。   BotBonnie（ボットボニー）   LINEをはじめとするSNSやWebチャットを活用し、AI Agentによる顧客コミュニケーションを実現するマルチチャネルマーケティングソリューションです。   AIRIS（アイリス）   AI Agentの意思決定を支えるPredictive Customer Data Platform（CDP）です。  顧客データを統合するだけでなく、AIによる予測分析を通じて顧客の将来行動やニーズを予測し、最適なマーケティング施策や顧客体験の実現を支援します。   AdCreative.ai（アドクリエイティブ・エーアイ）   生成AIを活用し、高品質な広告クリエイティブを自動生成・最適化するAIクリエイティブプラットフォームです。   ポジション概要   Customer Success Managerとして、AIQUA・BotBonnie・AIRIS・AdCreative.aiを導入いただいた日本国内の企業を担当し、お客様がプラットフォームから最大の成果を引き出せるよう、導入から定着、そして事業成果の創出までを伴走していただきます。  本ポジションは、問い合わせに対応するサポート業務ではありません。  お客様のマーケティング課題とKPIを深く理解した上で、AI Agentを活用した施策を「一緒に設計し、実行し、数字で振り返る」——お客様のマーケティングチームの一員として動く、実行力を伴うパートナーです。  担当アカウントの継続率とアカウント成長に責任を持ち、日々の施策運用からお客様とのQBR（四半期レビュー）までを一貫して担っていただきます。  また、プロダクト・エンジニアリングチームは台北を中心としたグローバル体制です。日本のお客様の声を製品開発に届け、機能改善の優先度を動かしていくことも、CSMの重要な役割です。   主な業務内容     担当アカウントのオンボーディングをリードし、初期の成果創出（Time to Value の最短化）を実現する  お客様のマーケティング課題・KPIを理解し、AIQUA・BotBonnie・AIRIS・AdCreative.aiを活用した施策を設計・実行・改善する  セグメント設計、シナリオ構築、配信設定、効果検証まで、プラットフォーム上で手を動かしながらお客様と伴走する  利用状況・成果データをモニタリングし、活用が進んでいない領域を能動的に特定して改善提案を行う  経営層・マーケティング部門・IT部門など多様なステークホルダーと信頼関係を構築し、QBRを主導する  担当アカウントの契約継続に責任を持ち、アップセル・クロスセルの機会を創出してアカウントを成長させる  タグ・SDK実装やデータ連携に関する技術的な論点を切り分け、お客様の技術担当者や社内テックチームと連携して解決に導く  お客様からのフィードバックを構造化してプロダクトチームへ連携し、製品ロードマップへの反映を推進する  Sales、Pre-Sales、Marketing、Productチームと連携し、お客様への価値提供を最大化する  成功事例やナレッジをプレイブックとして形式知化し、チーム全体の提供品質を引き上げる     応募条件    必須 title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

  • Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

  • Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

  • Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

  • Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

title: Operations Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Steuerberatung ist ein operatives Geschäft. Jede Buchung, jede Lohnabrechnung, jeder Abschluss folgt einem Ablauf – und die meisten dieser Abläufe wurden nie systematisch hinterfragt. Sie funktionieren, weil erfahrene Menschen ihre Workarounds kennen, nicht weil sie durchdacht sind. Genau das ist der Hebel, der in dieser Branche noch niemandem gehört.

Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und entwickelt sie weiter, statt sie einzuschmelzen. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Das funktioniert nur, wenn darunter etwas steht, das trägt: Prozesse, die an jedem Standort gleich laufen, Technologie, die im Alltag tatsächlich genutzt wird, und eine Integration, die bei der fünften Übernahme schneller geht als bei der ersten. Diese Schicht baust du. Sie existiert heute nicht.

Du bringst Erfahrung aus dem Aufbau operativer Systeme mit – aus einem B2B-Scaleup, einem Company Builder, einer Beratung mit eigener Umsetzungsverantwortung oder aus deiner eigenen Gründung. Du wechselst, weil dein Mandat kleiner geworden ist als deine Verarbeitungskraft: zu viel Abstimmung, zu wenig Hebel, zu viele Konzepte, die andere umsetzen. Bei Vogel findest du das Gegenteil von beidem – Strukturen, die tragen, mit etablierten Mandanten und einer starken Wachstumsbasis, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Du verantwortest Operations bei Vogel in ganzer Breite: die Automatisierung der Abläufe im Kerngeschäft, die internen Werkzeuge und die Datenarchitektur, die IT- und Identitäts-Infrastruktur samt Endgeräten und Sicherheit, die technische Integration jeder übernommenen Einheit und die Abläufe rund um Eintritt, Vertrag, Systeme und Austritt unserer eigenen Leute. Du baust das Team, das diese Themen trägt, und verteilst die Schwerpunkte dari

title: Wirtschaftsprüfer / Accounting Lead Buy & Build (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Wer Beratungsunternehmen zukauft, kauft sich Konsolidierungskreise ein – und in den meisten mittelständischen Strukturen ist das Rechnungswesen dafür nie gebaut worden, sondern über Jahre gewachsen.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland – mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen organisch und durch Zukäufe und bauen daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den deutschen Mittelstand. Jeder Zukauf bringt eine neue Gesellschaft, eine Eröffnungsbilanz, eine Kaufpreisallokation und einen erweiterten Konsolidierungskreis mit. Damit das trägt, braucht es jemanden, bei dem niemand mehr nachrechnet, ob der Konzernabschluss steht.

Du bist bestellter Wirtschaftsprüfer oder stehst unmittelbar vor dem Examen, mit vier oder mehr Jahren Audit bei einer der großen oder der nächstgrößeren Prüfungsgesellschaften und echter Konzernabschluss-Tiefe. Du wechselst, weil die nächste Stufe in der Prüfungshierarchie mehr Review und weniger eigene Arbeit bedeutet – und weil du die Zahlen lieber verantwortest, als sie zu testieren. Bei Vogel findest du Strukturen, die tragen, und gleichzeitig ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht.

Du verantwortest das Rechnungswesen von Vogel – Konsolidierung und Konzernabschluss, das laufende Rechnungswesen über alle Gesellschaften, dessen Automatisierung und das externe Reporting an Banken und Stakeholder. Du berichtest direkt an Joachim und Moritz Vogel; am Standort München entsteht die Finance-Funktion gerade erst, und du bist ihr fachlicher Anker. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn – oder, wenn du das willst, in den Aufbau eines eigenen Teams.

title: Intern (m/f/d) Vision Software Development
description:
About the role

The Industrial Application team of Agile Robots is looking for a motivated Intern (m/f/d) Vision Software Development to support the development, testing, and commissioning of industrial vision systems for robotic and AGV applications. In this full-time internship, you will work hands-on across the entire lifecycle of our vision solutions — from software development and camera calibration at our Munich headquarters to on-site commissioning at customer production sites.


Your Responsibilities

  • Vision Software Development: Develop, test, and maintain software components for industrial 2D/3D vision systems, including API-based secondary development on top of vision vendor SDKs.
  • Camera Setup & Calibration: Configure and calibrate 2D area-scan/line-scan cameras and 3D sensors for robotic and AGV applications, performing nine-point, checkerboard, and 3D hand-eye calibrations.
  • Algorithm Debugging: Support the debugging and tuning of core vision algorithms, from QR-code and natural-contour (V-SLAM) AGV navigation to deep-learning-based detection models.
  • Testing & Automation: Write Python scripts for automated testing and data-log analysis, and validate vision system performance in the lab and in production-like environments.
  • System Integration: Configure and troubleshoot data exchange between vision industrial PCs (IPCs) and PLCs, supporting communication via TCP/IP sockets

title: Team Lead Partner Success (m/w/d) 100%
description: Jobbeschreibung  Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an.   Wir bei bexio leben die Philosophie, dass erstklassige, effiziente und smarte Softwarelösungen für jedes KMU zugänglich und erschwinglich sein müssen. Mit dieser Mission sind wir heute die führende Anbieterin für webbasierte Business-Software in der Schweiz.   Unser Expansionskurs geht steil nach oben: Über 100'000 zufriedene Kunden, mehr als 7'000 Treuhand-Partner und ein starkes Team von über 150 motivierten Mitarbeitenden sprechen für sich. Um diese Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir tatkräftige Unterstützung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel!  Stellenanforderungen Was du bei uns bewegst    Du leitest ein Team aus Partner Success Managern und sorgst dafür, dass sich jeder – egal auf welchem Erfahrungslevel – gezielt weiterentwickelt. Als Sparringspartner im Tagesgeschäft hilfst du deinem Team, die eigenen KPIs und Ziele zu erreichen.   Dein Team organisiert Schulungen, beantwortet Anfragen und entwickelt Wachstumsstrategien für Partner. Du musst das nicht alles selbst machen, aber du verstehst die Herausforderungen dahinter und optimierst Prozesse wie das Onboarding, damit sie für dein Team und die Partner reibungslos laufen.   Deine klare Mission ist das Enablement, nicht der klassische Verkauf. Du entwickelst neue Strategien und Massnahmen, um die Partnerbindung und das Produkt-Know-how unserer Partner nachhaltig zu maximieren.   Du analysierst fortlaufend die Partner-Performance, wertest Reports aus und leitest daraus strategische Handlungsempfehlungen für die Geschäftsleitung ab.   Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend eng mit Vertrieb, Marketing und Produktmanagement zusammen und bringst dich bei komplexen Anliegen von grossen Partnern aktiv als Lösungsfinder ein.    Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle    Du hast bereits Teams geleitet und bringst das Gespür mit, Menschen zu motivieren und zu einem starken Team zu formen.   Du weisst aus eigener Erfahrung, wie Partner Success funktioniert und kennst die Bandbreite der Aufgaben – von alltäglichen Anfragen bis hin zur strategischen Account-Planung.   Du siehst dich selbst als Beziehungsmanager und Enabler. Anstatt Produkte mit Druck in den Markt zu pushen, sorgst du dafür, dass Kunden unsere Lösungen richtig nutzen und den Mehrwert erkennen.   Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung oder im Enablement mit, idealerweise direkt aus dem SaaS-Umfeld oder mit Berührungspunkten zur Treuhand-Branche.   Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich, da das für unseren Alltag absolut unverzichtbar ist.    Darauf kannst du dich freuen    Hybrid-Modell und Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen.   5 Wochen Ferien plus Option auf unbezahlten Urlaub.   Yoga, Bootcamps, Massagen und legendäre Grill-Sessions.   16 Wochen Mutterschafts- und 3 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub.   bex

title: Customer Service Manager

title: Tiiminvetäjä (myymälä)
description: Tiiminvetäjä (myymälä), 37,5h      Etsimme tiiminvetäjää Konalan myymäläämme, Helsinkiin. Sykkiikö sydämesi ensiluokkaiselle asiakaskokemukselle? Oletko se innostava persoona, jonka energia tarttuu koko tiimiin? Johdat porukkaasi valmentavalla otteella ja nautit myymälän vauhdikkaasta arjesta, jossa autamme asiakkaitamme tekemään kestäviä ja parempia valintoja. Nyt sinulla on ainutlaatuinen tilaisuus hypätä mukaan rohkeaan ja omaperäiseen työyhteisöön, jossa asioita uskalletaan tehdä vähän eri tavalla. Jos tämä skene puhuttelee sinua ja uskot sopivasi kunnianhimoiseen mutta rentoon tiimiimme, jatkathan lukemista.      Keitä me olemme?   Varuste.net on suomalainen ulkoilu-, retkeily- ja vapaa-ajan varusteiden myyntiin erikoistunut yritys, joka työllistää jo noin 170 työntekijää. Pyöritämme kivijalkamyymälän lisäksi kansainvälistä verkkokauppaa. Tehtävänämme on auttaa ja innostaa ihmisiä tekemään parempia valintoja eikä niiden valintojen tarvitse jäädä varustetasolle. Näytämme omalla esimerkillämme, että metsäpolku voittaa aina sohvannurkan. Me uskomme, että kun ihminen uskaltaa tehdä parempia valintoja, hän saa elämästään enemmän irti. Kaikki toimintomme on keskitetty Helsingin Konalaan, missä myymälämme, varastomme ja toimistomme sijaitsevat kaikki saman katon alla. Me tähtäämme korkealle, joten tarvitsemme tiimiimme myös vahvaa osaamista, korvaamattoman hyvää asennetta ja rutkasti hulvatonta huumorintajua.      Tarjoamme:    Työn, jossa pääset hyödyntämään esihenkilötaitojasi, innostamaan tiimiä ja kehittämään henkilöstöä.  Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi sekä olla mukana kehittämässä Varuste.netin johtamista ja toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.  Tiivistä yhteistyötä muiden esihenkilöiden ja päällikköiden kanssa.  Monipuolisen, rohkean ja rennon työyhteisön. Varuste.netillä saat takuulla nauraa työpäivien aikana ja pääset osaksi rentoa yrityskulttuuria.  Kannattavasti kasvava ja nopeasti kehittyvä yritys tarjoaa paljon mahdollisuuksia myös tulevaisuuden suhteen. Varuste.net Akatemia tarjoaa työntekijöillemme mahdollisuudet oppia uutta, kehittyä uudenlaisiin työtehtäviin ja hyödyntää omaa osaamistaan entistä paremmin.  Haluamme, että jokainen työntekijä panostaa siihen, että työ Varuste.netillä on kivaa. Sitä tukeaksemme, tarjoamme työntekijöillemme mm. loistavat henkilöstöalennukset, alan huipputuotteita lainaksi (esim. SUPit, teltat, lumikengät), hierontaa, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun, sekä mökin Rukalla.       Tehtävänkuvaus:   Osana myymälän esihenkilötiimiä työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä myymäläpäällikön ja kolmen muun tiiminvetäjän kanssa. Vastuullasi on varmistaa ensiluokkainen asiakaskokemus ja tukea henkilökuntaamme heidän päivittäisessä työssään. Johdat myymälän arjen operatiivisia toimintoja, valmennat tiimiäsi menestykseen ja varmistat työskentelyn sujuvuuden sekä tasapuolisuuden. Olet avainasemassa luomassa ympäristöä, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus loistaa.      Työtehtävät:     Operatiivinen arjen johtaminen:  Vast

title: Supervisor Customer Support (m/w/d) 80-100%
description: Jobbeschreibung  Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an.   Wir bei bexio leben die Philosophie, dass erstklassige, effiziente und smarte Softwarelösungen für jedes KMU zugänglich und erschwinglich sein müssen. Mit dieser Mission sind wir heute die führende Anbieterin für webbasierte Business-Software in der Schweiz.   Unser Expansionskurs geht steil nach oben: Über 100'000 zufriedene Kunden, mehr als 7'000 Treuhand-Partner und ein starkes Team von über 150 motivierten Mitarbeitenden sprechen für sich. Um diese Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir tatkräftige Unterstützung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel!  Unser Ziel ist klar: Wir wollen nicht einfach nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern ein Support-Erlebnis schaffen, das begeistert. Klingt ambitioniert? Ist es auch!  Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als  Supervisor Customer Support  behältst du im Daily Business den Überblick und arbeitest aktiv im Team mit. Du steuerst die Abläufe vorausschauend, fängst Peaks flexibel ab und lässt das Team wie ein eingespieltes Orchester harmonieren -  fachlich orientiert und ohne administrativen Führungsdruck, sondern als motivierender Dreh- und Angelpunkt im Team .  Ein IT-Genie oder Treuhand-Profi musst du dafür nicht sein. Wichtig ist uns dein Drive, deine schnelle Auffassungsgabe, ein kühler Kopf im Getümmel und echte Begeisterung für deinen Job!  Stellenanforderungen Was du bei uns bewegst    Du organisierst das Daily Business, erstellst Stundenpläne, pflegst die Hotlines und übernimmst die frühzeitige und regelmässige Triage neuer Tickets.   Du arbeitest aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mit und packst bei hohem Aufkommen selbst am Telefon und im Ticket-System mit an.   Du versteckst dich nicht hinter Zahlen, sondern gehst als Vorbild voran und zeigst dem Team durch dein tägliches Handeln, was exzellenter Support bedeutet.   Du analysierst tägliche Kennzahlen, leitest Massnahmen ein und optimierst Prozesse in Rücksprache mit der Teamleitung, um Kundenzufriedenheit und Effizienz zu steigern.   Du fungierst als wichtiger Inputgeber für das Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam und übersetzt Kunden-Insights in konkrete Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts.    Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle    Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre oder Ausbildung, vorzugsweise im KV, Detailhandel oder Kontaktcenter-Umfeld.   Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung mit, davon mindestens 2–3 Jahre im Customer Care oder Support bei einem Unternehmen mit grosser Kundenbasis.   Man kennt dich für dein ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent, das Ressourcen effizient plant und auch bei vielen wartenden Anrufen blitzschnell die richtigen Prioritäten setzt.   Du bist ein absoluter Praktiker, behältst in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf und managst Anfragen effizient und in hoher Qualität.   Dir fällt es leicht, den Überblick zu behalten, du hast Drive und eine authentische Persönlichkeit,

description:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

👀 The Role

Title: Sports Trader

Team: Trading

Location: Gibraltar, on-site

We’re looking for an experienced Sports / Risk Trader who knows there’s a lot more to trading than moving a price and watching the liability screen.

You’ll join Midnite’s growing trading team, helping us manage risk across a wide range of sports. That means profiling customers, managing events and limits, pricing markets and making good calls when the action starts coming in.

You’ll need strong sporting knowledge, sound judgement and at least three years’ experience in a sports trading or risk role. We’re growing quickly, so we’re after someone who knows their stuff but still wants to learn, improve and help us do things better.

Hours of work: Monday - Sunday (8am-12pm) 5/7 days.

title: Quality Engineering – Automation (Playwright & GenAI)
description: Position Description  We are looking for a Quality Engineering – Automation professional with strong hands-on experience in modern test automation. This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring four days per week onsite at our/client's office in downtown Toronto.  The ideal candidate will have practical experience developing and enhancing automation frameworks using Playwright. The candidate should also have experience leveraging AI/GenAI tools to generate test cases, identify test scenarios, improve test coverage, and accelerate automation development.  Your future duties and responsibilities     Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable Playwright-based automation frameworks, preferably using TypeScript/JavaScript.   Create automated tests for functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.   Apply automation design practices such as Page Object Model (POM), reusable components, fixtures, data-driven testing, and parallel execution.   Use AI/GenAI tools to generate and enhance test cases and test scenarios, identify edge cases, and improve overall test coverage.   Leverage tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar GenAI solutions to assist with automation code development, debugging, test-data generation, and optimization.   Review and validate AI-generated test cases and automation code before implementation.   Integrate Playwright automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.   Perform API testing using Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or comparable tools, as well as SQL-based backend and test-data validation.   Execute smoke, functional, regression, integration, system, UAT, end-to-end, and cross-browser testing.   Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other Quality Engineering professionals in an Agile environment; analyze defects, document test results, contribute to quality metrics and release-readiness activities, and follow coding standards, automation best practices, and quality engineering principles.     Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role   Must-have:     3–5+ years of hands-on Quality Engineering / test automation experience.   Strong recent hands-on experience with Playwright automation.   Demonstrated ability to develop, enhance, and maintain Playwright automation frameworks, rather than only execute existing automated tests.   Experience using TypeScript/JavaScript for Playwright automation.   Strong understanding of automation framework concepts, including POM, fixtures, reusable components, data-driven testing, and test reporting.   Practical experience using AI/GenAI for Quality Engineering, particularly for creating test cases, test scenarios, automation scripts, or improving test coverage.   Experience with GenAI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar technologies.   API testing experience with REST APIs and tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate.

Modern Tooling:  Deep expertise with modern testing tools like Playwright or Cypress, alongside robust API testing capabilities (Postman, RestAssured, etc.). Startup Mentality:  You thrive in fast-paced, agile environments where you can operate autonomously, make architectural decisions, and set the standard rather than just follow a checklist. Vastuullesi kuuluu testiautomaation kokonaisuuden suunnittelu ja toteutus hyödyntäen testiautomaatiotyökaluja. Projektista riippuen tähän voi sisältyä esimerkiksi testiautomaation rakenteen, kirjastojen, testihierarkian ja raportoinnin määrittelyä.  Suunnittelet ja toteutat API-testausta sekä rakennat ja kehität testauksen integraatioita osaksi CI/CD-putkia.  Tuet projektitiimiä laadukkaiden, ylläpidettävien ja käyttäjälähtöisten ratkaisujen rakentamisessa. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä kehittäjien, suunnittelijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa, jotta laatu on mukana koko kehityksen elinkaaressa.  Toimit asiakkaan luotettavana kumppanina ja autat löytämään toimivia testaus- ja laadunvarmistuskäytäntöjä, jotka sopivat asiakkaan tarpeisiin ja ympäristöön.  Lisäksi osallistut laadunvarmistuksen toimintatapojen kehittämiseen ja tuot aktiivisesti näkemyksiä siitä, miten tekemistä voidaan parantaa projektin ja tiimin tasolla. Roolin tarkemmat painotukset ja vastuun laajuus tarkentuvat kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Keskustelemme kanssasi roolin tarkemmista painotuksista ja vastuun laajuudesta kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Riippuen roolin kokonaisuudesta, kiinteä kuukausipalkkasi sijoittuu tyypillisesti 4700–5700 euron välille.      Mitä toivomme sinulta?     Useamman vuoden työkokemusta testauksesta ja testiautomaatiokehityksestä sekä kokemusta laadunvarmistuksen tekemisestä osana ohjelmisto

title: QA Automation Engineer (BDD/TDD & Product Quality)
description: Compañía consolidada del sector servicios, actualmente inmersa en un proceso de transformación digital, busca incorporar talento técnico a su equipo de desarrollo. El proceso se gestiona de forma confidencial: la identidad de la empresa se facilitará a las personas que avancen a la fase de entrevista.     Incorporamos un/a  QA Automation Engineer  con experiencia en  BDD y automatización  para trabajar junto a los equipos de Producto y Desarrollo. La misión del puesto es diseñar planes de prueba, automatizar suites de regresión y traducir requisitos funcionales en escenarios ejecutables con Cucumber o herramientas similares, garantizando entregas con calidad, coherencia y velocidad.     Responsabilidades   Generar planes de prueba completos basados en criterios de aceptación.  Automatizar pruebas de regresión (UI, API, end-to-end).  Definir y mantener escenarios BDD en Cucumber o similar junto a Producto.  Validar que los tests cubren los requisitos funcionales y de negocio.  Colaborar con Desarrollo para impulsar prácticas TDD.  Mantener pipelines de automatización en CI/CD.  Documentar defectos y coordinar su resolución según impacto en negocio.  Participar en refinamientos y diseño funcional del producto.      Requisitos técnicos   Experiencia con Cucumber, Gherkin y BDD.  Conocimientos sólidos en JavaScript, TypeScript, Java o Python.  Experiencia con frameworks como Playwright, Cypress, Selenium o RestAssured.  Familiaridad con CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).  Conocimientos de pruebas de API (REST, GraphQL).  Buen entendimiento de TDD y testing piramidal.      Se valorará   Experiencia en entornos de Producto o UX.  Conocimientos de microservicios y arquitectura moderna.  Experiencia en análisis de métricas de calidad.      Competencias   Capacidad de traducir lenguaje de negocio a escenarios técnicos.  Comunicación clara con Producto y Desarrollo.  Atención al detalle y pensamiento crítico.  Proactividad y autonomía.      Condiciones   Trabajo 100% remoto desde cualquier punto de España.  Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.  Paquete de retribución flexible y seguro médico opcional.  Plan de desarrollo profesional dentro de un proyecto tecnológico en crecimiento.

title: Sr. Test Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Test Engineer based in France.   This is a senior QA opportunity focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of applications in Agile and Scrum environments.  You’ll take ownership of comprehensive testing activities, from test case creation and execution through defect management and validation.  The role combines functional, integration, and regression testing with close collaboration across engineering and business teams.  You’ll help translate functional and technical requirements into effective testing strategies and actionable quality standards.  The position also offers the opportunity to improve testing processes and identify areas where automation can increase efficiency and coverage.  You’ll work independently while contributing to multiple Scrum teams and supporting complex technology initiatives.  This is a strong fit for a detail-oriented QA professional who enjoys solving problems and continuously improving software quality.   Accountabilities     Perform integration, regression, and functional testing to ensure applications meet business, technical, and system requirements.  Create, review, maintain, and execute comprehensive test cases for new and modified systems.  Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into effective testing scenarios and quality criteria.  Identify, document, track, and manage defects through resolution while ensuring appropriate validation and follow-up.  Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders and Scrum teams within Agile delivery environments.  Support multiple teams and complex assignments while maintaining consistent quality and testing standards.  Apply established software engineering disciplines, change-control standards, and testing procedures throughout the development lifecycle.  Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to maintaining engineering and quality standards.  Provide insights and recommendations to improve testing processes, coverage, efficiency, and overall product quality.  Identify opportunities for test automation and contribute to approaches that support Test Driven Development where appropriate.  Work independently while adapting to evolving technologies, methodologies, and testing approaches.  Use analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate issues, reconcile results, and identify root causes.     Requirements     5+ years of experience working in Scrum and Agile environments.  Extensive experience across the full software testing lifecycle, including test case development, test execution, defect management, and validation.  Strong experience performing functional, integration, and regression testing.  Advanced analytical, quantitative, deductive reasoning, reconciliation, and problem-solving capabilities.  Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy

title: Test Automation Engineer
description: Vill du ta din erfarenhet inom testautomation till nästa nivå och vara med och kvalitetssäkra framtidens fordon? DXC/Luxoft söker nu, tillsammans med Oddwork, en Test Automation Engineer som vill bli en del av deras växande team i Sverige.      Om DXC/Luxoft   DXC Luxoft är ett globalt mjukvaru- och teknikbolag som levererar lösningar inom bland annat automotive, finans och digital transformation. Inom Automotive samarbetar de med några av världens ledande fordonstillverkare och leverantörer och är särskilt kända för sin expertis inom avancerad mjukvaruutveckling. Verksamheten i Sverige fortsätter att växa och här får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett internationellt team som utvecklar och kvalitetssäkrar nästa generations system för en fordonsindustri där uppkopplade, autonoma och elektrifierade fordon står i centrum.      Om rollen   Som Test Automation Engineer kommer du att spela en viktig roll i utvecklingen och kvalitetssäkringen av komplexa embedded- och infotainmentsystem inom automotive. Du kommer att utveckla, underhålla och köra automatiserade tester med Python och PyTest samt arbeta med funktionella tester, enhetstester och regressionstester.  En central del av rollen är att integrera automatiserade testsviter i CI/CD-pipelines och säkerställa smidiga testkörningar, uppföljning och rapportering. Du arbetar i Linux-miljö och använder verktyg som Git, Gerrit och Jenkins för versionshantering, code reviews och automatiserade processer.  Du kommer även att arbeta med kommunikationsprotokoll inom automotive, såsom CAN och Ethernet, samt verktyg som CANoe, CANalyzer och CAPL för simulering och analys. Tillsammans med utvecklingsteam som arbetar inom områden som Android Automotive OS bidrar du till att säkerställa hög kvalitet och stabilitet genom hela produktens utvecklingscykel. Extensive experience across the full software testing lifecycle, including test case development, test execution, defect management, and validation.  Strong experience performing functional, integration, and regression testing.  Advanced analytical, quantitative, deductive reasoning, reconciliation, and problem-solving capabilities.  Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy

title: QA Manager
description: 토스인컴을 소개해요     토스인컴은 금융이 시작되는 시점인 ‘소득’과 관련된 서비스를 제공하기 위해 토스커뮤니티의 새로운 계열사로 가장 최근에 출범했어요.  토스인컴은 특히 세무 영역에 집중하고 있어요. 세무는 고객이 매일 써야 하는 금융 서비스는 아니지만 금융 생활에서 반드시 마주치게 되는 영역인 만큼, 개인이 스스로 해결하기 어려운 세무 영역의 불편함을 해소하기 위해 노력해요.  토스가 모든 사람들이 보다 쉽고 편리한 금융 생활을 할 수 있도록 혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여 온 것처럼, 토스인컴은 ‘숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 전달하고 있어요.  토스커뮤니티의 가장 신생 계열사인만큼, 초기 멤버가 되어 함께 팀을 꾸려갈 수 있어요.       합류하면 함께할 업무예요     맡게 될 제품/도메인의 품질을 전담하여, 기획 단계부터 릴리즈까지 전 과정에 참여해요.  PO, 디자이너, 개발자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 제품 설계 단계부터 품질 이슈를 사전에 발견하고 해결 방향을 제시해요.  신규 기능과 개선 사항에 대한 테스트 전략 수립, 테스트 케이스 설계, 검증 수행, 회귀 테스트까지 전 과정을 책임져요.  서비스 특성과 팀의 개발/배포 문화에 맞는 QA 프로세스와 체크리스트를 설계·개선하고, 팀에 품질 문화를 정착시켜요.  필요하다면 자동화 테스트와 QA용 내부 툴 도입/개선 등을 통해, 더 효율적이고 재사용 가능한 테스트 구조를 만들어가요.  세무/운영/CS팀과 함께 실제 현장에서 발생하는 이슈를 분석하고, 근본 원인을 제품/프로세스 차원에서 해결하는 데 관여해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     복잡한 구조의 제품 QA를 기획부터 릴리즈까지 A-Z 전 과정에 참여해 성공적으로 출시해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.  제품 팀과 협업하며 여러 프로젝트의 일정과 테스트 커버리지를 효율적으로 관리해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.  배포 주기가 빠르거나 변경이 잦은 환경에서, 제품 특성에 맞는 QA 프로세스를 구축하고 개선한 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.        이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     QA로서 본인이 기여하고 집중한 부분과 성과(또는 실패 이후의 개선 사례)를 알고 싶어요.  빠른 개발/배포 사이클 속에서 QA를 수행해보신 경험이 있다면 작성해 주세요.  다양한 기술 스택을 활용 했다면, 해당 기술을 실제 QA에 어떻게 활용했는지 작성해 주세요.  포트폴리오를 같이 제출하시는 경우 현/전 직장의 대외비(테스트 케이스)는 첨부하지 말아주세요.       토스인컴으로의 합류 여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격  직무 인터뷰 전형에는 '라이브 과제'가 함께 진행됩니다. 약 50분 동안 화상 인터뷰 툴을 이용하여 수행하시게 됩니다.        함께할 동료를 위한 한마디     “토스인컴 서비스의 신뢰를 보증한다.”  토스인컴의 QA는 단순히 버그를 찾는 역할을 넘어, 사용자가 안심하고 세무/소득 서비스를 이용할 수 있는 ‘신뢰’ 자체를 설계해요.  “원래 이렇게 테스트해왔으니까”에 머무르지 않고, 새로운 방식의 테스트, 자동화, 툴 도입 등을 자유롭게 제안하고 시도할 수 있어요.  돈과 세금이라는 도메인 특성상 작은 실수도 크게 느껴질 수 있기 때문에, 토스인컴에서 QA의 역할과 임팩트는 더욱 크게 드러나요.  토스인컴에서 품질과 신뢰에 대한 새로운 기준을 함께 만들어갈 분을 기다리고 있어요.      📢 소득 그리고 세금 환급과 관련된 모든 불합리함과 불편함을 해소해 나갑니다. >혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여온 토스처럼, '숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 도전하고 싶으신가요? >누구나 손쉽게 앱 하나로 세무 문제를 해결하는 미래를 상상해보세요. >초기 멤버로 팀의 성장과 혁신의 중심이 되고싶다면, ‘토스인컴’에 지원해보세요. >토스의 가장 신생 계열사인 토스인컴의 초기멤버로 합류하실 수 있는 기회를 놓치지 마세요. ########토스인컴을 소개해요 - 토스인컴은 금융이 시작되는 시점인 ‘소득’과 관련된 서비스를 제공하기 위해 토스커뮤니티의 새로운 계열사로 가장 최근에 출범했어요. - 토스인컴은 특히 세무 영역에 집중하고 있어요. 세무는 고객이 매일 써야 하는 금융 서비스는 아니지만 금융 생활에서 반드시 마주치게 되는 영역인 만큼, 개인이 스스로 해결하기 어려운 세무 영역의 불편함을 해소하기 위해 노력해요. - 토스가 모든 사람들이 보다 쉽고 편리한 금융 생활을 할 수 있도록 혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여 온 것처럼, 토스인컴은 ‘숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 전달하고 있어요. - 토스커뮤니티의 가장 신생 계열사인만큼, 초기 멤버가 되어 함께 팀을 꾸려갈 수 있어요. 합류하면 함께할 업무예요 - 맡게 될 제품/도메인의 품질을 전담하여, 기획 단계부터 릴리즈까지 전 과정에 참여해요. - PO, 디자이너, 개발자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 제품 설계 단계부터 품질 이슈를 사전에 발견하고 해결 방향을 제시해요. - 신규 기능과 개선 사항에 대한 테스트 전략 수립, 테스트 케이스 설계, 검증 수행, 회귀 테스트까지 전 과정을 책임져요. - 서비스 특성과 팀의 개발/배포 문화에 맞는 QA 프로세스와 체크리스트를 설계·개선하고, 팀에 품질 문화를 정착시켜요. - 필요하다면 자동화 테스트와 QA용 내부 툴 도입/개선 등을 통해, 더 효율적이고 재사용 가능한 테스트 구조를 만들어가요. - 세무/운영/CS팀과 함께 실제 현장에서 발생하는 이슈를 분석하고, 근본 원인을 제품/프로세스 차원에서 해결하는 데 관여해요. 이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요 - QA 관련 경험이 7년 이상이신 분이면 좋아요. - 제품 단위를 넘어 조직 전체의 QA 프로세스를 설계하고 운영해보신 분이 필요해요. - 복잡한 구조의 제품 QA를 기획부터 릴리즈까지 A-Z 전 과정에 참여해 성공적으로 출시해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요. - 배포 주기가 빠르거나 변경이 잦은 환경에서, 제품 특성에 맞는 QA

title: [EnIT] IT Architect - Application Architect
description: 📃 누구나 마음 속에 이력서 한 장은 있으니까,  ⚡ 1분 컷 지원으로 현대오토에버로의 여정을 시작하세요. (이력서 자율양식)   ✅ IT Architect - Application Architect   🚀  합류하실 팀을 소개해요     기준정보시스템팀은 완성차 생산을 위한 CORE 정보인 BOM/Master Data/생기정보 등 기준정보를 관리하는 시스템을 개발/운영하는 팀입니다. 우리 팀은    기준정보의 무결성을 통해 완성차 전사시스템의 안정성 확보   IT 핵심역량을 보유한 최고의 전문가   긍정적/능동적인 마음가짐으로 행복한 직장생활 추구    라는 3대 목표를 가지고, 일과 삶에서 최선을 다해 행복을 추구하고자 노력하는 팀입니다!!  팀 내 운영 시스템은 RDBMS/X-FRAMEWORK 기반에 마이플랫폼으로 구현되어있으나, 현재 오픈소스기반 차세대 플랫폼을 준비하고 있어 팀 내 신기술 역량향상을 기대하고 있습니다.  💻  합류하시면 함께 할 업무예요     애플리케이션 설계 및 아키텍처 정의  API 아키텍처 설계  성능, 확장성, 보안을 고려한 설계  개발팀과 협력하여 기술 문제 해결  코드 리뷰 및 기술 표준 수립     🔍 이런 분과 함께 하고 싶어요     Java/Spring 기반 10년 이상 개발 경력  시스템 아키텍처 설계 경험 3회 이상  최근 2년 이내 본인이 직접 설계·구현한 프로덕션 코드 실적 보유    (PL/Architect 역할 수행 중에도 핵심 모듈 직접 구현 및 프로젝트 전 기간 상시 코드 리뷰·페어 프로그래밍 수행 필수)    코드 리뷰 문화를 직접 운영/정착시켜 본 경험  배치, 연동(ERP/MES/PLM 등 외부 시스템), API 설계 및 개발 경험  성능, 확장성, 장애 대응을 고려한 비기능 요구사항(NFR) 설계 경험  SOA 혹은 MSA 기반의 시스템 구축 경험    #시스템 구조 분석/설계 방법론 #아키텍처 이해 #아키텍처 구현/관리   🔍 이런 분이라면 더욱 좋아요     대용량 BOM 데이터(트리 구조, 버전 관리, 이력 추적) 처리를 고려한 DB/트랜잭션 설계 경험  Full stack 개발자  Oracle / MySql 기반의 DB 운영 경험     ⌛ 이렇게 합류해요     서류 접수 → 서류 검토 → 직무역량테스트(과제테스트) 및 인성검사 → 1차면접 → 2차면접     → 처우협의 및 채용검진 → 최종 합격🎉  ※ 상기 직무역량테스트 外 추가 역량평가가 진행될 수 있으며, 해당 결과는 종합적인 역량 검토를 위한 참고자료로 활용됩니다.    📍 만나게 될 근무지는 여기예요     서울 강남     📣 동료의 한 마디     안녕하세요, 기준정보시스템팀 A책임입니다! 우리 팀은 활발한 커뮤니케이션과 수평적 문화가 특징이에요. 팀원 개인 의견을 서로 존중하며 편안한 분위기 속에 개인의 역량이 최대로 발휘하여 개인과 조직의 성장을 함께 하고 있어요. 또한 업무에 필요한 역량 교육을 권장하는 문화 및 제도가 잘 마련되어 이를 업무에도 적극 활용하여 정체되지 않고 성장할 수 있답니다. 가끔은 팀원들과 같이 인근 산책 및 티타임을 하면서 좀 더 자유로운 의견 교류와 함께 서로에게 힘이 되어주고 격려하고 있어요. 우리 팀과 함께 하고 싶은 분들은 언제나 환영이니 많이 지원해 주세요 :)  (팀 리더) 기준정보시스템팀은 밝고 긍정적인 에너지로 채워진 기술/업무 전문가들로 구성되어 있으며, 많은 경력의 선배들이 후배들의 기술/업무 역량 향상을 위해 적극적으로 지원하는 팀입니다. 팀 내 주요 업무인 BOM/MDM/생기 정보는 완성차 근간에 CORE로 사용되는 정보로써 완성차 연구소/생산/판매등 다양한 부문과 인터페이스되며 전반적인 업무 경험을 할 수 있습니다. 우리 팀에 합류한다면 기술개발 뿐만 아니라, 완성차 기준정보 전문가로 발전하여 각 영역에서 활약하는 리더로서 성장 가능합니다.    📌  참고해 주세요     채용 시 마감되는 상시 채용 공고로 운영되며, 채용 절차와 일정은 변동될 수 있어요.  사회적 배려 대상자(보훈 취업지원대상자, 장애인)는 관계 법령과 내규에 따라 우대해요.  모집 분야 및 담당 업무에 따라 영어 구술평가, 레퍼런스 체크, 또는 기타 전형이 실시될 수 있어요.  지원자의 경험과 역량을 고려하여 다른 포지션이 더 적합하다고 판단되는 경우 지원 분야가 변경될 수 있어요.  배치 부서 및 근무지는 회사 사정에 따라 변경될 수 있어요.  아래의 경우, 합격이 취소되거나 전형 진행에서 불이익을 받으실 수 있어요.  지원서가 사실과 다르거나 증빙이 불가할 경우  해외여행 결격 사유가 있는 경우 (남성의 경우, 회사가 지정한 입사일까지 병역 필 또는 면제 필요)  최종 합격 후 회사가 지정하는 입사일에 입사 불가한 경우

title: QA Lead with Spanish (Madrid)
description: About the role:      We are looking for an experienced QA leader with deep testing expertise and the credibility to lead the QA function effectively in a complex project environment. You understand QA best practices, manage client expectations confidently, and provide strong people leadership. You are able to build trust with clients and colleagues, develop team capabilities, and establish a high-performing and scalable QA organisation.  You will:   Lead the QA function within the project environment, ensuring a strong, credible, and effective quality organisation.  Define and drive the QA strategy, test approach, governance, and quality standards across the project lifecycle.  Act as the main QA counterpart for clients, managing expectations, building trust, and providing clear quality leadership.  Lead, mentor, and develop QA team members, helping raise capability, confidence, and overall team maturity.  Build strong collaboration across business, delivery, and technical teams to embed quality throughout the delivery process.  Oversee test planning, execution, defect management, reporting, and quality risk management.  Ensure the QA area is not only operationally effective, but also seen as a trusted and value-adding function by both client and internal stakeholders.  Support UAT and coordinate with client stakeholders where needed, while maintaining ownership of the broader QA direction. Søk med CV og noen ord om hvorfor – vi vurderer søkere fortløpende.

description: 합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요    토스플레이스 Technical Account Manager는 고객사의 요구와 상황에 최적화된 결제 시스템 연동을 지원하며 기술적 이슈 해결 및 전문 컨설팅을 통해 고객에게 안정감과 신뢰를 제공해요.  이용 중인 가맹점에서 발생하는 문제에 대해 기술적으로 분석하고 검증하며 이를 바탕으로 실질적인 해결 방안을 가맹점과 함께 논의해요.       합류하면 함께 할 업무예요    필요한 절차를 단계별로 설계 및 조율하며 파트너사와의 원활한 기술 협업을 통해 결제 연동을 성공적으로 끌어내고 있어요.  단순히 문제만 해결하는 것이 아닌 고객사의 의견을 들으며 필요 사항을 진단하여 제품 팀과 함께 전체적인 서비스를 개선해요.  불필요한 의사결정 단계를 지양하며 가맹점 연동에 필요한 기술 지원 및 커뮤니케이션에 집중하여 문제 해결의 실효성을 높이고 있어요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요    새로운 기술에 대한 높은 관심과 학습 의지를 바탕으로 변화하는 기술 환경에 능동적으로 대응할 수 있는 분이면 좋아요.  고객사의 개발자와 깊이 있게 소통하고 기술적 문제를 빠르게 분석하여 해결하기 위한 방법을 쉽게 잘 설명해 주실 수 있는 분이 필요해요.  직면한 문제를 끝까지 풀어내는 끈기가 있는 분, 특히 팀으로 함께 문제를 해결해 나가는 과정을 즐기는 분이면 좋아요.  기술 파트너로서 고객과의 협업을 주도할 수 있도록 다양한 기술을 비즈니스 맥락에서 유연하게 적용해 본 경험이 있으면 좋아요.  VAN/간편결제사 등 결제사 경험이 있으시다면 더 좋아요.       이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요    최신 개발 기술에 대해 경험해 보셨거나 프로젝트에 적용한 이력이 있으시다면 자세히 기술해 주세요.  직접 참여한 프로젝트의 기간, 역할, 기술 스택, 주요 기여 내용, 프로젝트 이후의 개선 효과 등을 중심으로 본인의 구체적인 기여도를 상세히 기술해 주세요.  경험했던 내용이 꼭 성공한 프로젝트 일 필요는 없어요. 최대한 많은 경험을 알려주세요.       토스플레이스로의 합류여정    서류 접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격 및 입사

title: Customer Service Manager
description: Functieprofiel    Als  Customer Service Manager  bij  PTH Global  ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere ontwikkeling van de internationale Customer Service-afdeling. Vanuit Zwolle ondersteunt het team klanten van de merken VONROC, FERM, Blue Home en Waterocx in heel Europa, variërend van consumenten tot webshops, retailers en marketplaces.     De organisatie bevindt zich in een sterke groeifase. Niet alleen groeit het aantal producten en klanten, ook de verwachtingen rondom dienstverlening nemen toe. Klantbeleving is daarom een strategisch speerpunt binnen PTH Global. De Customer Service Manager speelt hierin een centrale rol door processen, mensen en prestaties continu verder te ontwikkelen.     Binnen PTH Global wordt gewerkt vanuit de overtuiging dat een uitstekend product pas echt onderscheidend wordt wanneer de totale klantbeleving klopt. Customer Service is hierin veel meer dan een operationele afdeling; het vormt een belangrijke schakel tussen de organisatie en de klant en levert waardevolle inzichten voor de verdere ontwikkeling van producten, processen en dienstverlening.     De Customer Service Manager geeft leiding aan een internationaal Customer Service-team van 20 medewerkers. De nadruk ligt daarbij niet alleen op het realiseren van operationele doelstellingen, maar juist ook op het ontwikkelen van medewerkers, het verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van een klantgerichte cultuur.     De rol vraagt om een leidinggevende die overzicht weet te combineren met betrokkenheid. Iemand die zichtbaar is op de werkvloer, eigenaarschap stimuleert en samen met het team bouwt aan een afdeling die klaar is voor de volgende groeifase. Je weet structuur aan te brengen, bent analytisch sterk en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt.       Daarnaast ben je zichtbaar binnen de organisatie, maak je gemakkelijk contact en weet je medewerkers mee te nemen in veranderingen. Je hebt oog voor nieuwe ontwikkelingen en ziet technologische innovaties, waaronder AI, als een kans om de dienstverlening verder te verbeter

title: Responsable de la réussite client
description: Pour la version anglaise de cette description de poste, veuillez consulter le lien suivant / For the English version of this job description, please refer to the following link :     https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/appdirect/jobs/8737473002    À propos d’AppDirecte   Devenez un citoyen du monde à l’ère numérique et outillez une nouvelle génération d’entrepreneurs branchés aux quatre coins du globe. AppDirecte offre une plateforme d’abonnement permettant de vendre n’importe quel produit en tant que service, et ce, par n’importe quel canal et sur n’importe quel appareil. Nous alimentons des millions d’abonnements pour le compte d’organisations de partout dans le monde. Notre action est toujours guidée par nos valeurs et notre culture – une culture qui vous permet d’être vu, de rester authentique et d’exceller.   Votre profil   Devs.AI est une initiative stratégique d’AppDirect dédiée à créer la prochaine génération d'outils d'entreprise basés sur l'IA. Nous cherchons à combler notre tout premier poste de responsable de la réussite client, mais rassurez-vous, vous n'aurez pas à tout construire de zéro. AppDirect dispose déjà d'une infrastructure de soutien éprouvée (Zendesk), d'une équipe de soutien interne de niveaux 1, 2 et 3, et d’ententes de niveau de service établies. Votre rôle consistera donc à mobiliser ces ressources pour Devs.AI tout en étant responsable de la fonction de réussite client. Votre accorderez la plus grande priorité à nos principaux comptes stratégiques, en agissant comme partenaire de confiance pour favoriser l'adoption, s’assurer que la plateforme est utilisée à son plein potentiel et développer la relation au fil du temps. Vous superviserez également l'expérience de soutien pour les clients de Devs.AI, en collaborant avec les équipes de soutien internes d'AppDirect et en intervenant vous-même au besoin. Il s’agit d’un poste de type « couteau suisse » : en l’espace de quelques heures, vous pourriez passer d’une revue trimestrielle du rendement auprès d’un client clé, pour ensuite peaufiner une entente de niveau de service pour Devs.ai et finalement traiter un ticket de soutien dans Zendesk.   Ce que vous ferez et ce qui vous fera briller    Gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie après-vente des comptes stratégiques : intégration, adoption, renouvellement et expansion.  Agir comme principal interlocuteur auprès de nos plus grands clients, notamment en organisant des revues trimestrielles de performance (QBR), en faisant des mises au point régulières avec la direction et en élaborant des plans de réussite.  Optimiser la rétention du chiffre d’affaires en générant des ventes additionnelles, des ventes croisées et une adoption approfondie du produit.  Superviser l’expérience de soutien pour Devs.ai, en collaboration avec les équipes de soutien de niveau 1/2/3 d’AppDirect.  Peaufiner et appliquer des ententes de niveau de service adaptées spécifiquement aux clients de Devs.ai, en adaptant le cadre existant d’AppDirect.  Travailler

title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.  That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:  you own the release gate.  If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.  That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks  like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.  You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.  Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.  What You'll Own     The release gate: One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.    API test automation: Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.    End-to-end front-end automation: Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.    AI-driven test generation and maintenance: Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point. title: Senior Analytics Engineer - US
description:

More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to build and scale the analytical foundation that powers decision-making across Go-to-Market, Product, Finance, People, and Operations teams.

You will sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics: transforming raw product, marketing, financial, and operational data into clean, well-modeled, and trustworthy datasets. Your work will power everything from executive dashboards and cohort analyses to experimentation, billing operations, AI-powered outreach, and semantic layers that let AI agents answer stakeholder questions autonomously.

This is a highly cross-functional role — you'll partner closely with Product Management, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, People Ops, and Engineering to ensure our analytics stack is robust, scalable, and aligned with the business.

Responsibilities

Build & Own the Data Foundation

  • Own and evolve our dbt project — ensuring models are performant, well-tested, and documented.

  • Design and maintain the Snowflake data warehouse and ingestion processes.

  • Use modern data modeling best practices to create core entities and datasets that account for complex business processes and logic.

  • Build and maintain custom Python/Airflow pipelines to ingest data from third-party APIs into Snowflake.

  • Design and operate cross-system reconciliation models that compare data across source systems to surface discrepancies and protect revenue.

Drive Data Quality & Automation

  • Implement testing and observability for analytics pipelines.

  • Enforce CI/CD best practices, such as automation, linting, tests, code review and approvals.

  • Standardize metric definitions and ensure they are consistently computed across tools.

  • Investigate and document data incidents end-to-end — from root cause analysis through remediation tracking and stakeholder communication.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as data liaison between Engineering, GTM, and Finance — ensuring consistent metric definitions and proper system instrumentation.

  • Enable stakeholder self-service access to trusted insights.

  • Drive data literacy: evangelize best practices in querying, dashboarding, and interpreting metrics; coach stakeholders toward self-serve.

title: Client Retention Specialist
description:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

Our Customer Success Team serves as the primary point of contact for valued customers enrolled in Beyond Finance’s financial hardship programs. Our Retention Specialists play a critical role in ensuring the continued loyalty of our Beyond customer base. As a Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility will be to educate and assist clients who are facing financial hardship and exploring options to become debt-free. You will play a crucial role in retaining clients within the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program. In this position, you will interact with clients primarily through inbound phone calls and be responsible for deescalating upset clients, empathizing with their financial difficulties, and helping them navigate the Beyond Finance program. Their primary focus is on our at-risk customers who are struggling with the use and/or value of their enrolled program, requiring creative problem solving to help them better realize and understand the value of their decision.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Educate Clients: Provide comprehensive information about the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program to clients, ensuring they have a clear understanding of the benefits, process, and available options.
  • Empathize and Deescalate: Display empathy and active listening skills to understand and deescalate upset clients, addressing their concerns and alleviating their stress regarding their financial situation.
  • Navigate CRM System: Effectively use our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to quickly access and comprehend client information, including their current financial status and program progress. Maintain accurate and detailed records of all client interactions and program progress in the CRM system.
  • Analyze Financial Situation: Assess the client's current financial situation and determine the most appropriate options to help them achieve their goal of becoming debt-free.
  • Retain Clients: Collaborate with clients to develop customized solutions that align with their financial goals, and encourage them to remain in the Beyond Finance program.

Acquia empowers the world’s most ambitious brands to create digital customer experiences that matter. With open source Drupal at its core, the Acquia Digital Experience Platform (DXP) enables marketers, developers, and IT operations teams at thousands of global organizations to rapidly compose and deploy digital products and services that engage customers, enhance conversions, and help businesses stand out.

title: Bilingual Client Retention Specialist
description:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

Our Customer Success Team serves as the primary point of contact for valued customers enrolled in Beyond Finance’s financial hardship programs. Our Retention Specialists play a critical role in ensuring the continued loyalty of our Beyond customer base. As a Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility will be to educate and assist clients who are facing financial hardship and exploring options to become debt-free. You will play a crucial role in retaining clients within our financial hardship debt program. In this position, you will interact with clients primarily through inbound phone calls and be responsible for deescalating upset clients, empathizing with their financial difficulties, and helping them navigate the program. Their primary focus is on our at-risk customers who are struggling with the use and/or value of their enrolled program, requiring creative problem solving to help them better realize and understand the value of their decision.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Educate Clients: Provide comprehensive information about Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program to clients, ensuring they have a clear understanding of the benefits, process, and available options.
  • Empathize and Deescalate: Display empathy and active listening skills to understand and deescalate upset clients, addressing their concerns and alleviating their stress regarding their financial situation.
  • Navigate CRM System: Effectively use our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to quickly access and comprehend client information, including their current financial status and program progress. Maintain accurate and detailed records of all client interactions and program progress in the CRM system.
  • Analyze Financial Situation: Assess the client's current financial situation and determine the most appropriate options to help them achieve their goal of becoming debt-free.
  • Retain Clients: Collaborate with clients to develop customized solutions that align with their financial goals, and encourage them to remain in the Beyond Finance program.

description:

  • Coachable, resilient, and motivated to improve performance

title: Account Executive | Vodori (UK)
description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive. GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of Vodori, GT is looking for an Account Executive (Enterprise SaaS – Life Sciences) who is excited to drive complex enterprise sales cycles and help leading pharma, biotech, and medtech companies modernize their commercial and compliance infrastructure.

About the Client

Founded in 2005, Vodori is a purpose-built SaaS company helping life sciences organizations accelerate compliant promotional content review. With two decades of experience, Vodori has become the trusted choice for pharmaceutical, medical device, biotech, and diagnostics companies worldwide.

Positioned as a modern, flexible, and cost-effective alternative to legacy systems, Vodori partners closely with Salesforce and other commercial tools, and is rapidly expanding its footprint across enterprise life sciences organizations looking to future-proof their operations.

About the Role

As an Account Executive, you will own and drive new enterprise revenue by leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You will act as a strategic, business-case-led seller who can translate customer pain into measurable impact and guide organizations through meaningful transformation.

You will work closely with SDRs, Marketing, and Leadership to execute a focused go-to-market strategy targeting enterprise pharma and medtech accounts. This role requires a disciplined and consultative approach, with a strong focus on deal qualification, stakeholder alignment, and closing high-value opportunities.

Responsibilities:

  • Owning full-cycle enterprise sales from qualification to close

  • Leading complex, multi-threaded deals across commercial, medical, regulatory, IT, and executive stakeholders

  • Building and presenting compelling business cases (ROI, cost of inaction)

  • Running structured discovery and translating customer pain into quantified business impact

  • Driving pipeline conversion through clear next steps and mutual action plans

  • Maintaining deal momentum throughout long sales cycles

  • Developing and executing account strategies for enterprise and upper mid-market clients

  • Partnering with SDRs on outbound efforts and account coverage

  • Collaborating with Marketing on campaigns and messaging

  • Working cross-functionally with Customer Success and Product teams to support deal progression

Essential knowledge, skills & experience:

  • 5–10+ years of SaaS sales experience

  • Proven track record closing $50K–$250K+ ACV

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Security
description:
About the Team

OpenAI builds powerful AI systems like ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, and enterprise products that serve millions of users across the globe. As we scale, securing our infrastructure, protecting sensitive data, and meeting global compliance standards are essential to our success and societal impact.

Security at OpenAI is a cross-cutting function that spans infrastructure, applied engineering, legal, policy, and product. Technical Program Managers (TPMs) play a critical leadership role in aligning teams and delivering execution at scale and this role will be foundational in shaping how we secure OpenAI’s systems, users, and commitments.

About the Role

We’re seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive cross-functional security, privacy, IT and compliance initiatives at the intersection of infrastructure, product, and policy. You will execute complex programs that reduce internal data access, prevent misuse, and ship security capabilities. You will focus your efforts on the most critical initiatives within Security, crossing the spectrum of insider threat, information security, physical security, and information technology challenges.

This role is deeply technical and execution-focused. It requires a structured operator who thrives in ambiguity, partners effectively across boundaries, and applies principled judgment to scale trust, governance, and security across OpenAI’s systems and products.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive execution of critical security and compliance programs such as vulnerability management, merger and acquisition security and integration, infrastructure hardening, and datacenter security management. You will need to deeply collaborate on technical architecture and resolve technical problems in partnership with engineering.

  • Partner with IT, Infrastructure, Application, Legal, Privacy, and Security teams to build scalable programs, and deliver critical security outcomes across multiple disciplines, including insider threat, information security, physical security, and information technology.

  • Establish scalable frameworks and build programs around critical security initiatives including vulnerability management, evidence collection, incident response coordination, supply chain risk management, and device security.

  • Track and enforce OpenAI’s privacy and security requirements by translating commitments into engineering milestones and driving their full implementation across systems.

  • Create and maintain program-level visibility across risk areas, security milestones, and cross-org dependencies—ensuring outcomes are delivered reliably and at high quality.
