title: Senior AI/ML Engineer, Security Log Intelligence
description:
We are building a new capability that turns fragmented, noisy security logs into explainable, AI-powered threat analysis, delivered inside the RedMimicry platform.

As Senior AI/ML Engineer at RedMimicry, you will lead the applied AI/ML work behind new analysis capabilities for our breach and attack emulation platform. The core challenge is extracting useful structure from heterogeneous, partially unstructured security telemetry and relating it to known attacker activity.

The problem is broader than prompt engineering. You will determine where LLMs, embeddings, retrieval, learned ranking, and deterministic heuristics are justified. The standard is measurable improvement against reproducible baselines, not architectural fashion. Everything you build must operate under realistic latency, reliability, and deployment constraints.

This is a fixed-term position running until 31 October 2027.

Tasks

  • Develop Security-Log Parsing Methods: Design and implement methods for extracting typed events from heterogeneous SIEM, EDR, NDR, operating-system, and network telemetry.
  • Design Embeddings and Retrieval: Select, evaluate, and tune representations and retrieval methods for security events.
  • Handle Ambiguity Explicitly: Implement confidence scoring, calibration, and controlled treatment of ambiguous evidence.
  • Ground Results in Evidence: Ensure that results are supported by traceable evidence from the original telemetry.
  • Build Rigorous Evaluations: Define datasets, baselines, ablations, and metrics, and analyse failure modes systematically.
  • Optimise Inference: Make the pipeline practical for cloud operation and on-premises deployment.
  • Productise the Research: Work with backend, integration, and offensive-security engineers to turn experimental methods into maintainable

title: Junior AI/ML Engineer, Data and Evaluation
description:
We are building a new capability that turns fragmented, noisy security logs into explainable, AI-powered threat analysis, delivered inside the RedMimicry platform.

As an AI/ML Engineer at RedMimicry, you will build the datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation infrastructure behind our applied AI/ML work on security telemetry.

The quality of this work depends on accurate ground truth, disciplined data handling, reproducible experiments, and systematic error analysis. Your work will determine whether reported improvements are real and whether regressions are caught before deployment.

You will work closely with the Senior AI/ML Engineer and Offensive Security Engineer. This role is suitable for an early-career or intermediate engineer with strong programming and data skills who wants to work on applied AI in a technically demanding cybersecurity environment.

This is a fixed-term position running until 31 October 2027.

Tasks

  • Curate Security Datasets: Prepare telemetry from controlled engagements and test environments.
  • Build Ground Truth: Create and maintain labelled examples, annotation guidelines, and consistency checks.
  • Maintain Evaluation Partitions: Separate training, validation, and test data along relevant dimensions.
  • Automate Benchmarks: Implement metrics and maintain reproducible benchmark and regression pipelines that run locally and in CI.
  • Run Experiments and Error Analysis: Evaluate models and methods, and identify recurring failure modes and data-quality issues.
  • Maintain Data Quality: Implement schema checks, provenance tracking, deduplication, validation, and dataset versioning.
  • Document Experiments: Produce clear experiment records, plots, tables, and technical summaries that support engineering decisions.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Security Analytics
description:
We are building a new capability that turns fragmented, noisy security logs into explainable, AI-powered threat analysis, delivered inside the RedMimicry platform.

As a Full Stack Engineer at RedMimicry, you will take a leading role in developing a new security analytics capability within our platform. You will build the user interface and the application layer that connects the underlying components into a reliable workflow for security analysts.

This is a fixed-term position running until 31 October 2027.

Tasks

  • Build Backend Services and APIs: Implement services and stable interfaces for ingestion, analysis, and reporting workflows.
  • Design Domain Models: Define maintainable data models for security events, analysis results, and supporting evidence.

  • Build Secure Multi-Tenant Components: Apply authentication, authorisation, tenant separation, and secure data-handling patterns.
  • Maintain Engineering Quality: Add tests, review code, document interfaces, monitor performance, and translate analyst feedback into concrete improvements.

Wer Non-Food-Ware aus Asien nach Europa bringt, gewinnt heute nicht mehr über den Einkaufspreis, sondern über Verlässlichkeit: geprüfte Lieferketten, belastbare Zertifizierungen, planbare Termine. Dafür suchen wir für Carstensen eine zweite starke Stimme im Finanzbereich: jemanden, der das Bankenreporting und den Konzernabschluss verlässlich trägt und daneben die Themen aufbaut, die bisher zu kurz gekommen sind — Kostenrechnung, Controlling-Systeme, Beteiligungscontrolling.

Its modular technology and in-house expertise enable customers to create tailored payment solutions that are flexible, scalable and secure.  As a regulated payments partner, Enfuce holds Electronic Money Institution licences from both the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority and the UK Financial Conduct Authority and is a principal member of Visa and Mastercard. Its PCI-DSS-certified, cloud-native platform is designed for enterprise-grade reliability and global scalability, with 99.999% platform uptime.  Enfuce has raised €73.5 million in funding and has received industry recognition including Fintech of the Year and Best ESG Campaign at the 2024 European Fintech Awards.       About The Role:    We're looking for a Senior Exploratory QE Engineer to strengthen how we find risk before our customers do. This is not a scripted test-case role. You'll use structured exploratory testing, charter-based sessions and deep product intuition to probe our card issuing and payment processing platform for the failure modes that automated suites and requirements documents miss: edge cases in transaction flows, race conditions, state corruption, security gaps and usability breakdowns. You'll work closely with automation engineers, developers and product owners, but your craft is distinct: you go where the tests don't, and you make the invisible risks visible.       What You'll Be Doing:    Design and run structured exploratory testing charters against new features, APIs and high-risk areas of the platform, guided by risk, not scripts.  Dig into complex payment and card lifecycle flows to uncover edge cases, state issues and integration gaps.  Partner with automation QE engineers to decide what should be automated, what needs a human eye, and feed exploratory findings back into the regression suite.  Perform risk-based test planning for releases, identifying the areas most likely to break and why.  Investigate production incidents and near-misses to find the underlying gaps in test coverage, then close them.  Champion a quality mindset across engineering, and raise the bar on what 'done' means.  Contribute to and evolve our exploratory testing practice: charters

title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
description:
Headquarters:  Remote
 

  Payabli  is a next-generation Payments Infrastructure and Monetization Platform purpose-built for vertical software companies. Through a single, developer-friendly API with low-code embedded payment components, Payabli enables platforms to seamlessly embed, monetize, and operationalize payments—making payments a core part of their platform and business model.  By unifying payment acceptance, payment issuance, and advanced payment operations tooling, Payabli empowers software companies to manage and move money through a single infrastructure stack that delivers total control over the payments experience. Built to scale with PCI DSS 4.0 and SOC 2-compliant security, Payabli’s infrastructure delivers enterprise-grade reliability and trust while leveraging AI-driven intelligence to enhance visibility, streamline operations, and drive revenue growth.  Backed by leading fintech investors including QED Investors, Fika Ventures, TTV Capital, and Bling Capital, Payabli is setting the standard for embedded payments infrastructure powering the next generation of vertical SaaS.    We're seeking a  Senior   Product Manager, Platform  to own and evolve the foundational services that every product at Payabli depends on. From identity and authentication to embedded components, tokenization, and notification systems—you'll be the connective tissue between engineering and the rest of the organization, ensuring our platform is secure, scalable, and built to last.  This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage from the sidelines. You'll run to the fire, own the outcomes, and build the infrastructure that makes everything else at Payabli possible.     What You'll Do      Identity & Access Management  Lead the strategy and execution of our identity platform, spanning both authentication and authorization. You'll define how users and API consumers prove who they are and what they're allowed to do—two fundamentally different problems that require distinct architectures. This includes SSO management, multi-tenant permissions models, and API authentication and authorization. You understand that identity is the front door to every product we build.     Embedded Components & Creator Suite  Own the foundational suite of embeddable components that our platform partners use to build financial experiences. You'll drive the strategy for our component library—from white-labeled UI elements to drop-in workflows—ensuring our partners can go live faster with less engineering effort. This requires experience building embeddable systems and a deep appreciation for developer experience.     Tokenization Services  Own the cross-cutting tokenization layer that serves multiple product lines. Tokenization underpins payment security, funding account protection, and data privacy across the entire platform. You'll work across teams to ensure a unified approach to sensitive data handling that scales with our growth and meets compliance requirements.

To participate in this project, you will need to create an account on our platform. Through this account, we can assign you testing tasks. You will be asked to use our website for defect tracking and will receive materials to prepare you for testing.

Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio

  • Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you.
  • Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class.

  • Location: Must be physically located in Italy.
  • Availability: 30 minutes for your Testlio account setup and 2 hours for the actual PayPal testing task, which will be paid.
  • Devices: iOS device (iPhone or iPad), Android device (Android Tablet or Phone), Laptop/Desktop.
  • Experience: Software testing experience is a plus, but if you are new to testing, we offer free courses to help you learn and grow. We offer a preparatory course that will help you learn more about testing on our website.

What does testing look like?

  • Type of testing: Functional testing.
  • Type of work: short-term, freelance.
  • Workload: Regular weekly cadence, with additional ad-hoc requests possible throughout the week
  • Pay rate: The pay rate for this is 30 USD/hr.
  • Payment: You are paid weekly via PayPal or Payoneer.

Whether you’re checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development.      Summary   The Customer Success Manager will be responsible for the long-term success, value, and retention of their customer portfolio utilizing our MariaDB database solutions. Leveraging their  English language skills , they will strengthen and manage the partnership between customers and the company, interacting regularly to build relationships, drive adoption, and provide awareness to all available resources. Through collaboration, they will educate customers to achieve their business goals and maximize value from their investment in our MariaDB solutions. The CSM is the primary point of contact for escalations and is responsible for working in collaboration with a team of Sales Engineers, Account Executives, and other cross-functional teams, focused on helping our customers achieve their business goals.      Key Strategic & Retention Responsibilities    Support and engage with customers throughout all stages of their customer lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, expansion, retention, and advocacy.  Guide new customers through onboarding for MariaDB deployments, consulting on MariaDB best practices to ensure customers receive value.  Formulate an ongoing meeting cadence with the assigned portfolio.  Become a trusted advisor and advocate for customers within the company.  Understand customers' data management strategies and effectively articulate additional improvements and/or new strategies leveraging MariaDB capabilities.  Identify proactive opportunities to work with and provide value to customers.  Proactively address customer experience issues early, collaborating with Technical Support to understand their customer's issue, and assisting as an escalation point of contact.  Work with Sales Engineers and Professional Services to determine appropriate services for MariaDB upgrades, migrations, deployments, and/or maintenance.  Conduct regular business reviews within accounts, showcasing value and learning about business goals and priorities.  Encourage customer participation in company initiatives (Webinars, Roadshows, Product Feedback, etc).  Responsible for measuring, managing, and improving customer health, engagement, and value realization.  Coordinate with Account Executives to ensure the upgrade, migration, and/or growth of the customer portfolio. title: Customer Success Manager till Bonnier News
description: Vill du arbeta i en affärsnära och datadriven roll där kundrelationer, digital annonsering och affärsutveckling står i fokus? Vi söker nu en Customer Success Manager till Ad Operations där du ansvarar för att utveckla långsiktiga kundrelationer, driva retention och identifiera tillväxtmöjligheter.    Om Oss   Bonnier News är Nordens ledande mediekoncern med över 8 000 anställda. Vår techorganisation består av 350 personer, varav ca 180 är utvecklare, som utvecklar produkter och plattformar för några av Sveriges starkaste varumärken, inklusive Dagens Nyheter, Dagens Industri och Expressen. Vår journalistik når ut till sex mi ljoner läsare, lyssnare och tittare varje dag. Att försvara det fria ordet är centralt för oss.  Du blir en del av ett engagerat team på 7 personer bestående av Customer Success och Ad Operations Specialister. Som Customer Success Manager ingår du även i ett nationellt säljteam.   Om Rollen   Som Customer Success Manager ansvarar du för att utveckla och förvalta relationen med våra kunder. Du arbetar proaktivt med att förstå kundernas mål, KPI:er och affärsutmaningar för att säkerställa att våra lösningar skapar tydligt värde över tid.  Rollen är både strategisk och operativ och innebär nära samarbete med säljorganisationen, Ad Operations och andra interna funktioner. Du arbetar datadrivet med uppföljning, analys och optimering samtidigt som du identifierar möjligheter till vidareutveckling, retention och affärstillväxt.    Dina främsta arbetsuppgifterna är       Utveckla kundrelationen: Proaktivt förvalta din kundportfölj och driva långsiktig framgång, retention och förnyelser i nära samarbete med säljteamet.  Maximera affärsvärde och tillväxt: Analysera kundernas KPI:er och resultat för att säkra hög kundnöjdhet samt identifiera möjligheter till optimering, upsell och cross-sell.  Projektleda och hantera leveranser: Arbeta operativt med egna kampanjer samt briefa och koordinera interna specialistteam inom bl a Ad Operations för att säkra hög kvalitet.  Arbeta datadrivet och utvecklande: Rapportera, följa upp och dela med dig av kundinsikter för att ständigt utveckla våra interna processer och erbjudanden.     Vem är du?   Du är en relationsskapande och affärsdriven person som drivs av att skapa kundvärde, utveckla långsiktiga relationer och se konkreta resultat av ditt arbete. Du trivs i en datadriven miljö där du omsätter insikter till förbättringar och tillväxtmöjligheter, och har en naturlig förmåga att samarbeta och bygga förtroende med både kunder och interna team. title: Customer Success Manager - Claviate
description: Take ownership of the customer journey and help shape how Customer Success evolves in an ambitious technology company.       Shape Customer Experiences and Delivery Excellence      As Customer Success Manager at Claviate, you become the primary point of contact following the sales process, ensuring a seamless transition from onboarding to successful project delivery. As this is a newly established role, you have a unique opportunity to shape how Customer Success evolves while helping establish scalable ways of working, strengthen delivery quality and create a more consistent approach to project delivery as Claviate continues to grow.     Your key responsibilities include:   Acting as the trusted advisor and primary customer contact throughout implementation and project delivery  Coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver successful implementations  Building and maintaining trusted, long-term partnerships.  Managing feedback, challenges and escalations while ensuring successful project outcomes.  Identifying opportunities for process improvements, product enhancements and additional value  Supporting the continued professionalisation of customer-facing processes and governance structures.      Based at Claviate's headquarters in Aarhus, you report directly to the COO and work closely with customers and colleagues across the organisation. Travel activity is limited and expected to be approximately 10–20 days annually.      Customer-Focused, Structured and Solution-Oriented      We imagine that you bring experience from a similar customer-facing role within a software, SaaS or technology-driven organisation.     You thrive in a role where customer success, project coordination and stakeholder management go hand in hand. You are naturally curious, quick to understand new technologies and capable of translating technical concepts into meaningful value.     Furthermore, you:   Have experience managing relationships throughout implementation and delivery processes  Communicate effectively with both technical specialists and business stakeholders  Possess strong project coordination and organisational skills  Take ownership and drive activities forward independently and proactively  Balance customer advocacy with commercial and operational priorities  Are comfortable operating in a dynamic environment where processes continue to evolve. Join Claviate at an Exciting Stage of Growth      This is an opportunity to influence how a fast-growing technology company builds long-term client partnerships while helping shape a function that will become increasingly important as Claviate continues its international expansion. title: Customer Success Team Lead
description: Are you a Customer Success leader who loves building scalable ways of working? Do you want to help thousands of SMEs get real, measurable value from technology? Would leading a high-volume, fast-growing team energise you?  If you answered yes to every question, keep reading. You might be Groweo's new Customer Success Team Lead 🤩  We are looking for a Customer Success Team Lead to lead our Customer Success Associate team in a pooled, high-volume motion. This is a pure leadership role with no personal customer portfolio: you own your team's output, meaning customer retention, satisfaction, and measurable value deliver.   Who are you?   You know what good customer success looks like, and you know how to make it work at scale. Your team serves a large pool of customers, with each Associate managing 300+ accounts, so you think about efficiency, clarity, and repeatable processes as much as warmth. You understand that coaching your team on business understanding is the part of the job you care about most.  Our customers are owner-operators (plumbers, accountants, restaurant owners) who think in leads and bookings, not marketing funnels, and you help your team speak their language.   What will you do?   You lead the Customer Success Associate team: setting and maintaining the quality standard for every customer interaction, coaching team members on business understanding and value communication, and balancing workload across a pooled model. You design the KPI frameworks and playbooks the team follows. You monitor customer health metrics and step in on at-risk accounts, you hire and onboard as the team scales, and you coordinate with the other CS Team Lead, Support, Sales, and Product. You report on retention, optimisation delivery, satisfaction, and team capacity.   This role suits you if…     You have 4+ years in customer success or account management, with at least 2 years in a team leadership role  You understand what "good customer success" looks like and can set quality standards for how the team communicates and demonstrates value  Coaching is your strength: you can develop Associates' business understanding so customers always see the value of what has been done  You can design and track KPI frameworks: retention, customer health, satisfaction, and team performance  You can build repeatable playbooks for onboarding and regular customer interactions  You are comfortable hiring: interviewing and evaluating candidates for CS roles  You are strong operationally: workload distribution, portfolio balancing, and capacity planning  You build a team culture where business understanding is valued above technical speed  You are curious about AI and comfortable with prompting  You communicate clearly in both Finnish and English     What We Offer You     Salary depending on your experience and background: €5100 - €5700 OTE (80% base salary)  Interesting work in a growing and internationalising technology company  A lunch benefit as a fringe benefit

title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Fleet, Fuel and Mobility
description: About Enfuce:    Founded in 2016, Enfuce is a female-founded and led global payments partner solving payments complexity for ambitious brands, banks and fintech leaders. Born in the Nordics and built for the world, Enfuce combines deep payments expertise with cloud-native technology to help customers launch and scale with confidence.  Enfuce is a strategic issuing and licensing partner delivering premium, flexible payment programmes across consumer, commercial and B2B use cases. Built for fast launch and trusted scale, Enfuce designs, launches and runs card programmes supporting debit, credit, prepaid, fleet and fuel propositions, alongside digital wallets and card scheme connectivity.  Enfuce combines cloud-native issuing, embedded compliance and fraud intelligence to deliver velocity with control. Its modular technology and in-house expertise enable customers to create tailored payment solutions that are flexible, scalable and secure.  As a regulated payments partner, Enfuce holds Electronic Money Institution licences from both the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority and the UK Financial Conduct Authority and is a principal member of Visa and Mastercard. Its PCI-DSS-certified, cloud-native platform is designed for enterprise-grade reliability and global scalability, with 99.999% platform uptime.  Enfuce has raised €73.5 million in funding and has received industry recognition including Fintech of the Year and Best ESG Campaign at the 2024 European Fintech Awards.       About The Role:    Fleet, Fuel & Mobility is one of Enfuce's key strategic focus verticals, and we're looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to help us grow and strengthen some of our most important customer relationships within this space.  You'll take ownership of a portfolio of high-value and often complex customers across areas such as fuel retail, fleet cards, EV charging and mobility platforms.  This is a highly commercial Customer Success role. Your focus will go beyond customer satisfaction and retention. You'll develop strategic account plans, identify expansion opportunities and work with senior customer stakeholders to drive measurable growth for both the customer and Enfuce.  You'll also act as a key link between our customers and internal teams across Product, Commercial, Solution Consulting, Delivery and Finance, ensuring we're aligned around customer priorities and long-term growth opportunities.  As a senior member of the Customer Success team, you'll also contribute to team best practices, support colleagues and help strengthen how Enfuce manages its most strategic customer relationships. title: Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description: Who is Understory?   This is not the average job post. And we are not the average company.  Laura is a kind, creative, positive soul who loves to cook and loves teaching others to cook. So she started a company offering cooking classes for locals and tourists. The venue is authentic and beautiful - her taste is unique and welcoming. The classes are thoughtfully designed. Every detail is considered. And the bookings start to tick in - from people she knows, from views on Instagram, from word of mouth. It works. Laura gets to do what she loves, creating strong memories for people from all over the world.  But she is also starting to struggle. Managing participants. Hiring and training instructors. Chasing invoices. And the quiet pressure underneath it all: making sure more bookings arrive tomorrow than today.  That passion, and that struggle, is what Understory is built on.  Understory is a vertical-focused, multi-product operating system for experience businesses. With it, creators like Laura manage operations, accept payments, build beautiful websites, and automatically grow bookings across channels. Even the bookkeeping runs itself. AI is natively built into most of this, ensuring it works and scales, but that's not the point. The point is that Laura is empowered to live the life she has always dreamed of.  There are hundreds of thousands of Lauras across Europe and beyond, and no one has built the platform they deserve, yet. We intend to. We have the product, customers in 10+ countries, and a recently raised €12m Series A to be the driving force in a fragmented market.  Now we are launching Spain — and once our customers are live, there's a whole world of value they haven't unlocked yet. Your job is to help them get there.   Your role in this   As a Customer Success Manager (CSM), you will take ownership of customer relationships right after customers are live and have processed their first bookings. You are accountable for driving continuous product adoption, long-term retention, value realization, and spotting expansion opportunities to ensure our experience creators thrive on the platform over the years ahead. Drive full customer lifecycle retention, aiming for a target yearly ARR retention rate of 110%.  Help customers embed the software into their daily operations to increase booking volumes and platform utilization.  Monitor customer health scores, usage data, and engagement trends to proactively address risks and unlock new growth opportunities.  Handle direct account support, renewals, and collaborate with Customer Growth Managers and Sales on expansion initiatives. title: Customer Success Manager - French Market
description: You'll configure, test and stress-test AI agents running in production for 20 to 30 e-commerce brands, and you'll be the person they call when it matters.       Yuma is the most advanced AI platform for e-commerce support. Founded in late 2022, backed by Y Combinator, with 100+ merchants and over a million tickets resolved by our AI agents. We're a team of 20+ across Barcelona, Boston and a few remote spots. Small enough that your work is visible in your first week, mature enough that you'll be working on real accounts with real retention stakes.       📍 Based in   Barcelona   with partial remote.       The Team:       The Success team is composed of two teams.       The first one owns the accounts. Account Managers take our most strategic merchants and work closely with a technical counterpart. Customer Success Managers own a book on their own, the commercial side and the technical side both, which means they run their accounts end to end.       The second one is the technical team. Technical Account Managers handle the heavier implementations, and they're the ones Account Managers pull in on the hardest topics.       Cyril, our Head of Account Management, leads the whole thing from Barcelona.       Our mission: help every merchant automate a growing share of their support. And renew, because by then the results are there ;)       🎯 What you'll do:    You'll own a portfolio of 20 to 30 French e-commerce brands running their customer support on Yuma's AI agents.   This isn't a QBR-only CSM role: you build what runs in production, you debug it, and you keep the account over the long run.        Build automations with the merchant.   Most of what you set up starts with a conversation: either the merchant comes to you with a use case to automate, or you spot the one they haven't thought of yet. Then you build it around their actual processes.    Push each account's automation rate.   That's the metric that counts. You track it, you explain it to the merchant, and you know what to do when it plateaus.    Test, iterate, stress-test.   You'll spend time in the product writing and refining prompts, spotting where the AI goes off track, and fixing it. That's a concrete part of the day-to-day, not a "nice to have".    Diagnose before escalating.   We're a small team: you qualify the bug yourself, file the product issue, and talk directly to the engineer who picks it up. Account-driven fixes often ship within the week.    Be the merchant’s go-to contact for anything Yuma-related :   the day-to-day, incidents, questions, new ideas.    Own renewals and upsells across your portfolio.   You'll talk numbers, results and budget with your counterparts. Part of your variable compensation depends on it.        🔥 Why this role, right now:     Support automation is at a turning point. title: Technical Success Manager

Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.  At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.  We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.  Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast   Job D  escription  :   The Technical Success Manager (TSM) is a high-impact customer-facing role for someone who enjoys combining technical depth, customer advocacy, and commercial awareness to help customers get lasting value from cybersecurity technology.  In this role, you will partner with security, IT, and technical stakeholders to turn deployment into meaningful adoption, helping customers embed the platform into daily security operations, reduce risk, and achieve measurable outcomes.  You will work closely with Account Executives, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Support, and Renewals, bringing a clear technical view of customer health, adoption progress, risks, and renewal readiness.  This is a hybrid position, with a minimum of 3 days per week in our Milan office or remotely from Rome. title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - Spanish Speaking
description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.  As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.  Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.   Welcome to the video first world!   From your everyday PowerPoint presentations to Hollywood movies, AI will transform the way we create and consume content. Today, people want to watch and listen, not read — both at home and at work. If you’re reading this and nodding, check out our  brand video .  Despite the clear preference for video, communication and knowledge sharing in the business environment are still dominated by text, largely because high-quality video production remains complex and challenging to scale—until now….   Meet Synthesia   We're on a  mission to make video easy for everyone.  Born in an AI lab, our AI video communications platform simplifies the entire video production process, making it easy for everyone, regardless of skill level, to create, collaborate, and share high-quality videos. Whether it's for delivering essential training to employees and customers or marketing products and services, Synthesia enables large organizations to communicate and share knowledge through video quickly and efficiently. We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read  stories from happy customers  and what  1,200+ people say on G2 .  In 2023, we were one of 7 European companies to reach unicorn status. In February 2024, G2 named us as the fastest growing company in the world. description: About The Weather Company   The Weather Company is the world’s leading weather provider, helping people and businesses make more informed decisions and take action in the face of weather. Together with advanced technology and AI, The Weather Company’s high-volume weather data, insights, advertising, and media solutions across the open web help people, businesses, and brands around the world prepare for and harness the power of weather in a scalable, privacy-forward way. The world’s most accurate forecaster globally, the company reaches hundreds of enterprise clients and more than 360 million monthly active users via its digital properties from The Weather Channel (weather.com) and Weather Underground (wunderground.com).   AI Is Part Of How We Work   Human judgment, expertise, and creativity remain essential and are amplified by AI. We expect everyone in this role to use AI thoughtfully and proactively to accelerate their performance, improve the quality of their work, and explore new possibilities. We are looking for people who are curious, adaptable, and excited to help shape an AI-enabled culture that delivers better outcomes for our customers and our company. Weather shapes daily decisions, and your work makes sure users get the information that matters most, right when they need it. You'll join a team that works closely with Product Marketing, Product, Design, and Data, sitting at the center of the user journey to help people understand what to do, why it matters, and how to get more value out of our products over time. You'll own both the strategy and the execution: understanding what users need at each stage, then building the campaign, the trigger logic, and the send yourself. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants equal parts strategic ownership and technical depth, building a lifecycle program that helps millions of people plan their lives around the weather. title: Data Analyst, Value-Based Care Analytics
description:
Counterpart Health is an AI‑powered physician enablement platform that delivers clinical insights to providers at the point of care. Our flagship product, Counterpart Assistant, is embedded into clinicians’ workflows and integrates with EHR systems, helping care teams drive value-based outcomes, close care gaps, and proactively manage chronic disease. As we expand across Medicare Advantage and other value-based care programs, we need analytical talent that can translate complex clinical and financial data into narratives that drive action, for both our internal teams and our payer and provider customers.

You will be part of the analytical engine behind Counterpart Health’s value-based care performance insights. This role sits at the intersection of risk adjustment, quality measurement, utilization management, and cost analytics, and you will be expected to own the metrics that matter most to our payer and provider partners. Beyond the numbers, you are a storyteller: you turn dense claims and clinical data into clear, compelling narratives that help customers understand performance, identify opportunities, and take action. You will work closely with Customer Success, Clinical, and Product teams to ensure our analytics are accurate, trusted, and decision-ready.

As a Data Analyst, you will:

  • Develop customer-facing analytics, reports, and dashboards that surface actionable performance insights for payer and provider partners in a clear, narrative-driven format.

  • Translate complex data findings into executive-ready narratives: written summaries, slide-ready visuals, and structured QBR materials that tell a coherent story about performance and next steps.
  • Conduct deep-dive utilization and cost analyses, including high-cost claimant reviews, avoidable utilization patterns, and specialty/pharmacy spend trends, to identify levers for improvement.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Provider Operations teams to prepare and deliver performance reviews (QBRs, monthly reporting packages) that communicate value and surface priority action areas for each customer.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to validate claims and clinical data pipelines, flag anomalies, and ensure metric consistency across customer populations.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable analytics infrastructure: reusable SQL libraries, metric definitions, and documentation that enable the team to move faster.

title: Senior Customer Support Controls & Governance Program Manager
description:
In the early decades of aviation, flying itself was no longer the hardest problem. The harder challenge was coordination. As air travel scaled, what once relied on intuition and informal communication required entirely new operational systems: structured procedures, clear ownership, control mechanisms, and real-time coordination that could maintain safety without slowing movement. Modern air traffic control didn't exist to restrict progress. It existed to make scale possible.

At Mercury, we're entering a similar phase of evolution.

As we work toward becoming a bank, we're building the operational foundations required to support that transition thoughtfully and responsibly. We're looking for a Senior Customer Support Controls & Governance Program Manager to help design and operationalize the systems, controls, and governance mechanisms that will allow Customer Support to scale into a bank-grade operation without losing the speed, quality, and customer empathy that define Mercury today.

Your first mission will be helping Customer Support deliver one of the most important operational transformations in Mercury's history: preparing the organization for bank charter examinations in early 2027. From there, you'll evolve from leading a critical regulatory program to owning the long-term controls and governance program that ensures Customer Support continues to meet banking* expectations as Mercury grows.

Once that foundation is in place, you'll own the long-term controls and governance program for Customer Support. You'll build the operating mechanisms that ensure we continue meeting regulatory expectations as our products, partnerships, and support organization evolve. title: Senior Software Engineer (Elixir)
description:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join our product teams and help build the next generation of workforce management. This isn't a traditional engineering role - at Sona, engineers are deeply embedded in the product development process, working directly with customers to understand their pain points and turning those insights into shipped solutions.

AI tooling is central to how we work. Coding agents produce the majority of our code, and your job is to direct, correct, and architect - not type every line yourself. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar as a core part of your daily workflow, and we'll assess that proficiency as part of the interview process. To do that well, you need strong Elixir expertise - enough to know when an agent's output is wrong and how to fix it.

Day to day, you'll work within a cross-functional product team with significant autonomy over how to reach outcomes. You'll participate in defining features and scope from PR FAQs and kick-off conversations rather than picking up fully specified tickets. You'll also have the opportunity to rotate across different product domains throughout the year - scheduling, payroll, HR, staff engagement - giving you breadth that most engineering roles don't offer.

This role is remote-first for anyone based in a European timezone, with quarterly in-person team alignment sessions and client workshops in London. It's not a fully isolated remote setup - you'll need flexibility to travel for the moments that matter.

Responsibilities

  • Own features end-to-end across Sona's platform, from scoping through to delivery, including in the mobile app

  • Use AI development tooling as your primary workflow - directing and evaluating agent-

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? title: Condition Monitoring Application Engineer
description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

What's the Opportunity

The primary function of the Condition Monitoring Application Engineer (CMAE) is to support the sales process by providing technical expertise and tribal knowledge to the sales team. As a CMAE you will be a main factor in engineering a solution for our customers with our offerings. This role works closely with sales, the condition monitoring team, and customers. You will:

  • Support solutions architects in the sales process as the subject matter expert in condition monitoring.
  • Establish credibility with customers to encourage higher opportunity-to-trial conversion rates.
  • Ensure high-quality asset lists to enable higher trial-to-subscription rates.
  • Assist in engineering a solution that best fits the needs of the customer.
  • Track the success of the asset review call and provide recommendations to enhance the same.
  • Track and suggest ways to improve the average monitoring point/trial.
  • Acquire extensive expertise in AssetWatch products, encompassing technical aspects, to effectively secure trials that incorporate a diverse range of AssetWatch offerings.
  • Analyze vibration and temperature data at client sites, customizing data processing to the client's asset and determining if maintenance is needed.
  • Attend tradeshows to assist the sales team with technical knowledge and lead capture.
  • Evaluate machinery health and condition through the detailed analysis of vibration data.
  • Expand AssetWatch's expertise in machine condition monitoring, beyond vibration analysis, to include other condition-monitoring technologies.
  • Work closely with the product development team to create high-value hardware and software solutions and expanded product offerings.
  • Provide high-quality, actionable information to clients (e.g., setting appropriate alarm levels with analytical tools, to alert customers of pending failures).

Qualifications

  • Strong communication skills and ability to discover pain points for the customer and drive towards a solution.
  • Valid Vibration Category II, MLA/MLT Certifications preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience with vibration data collection and analysis.
  • Strong mechanical background with industrial equipment — centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, hydraulics, pneumatics, etc.

Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Building AI agents that can assist with any kind of enterprise work is a challenging, open-ended problem. We build many of these reinforcement learning (RL) environments, then drop our agents into them to evaluate or train them.

In this role, you are responsible for creating these RL environments, running AI agents inside them, and improving both the agents and the environments in the process. The results reach customers, whose feedback feeds back in - and the agent/environment improvement loop continues.

title: Product Owner - momox Product Catalog (m/f/d)

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to take ownership of the momox Product Catalog (MPC) - our central catalog system and single source of truth for product master data.   • Data Quality & Product Matching: Improve product matching across identifiers and ensure validity and correctness of product data and attributes
  • Internationalization & Localization: Scale catalogue coverage and multi-language enrichment to support European expansion including relevant regulatory logic
  • Analytics & Monitoring: Further develop and maintain product catalogue monitoring and reporting to track catalogue health

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.  That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:  you own the release gate.  If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.  That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks  like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.  You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.  Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.  What You'll Own    The release gate: One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.  API test automation: Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.  End-to-end front-end automation: Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.  AI-driven test generation and maintenance: Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point.  Failure triage that arrives with an answer: When the gate goes red, the team should get the failing assertion, the diff or deploy most likely responsible, and a first hypothesis — not a link to a log. Curate what they are told: the shared testing skills, patterns, and guardrails that decide what gets tested, at what level, and how. When something is missed, get the reasoning back into the shared skills, gates and patterns so the next feature starts better than the last. This role requires occasional travel based on business needs.  Main responsibilities & tasks:  AI engineers play a crucial role in developing and implementing AI based solutions. You have in-depth knowledge of computerized system validation and are familiar with EU GMP, FDA requirements, and industry standards governing GxP-relevant IT systems, combined with practical experience supporting validation projects, quality management systems, and regulated IT environments. You are a collaborative leader who communicates effectively across Quality, IT, and business functions and are comfortable advising stakeholders on complex compliance matters. You are comfortable engaging with stakeholders at all organizational levels and have demonstrated success influencing cross-functional decision-making in complex environments. Your strong analytical and problem-solving skills enable you to make sound decisions while balancing compliance, risk, and business needs. On a personal level, you are structured, quality-focused, and able to combine a pragmatic approach to problem-solving while maintaining a strategic mindset, enabling you to balance regulatory compliance with business needs in an increasingly digital environment. title: Seksjonsleder Test og Kvalitet
description: Om oss   I Bane NOR har vi ett felles mål – å sette spor vi er stolte av, som kan drive samfunnet fremover. Derfor jobber vi hver dag med å utvikle og forvalte løsninger som bidrar til en trygg, effektiv og bærekraftig jernbane.  Det er kanskje ikke alle som vet hvor mye teknologi som ligger bak norsk jernbane. Hver dag støtter digitale løsninger alt fra trafikkstyring og kapasitetsplanlegging til kundeinformasjon og operative prosesser. Dette er tjenester som er avgjørende for at togtrafikken skal fungere sikkert og effektivt.  For å lykkes trenger vi sterke fagmiljøer og dyktige ledere. Nå søker vi en leder for Test og Kvalitet som vil være med på å styrke et viktig fagområde og bidra til at Bane NOR fortsetter å levere stabile og fremtidsrettede digitale løsninger.  Vil du lede og videreutvikle test- og kvalitetsfaget i Bane NOR?  Som leder for Test og Kvalitet får du personalansvar for et fagmiljø på rundt 13 medarbeidere med kompetanse innen testledelse, testautomatisering, kvalitetssikring og testfaglig rådgivning.  Du får en viktig rolle i å videreutvikle test- og kvalitetsområdet i Bane NOR. Sammen med medarbeidere, leverandører og øvrige fagmiljøer skal du bidra til at vi utvikler og kvalitetssikrer digitale løsninger som er avgjørende for norsk jernbane.  Vi ser etter deg som kombinerer god faglig forståelse med trygt lederskap. Du vet hva som skal til for å utvikle mennesker, bygge fagmiljøer og sikre høy kvalitet i leveransene.  Dette er en rolle for deg som ønsker å kombinere personalledelse med faglig utvikling og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring på tvers av organisasjonen.   Om rollen   Som leder for Test og Kvalitet får du ansvar for et etablert fagmiljø som spiller en sentral rolle i utviklingen og forvaltningen av Bane NORs digitale tjenester.  Du vil ha ansvar for medarbeidere som arbeider med testledelse, testgjennomføring, testautomatisering, kvalitetssikring og testfaglig rådgivning på tvers av produkter, prosjekter og tjenester.  Rollen kombinerer personalledelse, faglig utvikling og forbedringsarbeid. Du skal sikre at test- og kvalitetsområdet utvikler seg i takt med virksomhetens behov, samtidig som du bidrar til å videreutvikle metoder, standarder og beste praksis innen test og kvalitetssikring.   Om fagområdet   Test og kvalitet er en sentral del av Bane NORs digitale leveranser.  Fagområdet bidrar til at løsningene som understøtter trafikkstyring, kapasitetsplanlegging, kundeinformasjon, logistikk, operative prosesser og andre samfunnskritiske funksjoner holder høy kvalitet og fungerer som forventet.  Vi har ambisjoner om å videreutvikle testområdet gjennom moderne arbeidsformer, økt grad av automatisering, sterkere faglige fellesskap og tydelige standarder for kvalitetssikring på tvers av organisasjonen.  Som leder får du en viktig rolle i å drive denne utviklingen videre.   Arbeidsoppgaver   Som seksjonsleder for Test og Kvalitet vil du:    Lede og utvikle et fagmiljø med rundt 13 medarbeidere innen test og kvali

title: Head of Quality Assurance
description: Head of Software Quality Assurance   Milton Keynes or Manchester - 2 days in office per week      If you believe quality should be built into software from day one – not tested in at the end – this could be where you transform an entire engineering culture.      What’s in it for you   You’ll have the opportunity to  reshape how software quality works across a major technology organisation .     Instead of maintaining the status quo, you’ll lead the move from  traditional testing to modern quality engineering , embedding automation, continuous testing and “shift-left” thinking across multiple delivery teams.     You’ll influence how  over 50 QA professionals  work today — and how quality evolves across a broader engineering ecosystem including strategic delivery partners.     And because this is a senior, cross-cutting role reporting directly into technology leadership, your decisions won’t sit in PowerPoint decks. They’ll shape  how software gets delivered across the entire organisation .      What you’ll be doing (and why you’ll enjoy it)   You’ll build and lead a  modern Quality Engineering practice  that works across multiple delivery teams and product portfolios.     Your focus will be on embedding quality into the development lifecycle — helping teams move from  manual testing towards automation-first, built-in quality  while still being pragmatic about different team maturity levels.     Day to day you’ll:   Lead and develop  QA and test professionals across multiple teams and locations   Create a  cross-cutting community of practice  that unifies standards, capability and career development  Define and deliver a  Quality Engineering strategy  that promotes shift-left testing and continuous testing  Partner with  product, architecture and delivery leaders  to embed quality early in design and development  Drive smarter use of  test automation and CI/CD pipelines   Use data and metrics to improve quality outcomes and delivery speed  Align internal teams and delivery partners around the  metrics that matter  — defect leakage, cycle time, automation coverage and more      You’ll also play a key leadership role in shaping the wider engineering organisation — helping break down silos and build a shared identity across software teams.      Where you’ll be doing it   You’ll join a technology organisation undergoing a  major transformation in how it builds and delivers software .     There’s real momentum behind modern engineering practices — but like many large organisations, maturity levels vary across teams. That’s where you come in.     You’ll help unify different delivery approaches (including SAFe, Scrumban and hybrid agile models) and bring a pragmatic, coaching-led approach to improving quality across the board.     It’s a rare opportunity to  influence culture, capability and engineering outcomes at scale . title: Quality Assurance Lead
description: Job Title:  QA Lead   Reports to:  Engineering Manager, SRE & QA   Location:  Ireland (remote)   Purpose   We are hiring a QA Lead who starts hands-on to run our QA team day to day. You will be embedded in one pod as a Quality Engineer, the same as the rest of the team, and you will also lead that team: three Quality Engineers report to you. You are the connection between the Engineering Manager and the QA team. The Engineering Manager sets quality strategy and direction. You turn it into day-to-day practice, feed the team's reality back up, and carry the operational load of goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and reviewing your team's work. You stay hands-on and technical throughout.  Most of your quality leverage is upstream. Our pods spec features in depth and hand them to coding agents that build the feature and its tests together. Inside your pod you are the advocate, not the executor: the voice asking the awkward questions, pushing the failure modes nobody thought of, and making sure the spec and our shared testing skills are good enough that the agent produces the right tests, at the right level, catching the right things. Expect to be hands-on early while that foundation is still thin. Expect that to reduce deliberately over time as the skills sharpen and the pod's own quality thinking matures.   Key Responsibilities     QA Team Leadership:  Lead the three Quality Engineers who report to you. Set their goals, run their performance reviews, coach them day to day, and review their work. You are the senior voice they turn to on what good looks like and what to do next, and the first escalation point when they are stuck.   Spec-Time Advocacy:  Be in the room while the pod specs a feature, before any code exists. Ask the awkward questions, push the edge cases and failure modes nobody has thought of, and hold the line that acceptance criteria are testable and traceable. A vague spec produces vague tests, so this is where most of your quality leverage lives.   Agentic Test Quality:  Our coding agents write most of our tests. Curate what they are told: the shared testing skills, patterns, and guardrails that decide what gets tested, at what level, and how. Verify the output is load bearing using mutation testing, rather than assuming a green suite means a covered feature.   Coaching & Culture:  Focus on coaching over absorbing workload. Review the tests that arrive with a pull request, whether a developer or an agent wrote them, asking probing questions to ensure they prove meaningful outcomes. You raise the developers' ceiling by mentoring them on test efficacy.   Fold Back and Compound:  A lesson that only lands in one spec is a lesson we pay for twice. When something is missed, get the reasoning back into the shared skills, gates and patterns so the next feature starts better than the last. This is what makes the role shrink rather than grow: every fold-back reduces how much intervention the next feature needs from you.

title: QA Lead
description: We’re Heidi.  We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.  Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.  We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.  If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.   About The Role   We ship atoms daily. Two million patient visits a week run through what we ship, and a clinician mid-shift has no appetite for our bugs.  This role owns quality at Heidi. Not as a gate at the end, but as the thing that lets every engineer here ship fast and be right. You'll decide what good testing looks like across our stack, build the frameworks and infrastructure that make writing a good test the easy path, and make deploying to production a boring, verifiable event rather than an act of faith.  You'll lead the QA function and stay in the code while you do it. Release management sits inside this role, because the person who understands the risk should be the person who decides it's safe   What You’ll Do     Own the testing strategy across Heidi's stack, from web and mobile to our AI pipelines and EHR-connected enterprise deployments, and make deliberate calls about what belongs in unit tests, what needs integration coverage, what only a real end-to-end run will catch and what we're better off detecting in production.   Choose and build the frameworks. You'll select the tooling, write the harnesses and fixtures, and get our test suites to the point where engineers reach for them because they're fast and reliable rather than because a policy says so.   Make deployment safe by design. Quality gates in CI/CD, staged rollouts, canaries, feature flags and rollback paths that get exercised before anyone needs them, so a bad change is caught by the pipeline instead of by a clinic.   Raise the testing bar across the engineering team through code review, pairing and documentation, so quality is something every engineer owns rather than something they hand to you.   Own the quality signal end to end: escaped defect rate, change failure rate and time to detect, alongside the DORA metrics we already run on. You'll be the person who can say what our real quality is, with evidence.   Run release readiness and go/no-go, weighing coverage, change size, dependency risk

description: Om Magma    Magma är ett av världens snabbast växande och mest omtalade edtech-bolag – och förändrar matematikundervisningen, med kraften i AI. Vi tar oss an en av de största utmaningarna i utbildningsvärlden: att för många elever kämpar med matematik. När var femte elev globalt har svårt för ett ämne som är avgörande för framtida studier och karriärer, vet vi att möjligheten att göra verklig skillnad är enorm.  Vi är redan det självklara valet för tusentals huvudmän och kommuner – och resan har bara börjat. När vi nu växer snabbt i USA och Europa (nu även i Tyskland!) bygger vi ett team som delar vår ambition och vårt driv: att hjälpa miljontals elever att låsa upp sin fulla potential i matematik. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara skicklig på att skapa förtroendefulla relationer på alla olika nivåer i en organisation och kunna navigera mellan olika behov, perspektiv och beslutsfattare. Du ligger steget före genom att förstå kundernas utmaningar, identifierar möjligheter och proaktivt driver deras fortsatta utveckling och framgång med Magma.  Du arbetar allra närmast våra kunder och förväntas därför ha djup kunskap om både produkten och hur den skapar värde i praktiken. Det ställer höga krav på din tekniska förståelse, analytiska skärpa och problemlösningsförmåga. Du ansvarar för den löpande kontakten med våra partners och driver implementering, utbildningsinsatser och andra initiativ för att säkerställa att vi stöttar varje partner på bästa sätt. Du har daglig kontakt med skolledare och lärare och besöker regelbundet klassrum, vilket ger dig en unik förståelse för hur Magma används och vilken impact produkten faktiskt har. Du kommer även att stå inför större grupper och förväntas kunna presentera tydligt, övertygande och engagerande. Rollen kräver att du är utåtriktad, nyfiken och ansvarstagande, har ett starkt driv och trivs med att driva flera komplexa projekt parallellt. Du är kundernas röst internt och behöver kunna konkretisera och värdera deras behov och feedback, omvandla dem till tydliga insikter och kommunicera dem med hög precision till resten av organisationen. Je hebt op strategisch niveau het juiste gesprek met de klant over asset management en zet samen met de business kansen om naar concrete opdrachten. Je gaat open gesprekken voeren over tevredenheid, haalt de vraag achter de vraag op en vertaalt dit naar concrete vervolgstappen. Daarmee ligt jouw focus op de verbreding van ons dienstenportfolio bij onze klanten. Stimuleren van accountgroei: Behoeften en veranderingen in de klantorganisatie herkennen en vertalen naar passende oplossingen en uitbreiding van het serviceportfolio.   Bewust “good to knows”, best practices en innovaties uit de markt meenemen naar klanten (en vice versa terug de organisatie in).   Leads en opportunities vastleggen in CRM, sturen op voortgang en zorgen voor een scherpe overdracht van lead → opportunity → business/delivery.   Intern afstemmen met de business en waar nodig marketing; zorgen dat de organisatie levert wat is beloofd en leert van klantfeedback.     Waar je komt te werken  Bij Haskoning kom je te werken bij een onafhankelijk adviesbureau dat ingenieurs-, ontwerp- en adviesdiensten combineert met software en technologie. Onze missie, “Enhancing Society Together" drijft ons om een positieve impact op de wereld te creëren.  Wij bieden uitdagend werk in diverse internationale projecten, waarbij we gebruik maken van onze 140+ jaar aan expertise. Met meer dan 6.800 medewerkers in meer dan 25 landen zetten we samen uitdagingen om in kansen om zo een positieve impact op de samenleving te maken. We werken samen met toonaangevende klanten in markten zoals infrastructuur, klimaatbestendigheid, hernieuwbare energie, decarbonisatie van de industrie en duurzame mobiliteit. title: Key Account Manager
description: Locatie: Randstad / Amsterdam | 32–40 uur     Wil jij commerciële verantwoordelijkheid combineren met inhoudelijke impact?     Bij LTP werk je op het snijvlak van psychologie, data en organisatievraagstukken. Je bouwt aan strategische klantrelaties en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete oplossingen die echt verschil maken.      Inzicht met impact   LTP is een toonaangevend psychologisch adviesbureau en marktleider in assessments. We combineren wetenschappelijke expertise met datagedreven oplossingen. Al bijna 100 jaar helpen we organisaties bij het nemen van betere beslissingen over talent en ontwikkeling.     We werken voor grote organisaties in zowel de publieke als private sector. Onze dienstverlening varieert van assessments en feedbackprogramma’s tot leiderschapstrajecten en teamontwikkeling, ondersteund door data en de nieuwste technologieën, zoals ons AI-powered assessment (ChatLab) of onze assessmentgame Frenzy Fest.     Onze ambitie is helder: organisaties beter laten functioneren door mensen beter te begrijpen.      Jouw rol   Als Medior Key Accountmanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor een eigen portefeuille met strategische waarde. Je verdiept bestaande klantrelaties en bouwt deze gericht verder uit.  Je kent je klanten goed, hun context, stakeholders en opgaven, en vertaalt dit naar passende (maatwerk)oplossingen. Daarbij treed je op als regisseur van de klantrelatie: je verbindt interne expertise aan klantvragen en zorgt dat we consistent kwaliteit leveren én blijven verrassen.  Je beweegt je zelfstandig op operationeel en tactisch niveau en ontwikkelt je richting een senior rol, met toenemende verantwoordelijkheid voor accountstrategie, commerciële groei en stakeholdermanagement.      Wat ga je doen    Je ontwikkelt en realiseert accountplannen gericht op duurzame groei en klantwaarde  Je legt nieuwe contacten en bouwt relaties op met stakeholders op verschillende niveaus en ontwikkelt deze richting strategisch partnerschap  Je signaleert en realiseert commerciële kansen (cross- en upsell)  Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner en adviseur voor klanten, ook buiten concrete opdrachten  Je regisseert de samenwerking rondom de klant en zorgt voor een sterke verbinding met interne teams  Je borgt klanttevredenheid, voortgang, kwaliteit en resultaat  Je gebruikt klantdata en marktontwikkelingen om proactief met relevante voorstellen te komen (“verrassen naast leveren”)  Je draagt bij aan verbetering van proposities, processen en klantbenadering       Wie ben jij?   Je combineert commerciële scherpte met inhoudelijke interesse. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar de klant en durft door te vragen. Je bouwt makkelijk relaties op en weet deze ook zakelijk te ontwikkelen.     Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:   Je denkt analytisch en vertaalt vraagstukken naar concrete oplossingen  Je ziet commerciële kansen en neemt initiatief om deze te benutten  Je bent organisatiesensitief, evenwichtig en schakelt makkelijk tussen stakeholders  Je werkt

description: Als führendes Handelsunternehmen transformiert OBI den DIY-Sektor. Unser Bereich Digital Platform schafft die Grundlage für ein nahtloses Omnichannel-Erlebnis. Im Zentrum steht unsere Abteilung Customer Management, deren Aufgabe es ist, unsere Kund:innen über alle Touchpoints hinweg in ihren Projekten und Kundenphasen zu begleiten und so den Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) strategisch zu optimieren.  Zur erfolgreichen, internationalen Umsetzung dieser Wachstumsstrategie suchen wir Dich als Customer Lifecycle Manager in unserem Team. Als Designer der Customer Journey entwickelst du das Gerüst für unsere internationalen CRM-Aktivitäten. Du überführst Kundenbedürfnisse vom Onboarding bis zum komplexen Projekt in Erlebnisse, die nachhaltige Kundenbindung schaffen. description: This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth.  As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025, 2024 and 2023, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.  At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada. Du lernst nicht Theorie, sondern Handwerk: wie man Kunden liest, wie man Argumente baut, die überzeugen, wie man aus Recherche eine klare Empfehlung macht

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description: At AppWork, we’ve built a simple, user-friendly PropTech platform that modernizes maintenance operations. Our platform brings everything into one easy-to-use platform so property managers, maintenance teams, and residents can all enjoy a smoother, more connected experience.  As a member of the AppWork team, you’ll be helping to build and deliver technology that solves real problems, makes communities run better, and creates happier teams and residents.   About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to help us ship our product to customers reliably, across three surfaces: web application portal that property managers and executives use every day, a mobile app that maintenance techs depend on in the field, and APIs that keep everything in sync.  You will build and own automated test coverage across web, mobile, and API, and work closely with engineers across AppWork's R&D squads to catch issues before they ever reach a customer. This is a senior, hands-on role: you'll plan and execute AppWork’s automation strategy.   What You'll Do     Design, build, and maintain automated test suites across our Web Portal (web), the Technician App (iOS and Android, including offline scenarios), and AppWork's backend APIs.  Partner with engineers across AppWork's R&D squads, covering maintenance operations, resident experience, and core infrastructure, to build testability into new features from day one.  Identify gaps in test coverage and prioritize automation work based on risk, usage, and customer impact rather than testing everything equally.  Investigate and reproduce bugs, document them clearly for engineering, and verify fixes before release, using automation.  Maintain and improve CI/CD test pipelines so failures are caught quickly and are easy to diagnose.  Test AppWork's integrations to confirm work orders and unit status sync correctly in both directions.  Contribute to test strategy for AppWork's growing AI features.  Champion quality across the team by advocating for testable designs, clear acceptance criteria, and a strong regression safety net as AppWork scales.     Qualifications     5+ years of experience in QA automation, with a track record of building and maintaining automated test suites from scratch.  Hands-on experience testing web applications and REST APIs.  Comfortable reading and writing code (JavaScript/TypeScript or similar) to build, debug, and maintain test automation.  Experience with modern test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines (for example Playwright, Cypress, Postman, and GitHub Actions, or equivalent tools).  A strong instinct for risk: you know which parts of a system need the deepest coverage and which can rely on lighter checks.  A clear communicator who can write bug reports and test plans that both engineers and non-technical stakeholders can follow. title: Local Tester - Qatari Nationality
description: Company Description  BlackNGreen is a global AI solutions provider focused on transforming how enterprises leverage artificial intelligence to solve complex business challenges. Since 2010, the company has grown into a team of over 350 professionals, serving 160+ clients across more than 100 countries in sectors such as Telecom, Banking, Government, Insurance, E‑commerce, and Travel. BlackNGreen has launched impactful products including Magic Voice, MobiBattle, SmartConnect AI, and Call Signature, which have redefined customer engagement for billions of users. Its latest innovation, EVA, is an end‑to‑end AI‑managed service that automates up to 83% of customer care interactions and can significantly reduce operational costs while delivering seamless, personalized support at scale. In this role, the Tester will design and execute test cases, perform functional, regression, and integration testing, and validate new features and enhancements across AI-powered products such as EVA. The Tester will log, track, and re-test defects, collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts, and help ensure that releases meet quality and performance standards.
