Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking tools, and familiarity with documenting test plans, test scenarios, and test reports.  Ability to analyze requirements and user journeys, identify edge cases, and validate end-to-end workflows in complex, enterprise-scale systems.  Exposure to automation testing tools or scripting (e.g., Selenium, REST API testing, or equivalent) is an advantage.  Understanding of telecom, banking, insurance, or customer care domains is beneficial, especially for testing AI-driven conversational solutions.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.  Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams and provide clear, actionable feedback.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Every reformer, tower, and accessory that leaves our Sacramento facility carries a promise to studios and instructors around the world — and we're looking for the person who makes sure that promise never breaks.  Who We Are  Balanced Body has been the world's leading manufacturer of premium Pilates equipment since 1976. We're headquartered right here in Sacramento, California, and we build more than equipment — we build the tools that help people move better, feel better, and enjoy their lives more. That mission starts on our production floor, and it depends on the quality of everything we ship.  What You'll Do  This is a newly consolidated role — and a rare chance to build something from the ground up. Today, quality lives in pieces: incoming inspection here, in-process checks there, supplier quality somewhere else. We're bringing it all under one leader. As our Quality Manager, you'll be the single owner of quality across the entire flow, from the supplier's dock to the customer's door, turning quality decisions from one-off fire drills into a disciplined, criteria-driven system.  You'll be the voice of the customer inside our factory. Your standard isn't "does it match the drawing" — it's "would the customer be proud to own this."  Especially in year one, this is hands-on work. You'll be on the floor inspecting parts, writing the standards yourself, and working supplier floors directly — not just directing a team to do it. This is a player-coach role, not a seat where you lead exclusively through managers.  What You'll Own    Customer-facing quality: complaints, field failures, and warranty claims route through you — 8D reports, corrective actions, and closing the loop from field data back to the factory floor.  Standards and decisions: author the written acceptance criteria for every part family, chair the Material Review Board, and give inspectors and technicians a clear, consistent rulebook to work from.  The QMS: drive QT9 as a living system — CAPA pipeline, non-conforming product trends, audit readiness — and build the dashboard leadership actually looks at: cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, rework by supplier.  Supplier quality: one end-to-end process from supplier quality agreements through first article and incoming inspection, with structured improvement programs for your highest-impact suppliers. Most of our roughly 1,200 suppliers are small, local shops with little or no formal quality system — you'll spend real time on their floors helping them build the processes and controls they don't have yet, not just auditing against ones they already do. About the Team

At DoorDash, our mission is to empower local economies by providing innovative technology solutions that make it easier for customers, merchants, and Dashers to connect. We are seeking a Senior Software Asset Manager to join our Global IT team and help drive our software asset management (SAM) initiatives worldwide.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented IT Software Asset Manager to oversee the lifecycle management, optimization, governance, and operational support of enterprise SaaS and AI software platforms. This role will be responsible for managing software licensing, vendor relationships, access governance, cost optimization, and renewal support across a rapidly evolving software ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational execution with analytical and vendor management skills and has hands-on experience with SaaS administration, software asset management (SAM), identity/access management tools, and enterprise procurement processes.

  • Track and communicate realized cost savings and optimization initiatives.

title: Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and skilled Software Engineer to join our Geo Information Systems team – Supply Division. We build and operate an end-to-end platform that ingests, processes, and visualizes real-time vehicle and ride data, providing valuable insights to both customers and internal users. 

You'll work on some of Flix's most visible products, building backend services that process large scale streaming data and power real time experiences for millions of passengers every day. title: Machine Learning Platform Engineer
description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

About the Role

As an ML Platform Engineer, you will build the infrastructure and systems that power A1's AI capabilities.

You will design and operate the systems behind the AI stack, from model training and evaluation to deployment, inference, observability, and continuous improvement.

You will work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and product engineers to turn models into reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient production systems. You will build the platforms, tooling, and infrastructure that enable the team to experiment quickly and bring AI capabilities to production with confidence.

Focus

  • Build and operate the ML infrastructure and platforms powering A1’s AI products

  • Design systems for model training, evaluation, deployment, inference, and experimentation

  • Build and optimise model serving and inference infrastructure for high-throughput and low-latency workloads

title: Senior Software Engineer, Production Suite
description: About Six Robotics   At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.  We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.  At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits and always be sharpening your blade, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.   About The Role   We are setting up a new team to build our Production Suite: the software product that gets our autonomy platform onto new drone hardware. This is not about assembling the physical drone. It is about everything that has to happen in software once the hardware is built, so a finished drone leaves production running on our stack.  As we move toward supporting production volumes in the thousands, installing our software on a new platform needs to become a high quality workflow someone runs at the production site, not something that pulls on engineering capacity per unit. Production Suite is how we get there.  It ships alongside each new release of our autonomy stack and wraps installation, configuration, acceptance testing, and sign-off into a guided flow.  The work is less about deep architecture and more about getting a lot of moving parts to work together cleanly: software packaging, deployment to edge devices, test automation, Linux plumbing, and an operator experience reliable enough that a non-engineer at a production site can run it on their own.  We are looking for several engineers to join this team early. As one of the first in, you will help shape what we build and how we build it. You will have a broad responsibility from low-level flashing and test orchestration up to the interface the production operator actually interacts with.   What You Will Do     Build the Production Suite: a software package that ships to a production site and takes a drone from factory-fresh hardware to a unit running our autonomy stack and passing acceptance  Design and implement the tooling that flashes our software onto new drone platforms, configures it, runs factory acceptance tests, and reports results back to Operatio

title: Senior QA Engineer, Message Squad
description: Diabolocom builds AI-first, cloud-native contact center infrastructure designed for high availability, low latency, and global scale. As both a software provider and a telecom operator, we combine a fully owned carrier-grade voice backbone with a programmable CCaaS platform that supports real-time, high-volume communications across 60+ countries. This ensures we maintain a   user-centric perspective  , influence implementation details when necessary, and distribute test coverage responsibilities among QA, frontend, and backend teams.        You will:    Co-design test strategies with the team for new features and refactorings.   Implement and maintain automated tests in Kotlin at multiple levels.   Challenge designs and technical solutions from a risk

title: Account-Based Marketing Manager
description:
For years, account-based marketing at Fresh Prints has been built around campaigns. We identify an opportunity, launch a program, measure the results, and rebuild the approach the following year. That is no longer enough.

Our highest-value accounts should not be managed as a series of campaigns. They need a long-term growth strategy: a clear view of which accounts deserve disproportionate investment, what will materially change their value, and how Fresh Prints should serve, retain, and expand them over time. Your job will be to build that strategy.

You will bring together customer insights, data, segmentation, and operational execution to determine where the biggest account growth opportunities exist and what the business must do to capture them. The goal is to build an account-growth system that becomes more intelligent, more effective, and more valuable with every cycle.

There is no established function to inherit and no finished playbook to manage. You will define what account-based marketing should mean for Fresh Prints, build the operating model behind it, and drive the business to execute against it across Marketing, Sales, Creative, Data, and Operations.

We are not looking for someone who will optimize the existing approach at the margins. We are looking for someone who will question its assumptions, identify the few bets that could materially change account value, and take responsibility for turning those bets into results.

This role is about:

  • Defining how Fresh Prints grows and retains its most valuable accounts at the company level, not simply running better campaigns.
  • Building an account strategy that continues to work as chapters, decision-makers, relationships, and buying cycles change.
  • Identifying the few highest-leverage bets that could materially increase account value, then focusing the business around them.
  • Turning strategy into execution through direct ownership, cross-functional influence, and systems that scale.
  • Shaping how Marketing, Sales, Operations, and account-facing teams approach retention, expansion, and long-term account development.
  • Building account growth into a durable business capability, not an initiative that resets every campaign cycle.

What You'll Own

Company-Level Account Strategy

  • Build the long-term growth strategy for Fresh Prints’ highest-value accounts.
  • Define how the business should identify, segment, prioritise, invest in, retain, and expand those accounts over time.
  • Develop a strategy that remains effective even as student leaders, decision-makers, buying committees, and internal account owners change.
  • Use customer insight, account data, and commercial judgment to identify the few opportunities that could materially change account value across the business.
  • Shape decisions across sales

In our mission toward powering careers through tech education, we are doubling down on the support that we offer to our students. As a part of this, we are looking for experienced AI professionals to mentor learners enrolled in our business-focused AI programs.

Required skills/qualifications:

  • Familiarity with generative AI (LLMs, RAG, tool use, evaluation) and/or agent-based systems.
  • Solid understanding of model evaluation and how data quality impacts outcomes.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders or senior leadership.

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Serving 2,000+ Distinct Ad Experiences With Sub-Second Time to Interactive

The rewarded ad experience is where the value exchange becomes real, the second a user decides whether to engage or scroll past. The Catalog team owns that moment, designing how users discover and interact with the most relevant ads. With over 200 million monthly visits, there's no room for slow rendering or poor personalization. Performance and relevance have to be perfect on every request.

The system runs on AWS Spot Instances spare compute capacity that can disappear at any moment, yet our system is built to stay online without any interruption for the user. Backed by Kubernetes with event-driven autoscaling, everything is tuned for millisecond-level data retrieval so the experience never feels slow, even at 200 million monthly visits. The frontend is built on React and Vite, leveraging Code Splitting and Tree Shaking to keep core bundles lean and Time to Interactive under a second. On top of that, a config-driven engine lets the team customize the entire ad experience or run A/B experiments per more than 2000 games on the fly, ensuring the right ad reaches the right user while continuously moving conversion rates in the right direction.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Java / Kotlin)

Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Legacy banking and payment infrastructure struggles to support the demands of today's low-volume, high-velocity payouts, leading to inefficiencies in global payouts. This role will be building with Java and Kotlin, leaning heavily on event-driven architectures to move money reliably at scale. Services will run in containers on EKS, backed by both SQL and NoSQL databases on AWS.

title: Software Test & Validation Engineer
description: About Us   Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.  Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.   About The Role   As a  Software Test & Validation Engineer , you build the systems that let us trust our drones' software before it ever flies a mission. You design the automated tests and pipelines that put our flight software through its paces, from pure simulation (SITL) to hardware-in-the-loop (HITL), and turn the results into clear signal for the engineering teams. Our validation team is scaling fast, from testing a handful of drones to testing them by the hundred, and you are how that scale becomes possible.  Your main instrument is the SITL/HITL simulation environment built by our tooling team. A big part of the job is to use it to its full potential and to help improve it continuously: it's recent and not yet fully representative of reality, so your feedback and contributions are what will make it a trustworthy test bench. On top of that, new systems to validate arrive on a regular basis, so you'll repeatedly stand up test coverage for platforms you're seeing for the first time.  This is a broad role, and we're deliberately hiring for a range of profiles rather than a single narrow one. We're looking for engineers with scope beyond pure software, system-level thinking, a feel for architecture, a statistical approach to noisy data, and some physical intuition. Depending on your strengths, you might focus on test-scenario design and coverage, on the automation and CI pipeline that runs tests on every build, on capturing and replaying flight telemetry, or on deepening the simulation itself. Tell us in your application where you fit best.   What you'll do   (the mix depends on your profile, you won't do all of it)     Test design & content: Define the scenarios that catch real bugs, decide what to measure, and turn noisy flight metrics into stable, meaningful pass/fail and regression signals.  Drive and improve the SITL/HITL environment: Use the tooling team's simulation bench as your primary test instrument, push it hard, and feed back concrete improvements to make it more representative, models, scenarios, missing capabilities.  Automation & tooling: Write clean Python tools to load, parse and analyse test outputs, detect regressions, and produce reports the engineering teams act on.  CI/CD integration: Integrate simulation and hardware tests into the continuous-integration pipeline so every new build is validated automatically, fast, and reproducibly.  Onboard n

title: Utvecklare till testautomationsteamet på Handelsbanken
description: Vill du vara med och utveckla Handelsbankens gemensamma lösningar för testautomation? Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg inom moderna test- och prestandalösningar. Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk spets med samarbete och påverkan i hela organisationen.   Ditt team   Ditt team är Handelsbankens Center of Excellence för testautomation och ansvarar för verktyg och lösningar inom både testautomatisering och prestandatestning.  I teamet arbetar utvecklare och testspecialister tillsammans under ledning av en engagerad produktägare. Vi har ett nära samarbete och löser utmaningar gemensamt för att säkerställa hög kvalitet och effektivitet i bankens utvecklingsarbete.  Teamet är en del av DEVX-tåget, Handelsbanken Development Platform. Vårt mål är att bygga en stark intern utvecklingsplattform efter användarnas behov som ger utvecklingsteamen möjlighet att fokusera på att skapa affärsvärde.   Din roll   Kärnan i rollen är att vidareutveckla bankens gemensamma lösningar för testautomation och prestandatest tillsammans med teamet. Teamet ansvarar för utveckling, förvaltning och förbättring av testverktyg och testinfrastruktur som används av flera utvecklingsteam inom banken.  Rollen kombinerar teknisk utveckling med kunskapsdelning och nära samarbete med andra team. Samtidigt är rollen under fortsatt utveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att påverka både lösningar, arbetssätt och framtida fokusområden.  Dina arbetsuppgifter varierar och kan bland annat omfatta att:    Utveckla och vidareutveckla gemensamma verktyg, ramverk och lösningar för testautomation  Hantera livscykeln för våra verktyg och plattformskomponenter  Ta fram exempelkod, guider och återanvändbara lösningar för utvecklingsteamen  Stötta team genom utbildningar, vägledning och kunskapsdelning kring våra verktyg och arbetssätt  Bevaka omvärlden och utvärdera nya tekniker, trender och verktyg     Din profil   Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av IT-utveckling, där du under de senaste åren har arbetat med objektorienterad programmering i JavaScript samt verktyg och arbetssätt som Git, CI/CD-pipelines och DevOps. Erfarenhet av teknisk testning, ReadyAPI, TestCafe, API-utveckling eller IT-säkerhet ses som meriterande.  Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta i team, där vi stöttar varandra och delar kunskap för att nå gemensamma mål. Du tar ansvar, arbetar självständigt och driver proaktivt fram lösningar.  Du kommunicerar tydligt och lättförståeligt på svenska och engelska både i tal som skrift då rollen innebär många kontaktytor med andra utvecklingsteam och presentationer och föreläsningar.   Välkommen med din ansökan!   Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.  Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handel

title: DevOps Engineer
description: We are looking for a  DevOps Engineer  to join Teleste's Public Safety and Mobility business. In this role, you'll help develop and improve the tools, automation, and environments that enable our software teams to build, test, secure, and deliver high-quality solutions efficiently and reliably.  This is not just a maintenance role. You will play an important part in shaping how software is delivered across teams, working closely with developers, QA specialists, architects, security experts, and Operational Excellence stakeholders.  What you'll do    Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Jenkins-based environments  Improve software build, test, release, and delivery automation  Support Linux-based development infrastructure and shared development tools  Administer and develop Jira workflows and automations  Improve software delivery reliability, traceability, and security  Help development teams solve tooling and delivery challenges  Contribute to DevOps roadmap and continuous improvement initiatives    What we're looking for    Experience with Jenkins and CI/CD environments  Strong understanding of DevOps practices and software delivery automation  Linux administration skills  Experience with Jira administration and automation  Familiarity with scripting (Python, Bash, Groovy, Go or similar)  Understanding of Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Ansible  Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills    Why join us?  You'll have a direct impact on how software is delivered across an international technology company whose solutions are used daily in public transport systems around the world. We offer a collaborative environment, opportunities to shape our DevOps capabilities, and the chance to work on meaningful technology that supports safer and smarter mobility.   Got interested?   If this sounds like the next step for you, send us your application and CV latest on 5th of September 2026. We review candidates throughout the process and will be in touch as soon as possible.  More information about the role from Juha Lintula (@teleste.com)   At Teleste Public Safety and Mobility, we develop technology that helps millions of people move safely and smoothly every day. Our solutions are used in trains, metros and public transport systems across the world, where reliability is not a nice-to-have but a requirement.   Teleste offers an integrated product and service portfolio that makes it possible to build and run a better networked society. Our solutions bring television and broadband services to you, secure your safety in public places and guide your use of public transport. With solid industry experience and drive for innovations, we are a leading international company in broadband, security and information technologies and related services. We connect with our customers through a global network of offices and partners. Teleste is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki.

description: Informazioni sull’azienda:    Multiversity si distingue come un punto di riferimento nell’ambito dell’istruzione e dell’innovazione, introducendo nuove prospettive nel settore dell’edTech con approcci educativi innovativi e soluzioni tecnologiche all’avanguardia. La nostra missione è offrire un’esperienza educativa completa, unendo metodologie tradizionali e strumenti digitali moderni per soddisfare le esigenze di una comunità diversificata. In Multiversity ci impegniamo a fornire agli studenti le risorse necessarie per eccellere in un mondo digitalmente interconnesso. Responsabilità     Contribuire alla definizione e progettazione dei test (system, integration, functional, performance) a partire dalle user stories presenti nel backlog;  Analizzare i requisiti funzionali e tecnici, progettare ed eseguire test case manuali e automatici;  Eseguire i test in coerenza con acceptance criteria e test case definiti, simulando diversi scenari attraverso personas e configurazioni applicative dedicate;  Registrare i bug su Jira, allegando evidenze (screenshot, video) e collaborare con il team SW Development per il ciclo di correzione e retest;  Identificare, documentare e monitorare i difetti tramite Jira, supportando la predisposizione e la conduzione degli UAT con i Resp. uffici dell’ateneo e garantendo la copertura dei principali scenari end-to-end;  Gestire i bug emersi durante gli UAT o le nuove richieste evolutive (Change Request  );Contribuire alla validazione delle user stories, aggiornando lo stato a “To Be Deployed” in caso di esito positivo;  Eseguire, quando necessario, performance test, stress test e stability test per valutare la capacità e la resilienza della piattaforma;  Assicurare la tracciabilità completa e ordinata delle attività su Jira, nel rispetto delle procedure interne e delle cerimonie agili del team QA (Pianificazione, Wrap-Up, Retrospective);  Eseguire query SQL per la verifica e la validazione dei dati;  Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi di test e qualità. title: Senior Technical Architect
description: Vil du lede arkitekturen bak morgendagens digitale løsninger og skape verdi gjennom moderne teknologi, data og AI?  Vi er Forte, et europeisk konsulentselskap som hjelper virksomheter med å forbli relevante og realisere sitt fulle potensial – uansett hva fremtiden bringer. Navnet vårt betyr styrke, og det er akkurat det vi gir våre kunder: styrken til å tilpasse seg, handle og vokse.  Gjennom å kombinere teknologi, strategi og brukeropplevelse hjelper vi kundene våre med å lede – ikke bare følge etter.  Nå ser vi etter en erfaren teknisk arkitekt som vil være med å bygge moderne, sikre og fremtidsrettede løsninger for kundene våre – og bidra til å forme hvordan vi jobber med arkitektur, utvikling og AI i Forte.  Om rollen  Som teknisk arkitekt hos Forte får du en sentral rolle i komplekse teknologi- og transformasjonsprosjekter. Du vil jobbe tett med kunder, utviklere, produktmiljøer, forretning og andre arkitekter for å forstå behov, sette retning og bygge løsninger som skaper reell verdi.  Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å kombinere strategisk teknologiforståelse med praktisk gjennomføring. Du trives med å tegne målbilder, ta arkitekturvalg og forklare konsekvenser – men du er også komfortabel med å gå ned i koden, sparre med utviklere og bidra direkte i implementeringen.  Hos oss får du jobbe med moderne skyarkitektur, .NET, Azure, integrasjoner, data, sikkerhet og KI. Vi tror AI vil endre måten vi utvikler, designer og forvalter digitale løsninger på, og vi ser etter deg som både har praktisk erfaring med AI-verktøy og en tydelig nysgjerrighet på hvordan teknologien kan brukes ansvarlig og verdiskapende.  Ansvarsområder    Lede tekniske avklaringer og arkitekturarbeid i komplekse kundeprosjekter  Designe moderne, skalerbare og sikre løsninger basert på forretningsbehov  Være en hands-on arkitekt som også bidrar i kode, tekniske vurderinger og implementering  Jobbe med .NET, Azure og moderne utviklingsplattformer  Bidra til gode teknologivalg, arkitekturprinsipper og stegvis modernisering fra legacy til målbilde  Utforske og bruke AI-verktøy i utviklingsprosessen, for eksempel kodeassistenter, LLM-er og agentbaserte arbeidsflyter  Vurdere hvordan AI kan brukes i kundeløsninger på en ansvarlig, robust og verdiskapende måte  Dokumentere og formidle arkitektur på en måte som er nyttig for både utviklere, forretning og beslutningstakere  Bidra aktivt til Forte sitt fagmiljø gjennom sparring, mentoring og kunnskapsdeling    Hvem er du?  Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du er en erfaren teknolog som er nysgjerrig, proaktiv og ønsker å spille de rundt deg god. Du har vært med på store og komplekse leveranser før, og du vet at god arkitektur ikke bare handler om mønstre, diagrammer og teknologivalg – men om mennesker, forretning, tempo, kvalitet og evnen til å ta gode beslutninger under usikkerhet. title: Testausinsinööri, puolustuksen johtamisjärjestelmät

Olemme ylpeitä laadusta ja jokainen tiimissäsi on sitoutunut teknologisesti korkeatasoisen tuotteen tekemiseen. Meillä jokaisella on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa työhönsä ja työnjakoon. Työn luonteen vuoksi työskentelemme täysin lähityössä Sarankulman kampuksellamme, jossa tarjoamme mukavat puitteet työntekoon. Kokemus kriittisen infrastruktuurin järjestelmistä, ilmapuolustuksen järjestelmistä ja puolustustoimialasta katsotaan eduksi.  Koska laadunvarmistus kehittyy meillä järjestelmien mukana, toivomme, että haluat kehittyä ja haastaa itseäsi sekä testauksen saralla että teknisten työkalujen oppimisessa. title: Software Test Engineer w/m/d
description: Hier gestaltest du die Zukunft    Du testest Softwarefunktionen für die Steuerung unserer hochpräzisen Maschinen, dokumentierst die Ergebnisse und trägst so zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Technologien bei.  Du entwickelst Teststrategien, Testpläne und detaillierte Testfälle.  Du betreust und erweiterst unsere Testumgebungen entsprechend neuer Softwarefunktionen und Kundenanforderungen.  Du führst manuelle Tests direkt an den Maschinen durch und stellst dabei die Praxistauglichkeit aus Kundensicht sicher.  Du unterstützt unsere Softwareentwickler:innen bei Vorabtests neuer Softwarefunktionen.  Du entwickelst und pflegst automatisierte Regressionstests, um Fehlerbehebungen zu verifizieren und die Qualität zukünftiger Software-Releases sicherzustellen.  Du reproduzierst Kundenprobleme im Haus und analysierst diese gemeinsam mit den Softwareentwickler:innen.  Du unterstützt unser Service-Team und bist gelegentlich auf Reisen, um bei Problemlösungen, Inbetriebnahmen und (Beta-)Tests mitzuwirken.    Darum machst du den Unterschied    Du hast eine technische Ausbildung im Bereich Software, Informatik, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen.  Idealerweise verfügst du über erste Kenntnisse in Programmiersprachen und Skripting, beispielsweise Python.  Du kennst gängige Methoden, Tools und Best Practices im Softwaretesting.  Eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen sind von Vorteil.  Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und hast Freude daran, Fehler zu finden und nachhaltige Lösungen zu unterstützen.  Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.    So investieren wir in dein Talent  Wir bieten dir eine ansprechende und herausfordernde Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen, teamorientierten und überaus innovativen Unternehmen. Es erwartet dich ein hochqualifiziertes Team, ein Gleitzeitmodell das sich individuell anpassen lässt, Sozialleistungen sowie zahlreiche Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung.  Dein Gehalt richtet sich nach deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung und wird mit dir persönlich besprochen. Das Mindestgehalt entspricht dem Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte des Metallgewerbes.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About the Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.       That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:   you own the release gate.   If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.      That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks   like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.      You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.     Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.     What You'll Own    The release gate:   One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.    API test automation:   Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.    End-to-end front-end automation:   Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.    AI-driven test generation and maintenance:   Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point. title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.

title: Senior QA Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Job Description Summary   The QA Engineer role is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and safety of complex healthcare software systems throughout the full development lifecycle. The position plays a key role in defining and executing quality strategies, embedding testing early in the development process, and supporting informed, risk‑based release decisions in an agile environment.  The role involves designing and maintaining robust manual and automated test suites, driving continuous improvements in QA processes and tooling, and collaborating closely with software engineers, architects, product managers, and domain experts. Strong ownership of quality outcomes, defect analysis, and clear communication of risks and metrics to stakeholders are essential.  The position also emphasizes the effective and responsible use of generative AI tools to enhance testing activities such as test design, exploratory testing, analysis, and documentation. The role offers the opportunity to influence product quality at scale while mentoring others and contributing to a culture of high‑quality engineering within a regulated healthcare environment.  At GE HealthCare, our machines, our software, our solutions, our services, and our people make a genuine difference to medical professionals and patients all over the world. What You'll Do   This is a newly consolidated role — and a rare chance to build something from the ground up. Today, quality lives in pieces: incoming inspection here, in-process checks there, supplier quality somewhere else. We're bringing it all under one leader. As our Quality Manager, you'll be the single owner of quality across the entire flow, from the supplier's dock to the customer's door, turning quality decisions from one-off fire drills into a disciplined, criteria-driven system.  You'll be the voice of the customer inside our factory. Your standard isn't "does it match the drawing" — it's "would the customer be proud to own this."  Especially in year one, this is hands-on work. You'll be on the floor inspecting parts, writing the standards yourself, and working supplier floors directly — not just directing a team to do it. This is a player-coach role, not a seat where you lead exclusively through managers.      What You'll Own     Customer-facing quality:  complaints, field failures, and warranty claims route through you — 8D reports, corrective actions, and closing the loop from field data back to the factory floor.   Standards and decisions:  author the written acceptance criteria for every part family, chair the Material Review Board, and give inspectors and technicians a clear, consistent rulebook to work from.   The QMS:  drive QT9 as a living system — CAPA pipeline, non-conforming product trends, audit readiness — and build the dashboard leadership actually looks at: cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, rework by supplier.   Supplier quality:  one end-to-end process from supplier quality agreements through first article and incoming inspection, with structured improvement programs for your highest-impact suppliers. Most of our roughly 1,200 suppliers are small, local shops with little or no formal quality system — you'll spend real time on their floors helping them build the processes and controls they don't have yet, not just auditing against ones they already do.   Cross-functional leadership:  a weekly quality/supply cadence with Supply Chain, and a team of inspectors, technicians, and supplier quality engineers who look to you for standards and coaching. Q

title: QA Manager
description: Ben jij een ervaren QA professional die kwaliteit niet alleen wil bewaken, maar echt verder wil bouwen? Voor een groeiende organisatie binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie zoeken wij een QA Manager.     De organisatie zit midden in een professionaliseringsslag. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen een bestaand kwaliteitssysteem beheert, maar juist de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan de volgende fase. Je geeft leiding aan een klein kwaliteitsteam en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor Operations en andere afdelingen.      Wat ga je doen?   Als QA/QC Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteit en voedselveiligheid binnen de organisatie.  Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:   Borgen, onderhouden en verbeteren van het kwaliteitssysteem volgens HACCP en FSSC 22000;  Analyseren van klachten en afwijkingen en inzetten van structurele verbetermaatregelen;  Voorbereiden, begeleiden en opvolgen van interne en externe audits;  Versterken van de kwaliteitscultuur op de werkvloer;  Aansturen en ontwikkelen van een team   Samenwerken met productie, productontwikkeling, inkoop en logistiek;  Verbeteren van processen, procedures en werkwijzen;  Rapporteren over kwaliteit en verbeterinitiatieven aan interne en externe stakeholders;  Contact onderhouden met klanten, certificerende instanties en toezichthouders;  Adviseren van management en collega's over kwaliteits- en voedselveiligheidsvraagstukken.       Wat breng je mee?    HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Levensmiddelentechnologie of vergelijkbaar;  3 tot 5 jaar ervaring binnen QA/QC in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie;  Ervaring met FSSC 22000 en HACCP  Kennis van BLK en Trace1 is een pré       Wie ben jij?   Je bent iemand die makkelijk schakelt tussen de werkvloer en het management. Je brengt structuur, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet mensen mee te krijgen in veranderingen.  Daarnaast:   Sta je stevig in je schoenen;  Ben je mensgericht en benaderbaar;  Communiceer je duidelijk en proactief;  Werk je planmatig en resultaatgericht;  Weet je een visie op kwaliteit te vertalen naar concrete acties.       Wat krijg je ervoor terug?    Een zelfstandige QA-managementrol met veel verantwoordelijkheid;  Directe invloed op kwaliteit, voedselveiligheid en organisatieontwikkeling;  De ruimte om het kwaliteitssysteem verder vorm te geven;  Een betrokken team  Een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is;  Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden, afhankelijk van je ervaring;  32 tot 40 uur per week.       Interesse?   Lijkt dit op de volgende stap in jouw QA-carrière? Stuur mij dan je cv of neem vrijblijvend contact met mij op. Ook als je eerst wat meer wilt weten over de organisatie en de rol, vertel ik je er graag meer over.

title: Area Software Architect
description: Every day, millions of messages are created, personalized, scheduled, and delivered through Voyado Engage. Behind that seemingly simple experience lies one of the most complex distributed systems in our platform.     As retailers expect richer personalization, more channels, and increasingly real-time experiences, that complexity is only growing. Our Communication Area owns the end-to-end communication platform, from content creation and personalization to orchestration, delivery, and message tracking across multiple channels.  We’re now continuing to evolve the architecture behind that platform. This isn’t about maintaining what already exists. It’s about making sure a business-critical system can keep evolving as our ambitions, volumes, and customer expectations grow. You’ll work closely with engineering teams, tech leads, Area Leadership, and fellow architects, helping teams make architectural decisions that balance what we need to deliver today with where the platform needs to be years from now.  This role is about seeing the system beyond individual services and features. You’ll challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities before they become blockers, and help teams understand how local decisions affect scalability, reliability, and the evolution of the communication platform as a whole.  As part of the Area Leadership, you’ll work alongside our Engineering Manager, Product Lead, and UX Lead, shaping both what we build and how we build it. title: (桂川)ソフトウェア・サービス開発のQMO
description: 求人カテゴリー / Recruiting Category  ◆情報（オムロン デジタル(株)）  ◆募集背景  全社横断のQMO(Quality Management Office)の一員として、組織全体のソフトウェア製品やサービスの品質を横断的に管理・向上させる人材を募集しています。プロジェクト品質・プロセス・成果物の標準化と継続的改善を担うQMO機能の強化を目的とし、プロジェクトマネジメント力の強化に加え、品質の観点で事業・IT双方に価値を提供できる人材を求めています。  従来は各事業部・プロジェクト単位で品質を担保してきましたが、品質課題の高度化・複雑化に伴い、組織横断で品質を統括・高度化する専門組織としてQMOを新設しました。本ポジションは、単なる品質保証の枠を超え、「品質＝価値」という観点から、事業成長に直結する品質戦略を牽引いただく役割を担います。  ◆担っていただきたい具体的な仕事内容  ・ソフトウェア・サービス開発での品質保証・品質管理の構築・展開。  ・AI、クラウド等の先行技術を活用した開発における品質管理プロセスの構築と展開。  ・開発プロジェクトでのQAおよびPMO機能の実践または支援。  ・品質管理・保証プロセスの改善・組織内教育。  ・個別プロジェクトに入り込みながらも、全社最適の視点で品質課題を抽出し、改善提言・仕組み化までリードします。  ・品質マネジメントシステム（QMS）の設計・標準化・ドキュメント化および全社展開。  ・プロセス・成果物の可視化やデータ活用（例：統計解析・分析）による品質向上施策の推進。  ・現場への指導・伴走支援を通じた品質文化の醸成。  ・将来的にはオムロングループ全体への品質展開・教育にも関与いただきます。  ◆具体的な仕事内容に対しての期待する成果  ・QCD/CXを高める規定やプロセスの構築/整備  ・品質力向上のための育成プログラム策定  ・個別最適ではなく、全社横断で再現性ある品質プロセスの確立  ・「守りの品質（不具合抑止）」と「攻めの品質（価値創出）」の両立  ・現場メンバーの品質意識・スキル向上（育成・教育体系の構築）  ◆必須条件【経験】  ・組込み開発含むIT領域での品質管理経験5年以上。  ・品質マネジメントシステムの導入・運用経験がある方。  ・テスト経験に加えて、品質改善やプロセス改善に関わった経験。  ・品質に関する課題を定義し、改善に繋げた経験。  ◆必須条件【スキル】  ・組込みソフトウェア開発のプロセスおよび製品品質の特徴を理解している。  ・ITサービスの開発と運用における品質保証・品質管理を理解している。  ・アジャイル、AI、クラウド等を活用した開発プロセス、および、製品品質を理解している。  ◆歓迎条件  関連するISO標準規格に関する知識  QMO／PMO組織での実務経験  IT統制、内部統制、監査対応の経験  ◆歓迎する人物像  論理的思考力・課題整理力・ドキュメンテーション能力  関係者と合意形成を行うためのコミュニケーション能力  ◆この仕事の魅力  当たり前品質を高める守りの品質だけでなく、CX (Customer Experience)やUX (User Experience)観点で、顧客への提供価値を高めるための攻めの品質戦略を推進しています。  ・QMO機能の設計と実装、さらに、継続的な強化と改善に取り組むポジションです。  ・品質領域でありながら、経営・事業・顧客価値に直接影響を与える上流ポジションです。  ・ 「プロジェクトの納期やリソース」だけでなく「実現する品質や価値の本質」を軸に意思決定に関与できます。  ・将来的には、オムロングループ全体の品質向上を牽引する中核人材として活躍可能です。  ・品質を軸に、プロダクト・サービス・プロセスのすべてを俯瞰できるキャリアが構築できます。  ◆業界動向と自社事業の特徴  オムロンのデジタル戦略子会社として、オムロングループ全体のソフトウェア・ITサービス開発を担っており、機器組込みのソフトウェア開発から、クラウドのITサービスシステム開発まで、幅広い領域をカバーしています。  従来の「不具合を減らす品質」から、「CX/UXを高め顧客価値を創出する品質」へと、品質の役割は進化しています。当社では、組込み領域で培った高信頼性開発に加え、クラウド／AI／データドリブン領域におけるサービス品質の高度化にも注力しており、「OT×IT両面の品質」を追求できる稀有な環境です。  ◆部・チームの業務概要  全社横断のPMO/QMO組織として、システム開発のQCD向上、顧客への提供価値向上のための仕組みづくり（育成プログラム、プロセス制定等）を推進しています。  QMOは、個別プロジェクトを超えた「組織全体の品質」を対象とし、プロジェクト横断でのレビュー・改善提言・仕組み化を推進します。  PMOと連携しつつも独立した視点で、品質観点からプロジェクト・プロセス・成果物に対して提言を行うポジションです。  ◆配属先の課・チームの人数や雰囲気  課の人数：7名程度  雰囲気：2026年度から新設のグループ。プロジェクトマネジメント、品質マネジメントのスペシャリストが揃っています。  ◆職種カテゴリ  品質, IT  勤務地 / Work location  桂川事業所（京都府）

description: Sveriges a-kassor söker nu en Systemtestare   Arbetsmarknaden förändras i allt snabbare takt och arbetslöshetskassornas uppdrag har kanske aldrig varit viktigare.     Det finns 24 a-kassor i Sverige. Sveriges a-kassor är deras gemensamma service- och intresseorganisation. Det betyder att vi hjälper a-kassorna med bland annat IT-utveckling, utbildning och opinionsbildning. Syftet är att a-kassorna ska kunna administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen på ett så snabbt och effektivt sätt som möjligt. Sveriges a-kassor sitter i nya fräscha lokaler vid Skanstull samt är en modern arbetsgivare som månar om sina anställda. Vi tycker arbetslivet ska vara hållbart över tid och erbjuder flexibilitet och goda villkor för våra anställda.     På Sveriges a-kassor jobbar vi med att vidareutveckla och förvalta de IT-system som a-kassorna nyttjar i sitt dagliga arbete med att administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen för sina medlemmar.  Vi söker nu en erfaren systemtestare som ska förstärka vår testgrupp. Du kommer att arbeta i en stimulerande miljö hos en viktig samhällsaktör med mycket bra villkor och goda möjligheter att påverka dina arbetsuppgifter och utveckla dig själv. Tulet osaksi innovatiivista ja asiantuntevaa työyhteisöä, jossa panostetaan henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämiseen ja jotta pystyisit tekemään työtäsi parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla, tuemme sen tekemistä uusimmilla työvälineillä ja ohjelmistoilla. description: WHAT IS BOX? title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Test Engineer
description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale.

The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. You will design and maintain test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security. You will build and evolve automated test frameworks – including stress testing, fuzzing, code coverage analysis, and regression detection – that not only must remain effective across many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance, but must be able to scale with the high demand for Ubuntu kernels (currently more than 160 under active support).

The successful candidate will bring strong Python skills, familiarity with Linux kernel internals, and experience building test infrastructure that scales. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the APAC region, except for Taipei, Taiwan, and Beijing, China, which are office-based locations.

What your day will look like

  • Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security for Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Build and improve automated test infrastructure for continuous kernel quality validation across multiple kernel versions and architectures
  • Maintain long-lived test suites that evolve alongside Ubuntu’s many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for continuous kernel quality validation
  • Conduct performance benchmarking and regression detection across kernel releases
  • Measure and improve kernel code coverage, identifying gaps in test coverage and creating tests to address them
  • Execute and analyze stress tests covering CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O subsystems, networking, and filesystem workloads
  • Develop and maintain fuzzing harnesses to discover kernel vulnerabilities and reliability issues using tools such as syzkaller, Trinity, or custom fuzzers
  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Contribute to upstream test suites and testing frameworks
  • Document test methodologies, results, and coverage gaps

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in Python
  • Experience with test frameworks such as LTP, kselftest, xfstests, stress-ng, fio, or similar

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close that gap. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. You are one of the first FDEs at Tacto, so you are not slotting into a playbook, you are writing it while shipping in real accounts.

Your Tasks

Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents, and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data.

Own the technical side of a deployment. Extraction, mapping, validation, enrichment, until the customer's procurement team can actually work with the result.

Be in the room, on site. Run data workshops with key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

Turn what you learn at the edge into product. Document the pattern and push it to Product and Engineering instead of quietly rebuilding the same one-off for the next customer.

Automate your own job. If a step in a deployment can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

Make it one team. Hold the boundary with Solution Engineering and Customer Value so the customer experiences one Tacto, not three.

Grâce à notre passion commune pour la technologie , à notre culture entrepreneuriale et à l'importance que nous accordons à la formation continue, nous mettrons tout en oeuvre pour vous accompagner à libérer votre plein potentiel   VOS MISSIONS     Participer aux cérémonies agiles,  Participer à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de test,  Concevoir et maintenir les scripts pour l’automatisation des tests,  Déployer les scripts sur le pipeline de livraison (CI/CD),  Assurer le reporting,  Suggérer des améliorations et optimisations.     Environnement technique :  Selenium, Appium, RobotFramework, Ranorex, SoapUI mais aussi Jira/Xray, Katalon, Protractor.   VOTRE PROFIL   Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme en informatique ou justifiez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans l’automatisation de tests.   Ce qui peut vous démarquer ?  Vous possédez des certifications pertinentes (ISTQB par exemple), ainsi qu’une excellente capacité de communication.   3 RAISONS DE NOUS REJOINDRE     Avantages groupe : bénéficiez d’un ensemble d’avantages tels que le plan d’actionnariat salarié, les primes de cooptation, tickets restaurant, ainsi que des activités sociales et culturelles variées proposées par le CSE. Des dispositifs d’accompagnement à la parentalité, comme le temps partiel à 90% pendant les vacances scolaires, sont également disponibles, ainsi que de nombreux autres avantages issus de nos accords collectifs.  Expertise reconnue dans le testing : rejoignez notre filière Testing professionnalisées, reconnue pour son excellence en qualité logicielle avec une communauté de plus de 1 200 experts. Notre expertise est à l’origine de méthodologies de référence, validées par l’ISTQB.  Un acteur de proximité : nous travaillons pour des entreprises de premier plan et sommes un partenaire de choix auprès des acteurs locaux. En rejoignant nos équipes agiles, vous contribuerez à une approche locale unique au service de nos clients.     NOS ENGAGEMENTS ET PRIORITES   Le groupe Capgemini encourage une culture inclusive dans un cadre multiculturel et handi-accueillant. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez un collectif qui valorise la diversité, développe le potentiel de ses talents, s’engage dans des initiatives solidaires avec ses partenaires, et se mobilise pour réduire son impact environnemental sur tous ses sites et auprès de ses clients.  Sogeti fait partie du groupe Capgemini et accompagne les organisations dans leur mise en oeuvre de l'innovation , en tant que partenaire local à l'échelle mondiale . En combinant son agilité et sa rapidité Sogeti propose des solutions innovantes en testing, cloud et développement d'applications , toutes pilotées par l'IA , les données et l'automatisation . Plus d’informations sur www.sogeti.com/fr f r

title: Senior Software Developer
description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.  Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced software developer for the development of automated testing frameworks for NVIDIA's Base Command Manager (BCM). BCM is used to power thousands of Linux clusters around the world, varying from a few nodes to several thousands of nodes.   What You'll Be Doing     Testing Framework Development: Design, implement, and maintain automated testing frameworks, including writing robust and reusable code.  System Validation: Develop tools and workflows to validate software functionality, ensuring it meets customer expectations.  Hardware Integration: Validate the integration of our software with the latest hardware technologies such as GPUs and accelerators.  Defect Analysis: Investigate and analyze test results, identify root causes of defects, and collaborate with development teams on solutions.  There will be ample opportunity to develop your skills and take initiative.     What We Need To See     Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience  5+ years of proven experience in software development on Linux platforms.  Proficiency in Python with focus on developing clean and efficient code.  Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to collaborate across teams.  Eagerness to learn and use new technologies.  Familiarity with Linux shell scripting. Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.  Our cluster management software is based on Linux. You should be experienced with the Linux operating system and in particular with networking concepts in Linux.   You are familiar with the most common software included in a typical Linux server installation.     Way To Stand Out From The Crowd     Experience with highly scalable distributed systems and system administration.  Experience with Kubernetes and Docker.  Hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding tools to enhance developer productivity.    NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. Are you creative, autonomous, and looking for a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you. title: Automation & Quality Specialist
description: Job Description:     Are you a skilled and detail-oriented tester with a passion for delivering high-quality digital solutions?   At Satair, we are looking for a Backend API Automation Tester who will ensure our e-commerce platform and underlying services meet the highest standards of functionality, performance, and reliability. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on building robust automation frameworks and ensuring that the "engine" of our digital ecosystem is flawless.  The position will be located in Copenhagen, Denmark.   What The Job Is...   You'll play a crucial role in shaping the quality of our platform by leveraging your expertise in backend automation, security validation, and defect analysis. You will work closely with developers, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure our backend services are scalable and resilient, contributing directly to our mission of delivering seamless customer experience.   Key Responsibilities:     Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks specifically for backend services and APIs.  API Automation: Create and execute sophisticated API tests using Playwright .Security & Auth: Automate complex authentication flows, including OAuth, JWT, and API keys, to ensure secure service-to-service communication.  Validation: Validate RESTful (and SOAP) APIs for functionality, performance, and schema integrity (JSON/XML).  CI/CD Integration: Implement and manage automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable continuous quality.  Defect Management: Analyze test results, identify root causes of defects, and collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolutions.  Strategy & Documentation: Develop comprehensive test cases, test plans, and data strategies for backend systems, ensuring high test coverage and clear API documentation.  Full Lifecycle Testing: Conduct regression, smoke and integration testing to support frequent production releases.     How You Will Contribute To The Team     Technical Expertise: 5-7 years of experience in backend/API testing with deep hands-on experience in Playwright.  Scripting Skills: Proficiency in automation scripting using JavaScript or TypeScript.  Protocol Mastery: Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, headers, status codes and version control (Git).  Agile Knowledge: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira and modern test management tools like XRAY, HP ALM, Practi Test.  Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks and optimizing automation frameworks for speed and reliability.  Stakeholder Acumen: Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical backend requirements and business needs.  Collaboration: Ability to work within diverse teams and foster a positive, solutions-oriented environment.     Nice to Have     Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or K6.  ISTQB Foundation Certification.  Experience with E-commerce platform architectures.

title: QA Automation Engineer | Senior
description: Previously Operating as Elite Dev Squad  QA Automation Engineer | Senior  Full-time / On-site  Deadline: 2026-09-14  330   Description   Humain Dev Systems is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to build and own our automated test frameworks end-to-end, drive API and UI testing, and ensure the delivery of high-quality software across our products.   Responsibilities     Design and own the test automation framework across the stack: API/integration tests against the Laravel endpoints and Playwright E2E tests using Playwright’s API-request context to combine backend setup/assertions with UI flows in a single suite.  Automate the core end-to-end user flows  Build regression coverage for data pipeline ingestion, sync, and update jobs, including data integrity checks that catch silent drift.  Test external integrations with contract/mock strategies: Salesforce, Stripe, DocuSign, Postmark email, and Twilio SMS.  Integrate tests into CI/CD and gate releases; make test results fast, reliable, and actionable (no flaky suites).  Validate background jobs and queues idempotency, retries, batch processing, and failure handling.  Own the defect lifecycle: reproduce, isolate to layer (data vs. code vs. integration), write clear repro steps, and verify fixes.  Partner with backend/frontend engineers on testability, and define the QA standards, coverage targets, and release checklist for the Development team.  Report quality metrics(coverage, escaped defects, flakiness, release readiness) to Development leadership.     Required Qualifications     3+ years in QA automation, with senior-level ownership of a test framework end-to-end.  Strong API test automation experience against REST backends; comfortable reading a PHP/Laravel codebase to understand what you’re testing (service-layer architecture, jobs, resources).  Strong Playwright experience driving a React SPA end-to-end auth flows (OAuth/Passport-backed), role/permission-gated views, parallel execution, fixtures, network interception/mocking, trace/video artifacts on failure, and CI integration.  CI/CD integration experience (GitHub Actions or similar) with parallelization and flake control.  SQL and data validation skills to verify data correctness across large relational datasets.  Strong debugging instinct: trace a failure through the full stack before filing it, and distinguish a data problem from a code problem.  English proficiency at B2 level or higher    First Name * Please fill out this field.  Last Name * Please fill out this field.  Email * Please fill out this field. title: Embedded Software Test Engineer
description: Meet the Team  The Cisco Lysaker Platform team are looking for a creative and curious Embedded Software Test Engineer to join our QA team. You will be working closely with other test engineers as well as embedded software, hardware, camera and audio teams to develop the next Cisco collaboration video products.  Your Impact  We are a team of creative software engineers, trying to uncover where the weak points of our technology are, and how they can be addressed. You will be part of a team with a variety of tasks, ranging from early prototype testing to developing automated tests for various regression testing of released products. This includes participating in creating new solutions for test setups and contributing to the development of new video collaboration products.   In This Role, You Will     Be an important part of the product development process, testing functionality and giving feedback  Participate in test development  Be a key driver for the quality of our products  Be responsible for qualitative, ad hoc and exploratory testing, configuring test setups, digging through logs, analyzing data and troubleshooting technical problems  Work closely with colleagues from multiple disciplines to achieve our common goal of developing high quality products     Minimum Qualifications     A degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (CS, CE, EE or similar)  Experience with Python  Experience with automated testing for embedded software     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with embedded development  Attention to details and quality  Creative problem solving and troubleshooting skills  Like to share your knowledge and are willing to learn and adapt  Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English    Why Cisco?  At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.  Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.  We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: QA Engineering Lead
description: Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow.Our values – Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together– guide us in everything we do.    As part of the evolution of our Digital organisation, we are strengthening strategy implementation by clarifying structures and leadership to bring more focus, improve prioritisation, and support the business more closely. The new setup strengthens product management and software development practices and provides a clearer foundation for data‑ and AI‑driven development, while enabling clearer roles and new opportunities for professional growth.    Our Digital Engineering team builds and runs Finnair's digital customer experience — one of Finland's largest e-commerce platforms. We're investing in how we build it: strengthening our product and software development practices and building toward more modern, AI-assisted engineering. Finnair Plus is central to how we build lasting relationships with our customers, and getting its technology right matters.   We are looking for  A  QA Engineering Lead  to own the technical direction for quality engineering across Digital Engineering. The role sits within the Engineering Platform team at Finnair HQ near Helsinki Airport, and works closely with the Principal Engineer who leads it.  The Engineering Platform team enables scalable, efficient and high-quality software development across all of our engineering teams. As QA Engineering Lead, you own how Finnair builds quality in — driving the shift from traditional testing toward modern quality engineering, built on automation, continuous testing and AI-assisted QA.  This is a senior individual-contributor role focused on technical leadership. Over time, and depending on how the role and the person develop, it may also grow to include people-leadership responsibilities. The teams keep a high degree of autonomy over how they build and test, while you set the broader quality direction, own the shared practices and  tooling, and keep quality engineering strong and coherent across the organization. You'll work in close partnership with the Principal Engineer, Engineering Managers and product teams. Part of what makes the role interesting is shaping how Finnair approaches quality going forward, including where AI-assisted testing genuinely helps.   In this role, you'll     Set the quality engineering strategy, standards and frameworks used across Digital Engineering, and shape how teams approach testing, reliability and testability.  Own the shared quality tooling and practices, and keep a pragmatic, ong

title: Specialist, Test Engineering
description: Job Description   As part of the global Test Maintenance Engineering team, you will work with the latest RF and BB products and modern test technologies in an international environment.  You will ensure that production testing is stable, efficient, and capable of detecting manufacturing-related defects while supporting production quality, throughput and delivery performance.   How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn     As part of the global Test Maintenance Engineering team, you will work with the latest RF and BB products and modern test technologies in an international environment.   You will ensure that production testing is stable, efficient, and capable of detecting manufacturing-related defects while supporting production quality, throughput and delivery performance.   Act as Test Application Owner for assigned production test applications (SW/HW), ensuring production testing provides adequate coverage to detect manufacturing-related defects   Provide daily support to factories and repair sites in technical issues in testing.   Coordinate and implement test application changes with controlled rollout to factories and repair sites.   Support failure investigation and root cause analysis (RCA) of production testing issues in collaboration with factories, repair sites, quality and R&D.   Participate in product transfer projects by verifying testers, providing tester training and on-site support, if needed.      Key Skills And Experience   Must-have:    Experience with RF/Baseband production functional testing or extended (system-level) production testing, including HW/SW interaction.  Strong knowledge of RF and digital technologies and measurement techniques  Capability to drive improvements in test applications based on test logs, measurements and test SW source code  Strong collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional and multi-cultural environments.  Readiness for travelling, if needed     Nice-to-Have:    Ability to analyze, modify and maintain source code in C, C# and Python.  Ability to analyze BTS logs and snapshots  Structured, quality-oriented, and problem-solving working style.  Experience of Boundary Scan

title: Integration Test Engineer
description: [주요업무]      * 로봇 통합 테스트 시나리오 설계 및 성능 평가  - 사족보행 로봇의 테스트 케이스(TC) 및 시나리오 작성  - 다양한 지형 환경(험지, 계단, 경사로 등)에서의 로봇 기동성 및 환경 적응력 성능 평가     * 필드 테스트 이슈 분석 및 품질 관리  - 테스트 중 발생하는 하드웨어(HW)/소프트웨어(SW) 결함 분석 및 이슈 트래킹/관리  - 문제 원인(Root Cause) 도출 및 개발팀과의 협업을 통한 개선     * 테스트 자동화 및 시스템 검증 고도화  - 반복적인 시스템 테스트 및 회귀 테스트(Regression Test) 자동화 스크립트 설계 및 구축  - 로봇 제품 출시 전 요구 사양 충족 여부 검증 및 신뢰성 평가     * 외부 연동 API 검증 및 기술 문서화  - 외부(고객사) API 기능 검증 및 연동 테스트  - 로봇 운용 매뉴얼, 테스트 리포트, 기술 지원 가이드라인 작성     *고객사 기술 대응 및 현장 이슈 디버깅  - 실 배포 환경 출장 및 현장 배치 지원  - 현장에서 발생하는 실시간 이슈 디버깅 및 기술 대응      [자격요건]      - 로봇공학, 컴퓨터공학, 전자/기계공학 등 관련 분야 학사 학위 이상 또는 그에 준하는 실무 경력을 보유하신 분  - C++ 또는 Python 중 최소 하나 이상의 언어로 스크립트 및 코드 작성이 가능하신 분  - Linux 환경에 익숙하고 기본적인 CLI(터미널) 명령어 사용이 가능하신 분  - 논리적인 사고를 바탕으로 테스트 시나리오를 설계하고, 발견된 문제를 명확하게 문서화하여 소통할 수 있는 분  - 야외 필드 테스트 및 고객사 현장 출장(운전 면허 소지 등)에 결격 사유가 없는 분      [우대사항]      - ROS / ROS2 기반의 로봇 시스템 테스트 또는 개발 경험이 있으신 분  - 사족보행, 이족보행 등 **다족로봇(Legged Robot)** 또는 드론, AGV/AMR 등 모빌리티 로봇에 대한 이해도가 높으신 분  - Git, Jira, Confluence 등 협업 및 이슈 트래킹 툴 사용에 능숙하신 분  - CI/CD 파이프라인 구축 및 Jenkins, PyTest 등을 활용한 **SW 테스트 자동화** 경험이 있으신 분  - 임베디드 시스템(NVIDIA Jetson 등) 및 통신 프로토콜(Ethernet, EtherCAT, ROS Topic 등)에 대한 분석 역량을 가지신 분

title: SW Test Engineer (Senior) – TDK AIsight, Korea (Full-time)
description: About the Role   AIsight is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to lead test strategy, automation, and validation of our firmware and SDK components. You will work cross-functionally with embedded, firmware, and SDK teams to ensure system reliability, performance, and release readiness. This role requires strong technical ownership, experience with automated frameworks, and the ability to drive improvements across QA processes.      Responsibilities   • Develop, maintain, and improve automated test frameworks for firmware and SDK validation  • Design comprehensive test plans covering functional, regression, integration, performance, load, and stress testing  • Create automated test cases and supporting utilities or tools to increase test efficiency  • Collaborate closely with embedded, firmware, and SDK development teams to understand system architecture and identify test gaps  • Debug and analyze failures, perform root-cause investigations, and drive defect resolution  • Develop and maintain test environments, including CI/CD-based automated test pipelines  • Assess system readiness for release by evaluating quality metrics, test results, and risk levels  • Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, automation coverage, and test methodologies  • Mentor junior QA engineers and provide technical guidance on test design and automation best practices      Qualifications   • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance, preferably in embedded systems or firmware/SDK testing  • Strong scripting skills in Python or comparable languages for automation development  • Experience designing or maintaining automated test frameworks  • Solid understanding of embedded systems, firmware behavior, and SDK-level interactions  • Working knowledge of Linux-based development or test environments  • Experience with CI/CD tools and automation workflows  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to collaborate with global teams      Preferred Qualifications   • Experience validating APIs, SDKs, or cross-platform environments  • Hands-on experience with version control tools such as Git  • Experience using issue-tracking systems such as Jira  • Familiarity with hardware interaction, device communication, or embedded build systems  • Prior mentoring or leadership experience within QA teams      Interview Process   • Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a coding assessment as part of the interview process.      Why Join AIsight   In this role, you will shape test strategy, automation direction, and quality standards for firmware and SDK development across globally deployed AI-driven products. You will collaborate with international engineering teams, influence product reliability, and play a key part in scaling AIsight’s QA capabilities

title: System Qualification & Reliability Engineer (SyQT/NFR) l AIsight, Seoul, Korea
description: Job summary   Under the direction of the AIsight QMS Lead / Manager, the System Qualification & Reliability Engineer (SyQT/NFR) is responsible for ensuring the AIsight system meets all non-functional requirements (NFRs) before release. The role defines, designs, executes, and certifies performance, reliability, stress, and availability testing across the entire system, working closely with subsystem teams and the QMS Lead to ensure quality gates are evidence-based and operationally sound. As the single point of accountability for NFR validation and operational readiness certification, this engineer ensures the system performs under real-world conditions before any release proceeds. This position is located in Korea.         Essential Function    Define and document all non-functional requirements (NFRs) for the system — including performance targets, availability thresholds, scalability criteria, and reliability benchmarks — ensuring they are measurable, testable, and aligned with business objectives  Design and execute comprehensive performance and load test scenarios to validate system behavior under expected and peak load, identifying bottlenecks, latency issues, and throughput limitations before they reach production  Run soak tests, Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) analysis, and availability validation to confirm long-duration operational stability, and track reliability trends across releases  Execute stress, spike, and capacity testing to determine system breaking points and ensure graceful degradation under extreme conditions, documenting failure modes and recovery behavior  Demonstrate system features alongside reliability statistics in every sprint review, giving stakeholders real-time visibility into system quality and NFR compliance  Establish and track NFR baselines across releases, monitor performance trends, flag regressions early, and maintain a living dashboard of key operational metrics  Certify that the system meets real-world operational expectations and provide formal NFR sign-off as part of the Quality Gate Review (QGR) process, ensuring releases are evidence-based  Collaborate with subsystem owners, the System Test Architect, and automation engineers to integrate NFR test conditions into the system test strategy, traceability matrix, and CI/CD pipeline          Minimum Qualification    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)  5+ years of experience in system-level quality engineering, performance testing, or reliability engineering  Deep expertise in performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, k6, Locust, or equivalent)  Hands-on experience with soak testing, MTBF/MTTR analysis, and availability validation  Strong understanding of non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, reliability, availability, recoverability)  Experience with CI/CD pipelines and integrating performance tests into automated workflows  Familiarity with monitori

title: Software Engineer
