You will work closely with systems, hardware, QA, and field teams to solve complex technical issues in a global, customer driven environment.   Duties And Responsibilities   In this role you will:     Understand Customer requirements and find innovative ways to incorporate those requirements within our existing software architecture.   Learn from our most senior engineers and bring your experience and voice to help drive the next generation of Teradyne.   Collaborate with our senior team to design and develop programs and libraries for new products.   Assist with sustaining and extending programs and libraries for existing products. Test Automation Development  - Selenium, Appium, Playwright 등의 도구를 활용하여 UI, 모바일 및 API 테스트 자동화 프레임워크와 테스트 코드를 설계하고 구현합니다. 반복적인 수작업 테스트를 줄이고 테스트 커버리지와 테스트 코드의 재사용성 및 유지보수성을 높입니다.   CI/CD Pipeline Integration  - 자동화 테스트를 CI/CD 파이프라인에 통합하고 테스트 실행 조건 및 품질 게이트를 구성합니다. 테스트 결과를 신속하게 피드백하여 결함을 조기에 발견하고 안정적인 배포를 지원합니다.   API and End-to-End Testing  - 실제 사용자 및 결제 시나리오를 기반으로 API와 End-to-End(E2E) 테스트를 설계하고 수행합니다. 정상 결제뿐만 아니라 실패, 취소, 환불, 재처리 등 주요 예외 흐름과 시스템 간 연동의 안정성을 검증합니다.   Test Data Management  - 여러 도메인에 걸친 결제 플랫폼 테스트에 적합하도록 테스트 데이터의 정확성, 최신성 및 적합성을 유지하며 관리합니다.   Collaborate with Cross-functional Teams  - 엔지니어링 팀과 긴밀히 협력하여 테스트 요구사항을 정의하고 테스트의 우선순위를 설정하며, 각 스프린트에 품질이 내재화될 수 있도록 보장합니다.       자격   요건    5년 이상의 소프트웨어 엔지니어 또는 테스터 경력이 있는 분  소프트웨어 개발 라이프 사이클(Software Development Life Cycle) 전반에 걸쳐 품질관리 경험이 있는 분  소프트웨어 QA 엔지니어링 또는 SDET(Software Development Engineer in Test) 경력이 1년 이상인 분  자동화 테스트 툴(Selenium, Appium, Device Farm, TestNG or Pytest 또는 유사한 관련툴) 경험이 있는 분  프로그래밍 언어에 대한 기본 지식이 있으신 분 (Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java 등)       우대   사항    결제 도메인에서의 근무 경력이 있는 분  QA팀을 운영하고 리드한 경험을 보유한 분  영어로 기본적인 업무 소통 및 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분  유연하고 독립적으로 업무가 가능하고, 자기 동기 부여가 가능한 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 여러 경쟁 우선 순위를 처리 할 수 있는 능력이 있는 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항     전형절차 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.   참고사항 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.       개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/       서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청

title: Sr. Staff Supplier Quality Engineer
description: At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.  For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.  At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.  We are looking for a  Sr. Staff Supplier Quality Engineer,  to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to  Dir, Supplier Quality  and based in  Seoul, South Korea.     Location:  This role will be based in  Seoul, Korea. It is fully on-site, in office role.   As a Sr. Staff Supplier Quality Engineer, you will be a part of the team responsible for setting and delivering the quality and reliability standards for our fuel cell components across Bloom Energy; you will work closely with supply chain and engineering as part of a cross functional team. We are looking for a Quality expert with a proven demonstrated track record of improving the quality from Design maintaining it throughout its full life cycle. We are looking for someone who is hands-on, can manage both long term trends and projects, and have extensive involvement in the tools and techniques used to assess and deliver product quality and reliability. The ideal candidate will be entrepreneurial, driven, energetic, detailed, team oriented and patient with data who delivers proven timely results. Comfortable in a dynamic environment with constant change / iteration of products / services.   Role and Responsibilities:      Ownership of assessment of the capability of potential suppliers – identifies areas for improvement and deliver them on time in relation to Total Quality for selected suppliers.  Assess the manufacturability of new product designs and assist both engineering and suppliers with improving manufacturability. Clear focus on process capability to deliver the lowest total cost.  Manage product and process development including change management with suppliers to meet / exceed business requirements

title: Senior AI Engineer
description: About Commercial Bank Of Qatar   Commercial Bank, founded in 1975 and headquartered in Doha, plays a vital role in Qatar’s economic development by offering a range of personal, business, government, international and investment services.  We believe in empowering our employees, providing them with opportunities for growth and professional development.  By Joining us, you’ll be part of a workplace culture that fosters innovation, supports work-life balance, and encourages you to reach your full potential.  Join us in shaping the future of banking! description: Nous vous proposons de rejoindre notre entité  Digital Testing  composée de  spécialistes des métiers de la QA  (fonctionnelle, non fonctionnelle : sécurité & performance, automatisation de tests) et  consultants fonctionnels  (BA, analystes fonctionnels, PPO, PO).  Notre équipe œuvre au quotidien pour accompagner nos clients dans la validation & l’optimisation de vos applications digitales, web & mobiles.   Le leitmotiv de notre team ? Garantir à nos clients des applications conformes aux besoins des utilisateurs finaux, reflétant l'excellence et l'innovation que nos clients attendent.   Vous souhaitez intervenir sur des environnements digitaux à fort trafic, porter une vision qualité transverse et accompagner des équipes produit dans leur montée en maturité ? Cette opportunité est faite pour vous !   Vos missions :   Nous recherchons un·e  Lead QA   disponible rapidement ( ASAP/1 mois)  , pour accompagner l’un de nos clients dans le pilotage et l’évolution de sa  stratégie qualité  au sein d’un environnement digital structuré autour de plusieurs équipes produit, design et tech.  Vous interviendrez dans un contexte à fort enjeu où la qualité constitue un levier clé de performance, d’expérience utilisateur et d’excellence opérationnelle.  Vous intégrerez une organisation pluridisciplinaire et jouerez un rôle central dans l’animation de la qualité à l’échelle. Définir les indicateurs qualité et assurer leur suivi dans une logique d’amélioration continue.  Mettre en place les rituels de pilotage et mesurer l’adoption des pratiques qualité.  Identifier les risques qualité, évaluer leur criticité et construire les plans de mitigation associés.  Accompagner l’évolution du patrimoine de tests vers davantage d’anticipation, d’automatisation et d’industrialisation.  Participer à la construction d’une approche qualité adaptée aux nouveaux usages et aux opportunités offertes par l’IA.      Animer et accompagner les équipes :     Coordonner les activités QA avec les équipes internes et partenaires externes.  Organiser et piloter les campagnes de tests fonctionnels avec les équipes produit et développement.  Accompagner les équipes dans l’application des standards qualité et leur montée en maturité.  Auditer les pratiques existantes et contribuer à renforcer la culture qualité.  Favoriser l’alignement entre autonomie des équipes et cohérence transverse.      Porter l’automatisation et l’excellence opérationnelle :     Maintenir et faire évoluer les frameworks de tests automatisés End-to-End.  Renforcer l’intégration des tests dans les pipelines CI/CD.  Garantir la robustesse, la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des solutions d’automatisation.      Outillage, gouvernance et amélioration continue :     Garantir l’alignement avec les standards qualité : stratégie de tests

description: Nanexa is now recruiting a Quality Assurance (QA) Manager. The position is full-time and based at our headquarters in Uppsala, and we are looking for a new colleague to join our growing organisation.  As a QA Manager at Nanexa, you will play a key role in building and shaping the quality function in a growing pharmaceutical company. This is not a traditional QA role in a large organisation – instead, you will be part of a small, highly skilled team where your contributions will have a direct and visible impact on how we work and grow. You will have the opportunity to develop, implement and continuously improve our Quality Management System while being actively involved in the full product lifecycle – from early development to manufacturing of clinical trial material. The role combines strategic responsibility with hands-on work and close collaboration across functions.  At Nanexa, you will not work in a silo. You will be involved across the organisation, working closely with colleagues in development, production and analytics, gaining a broad understanding of our technology, products and processes. As a company of approximately 15 employees, we offer an environment where each individual plays an important role, and where you will actively contribute to building something new.   Responsibilities   The QA Manager will have a central role in the oversight of manufacturing and analytical activities from a quality perspective, covering the entire chain from development to clinical supply. Do you know how to build a quality culture that reaches across engineering, product, and leadership - and can you bring a clear, honest picture of quality risk into conversations that shape how we build and ship? title: Quality Leader – Sector Industrial
description: En Temporing seleccionamos un/a  Quality Leader  para una consolidada empresa del sector de automoción, proveedora de OEMs y clientes Tier 1, con proyecto industrial sólido y cartera de clientes internacionales.      Misión   Impulsar la mejora continua del Sistema de Gestión de Calidad y del desempeño de productos y procesos, garantizando el cumplimiento de los requisitos de cliente, normativos e internos. Serás la principal interfaz de calidad con clientes y proveedores, liderando la prevención, la resolución de problemas y una cultura de calidad sólida en toda la organización.      Responsabilidades principales     Calidad de cliente (SQA):  contacto principal de calidad para clientes (OEMs/Tier 1); gestión de auditorías de cliente, reclamaciones y scorecards; liderazgo de resolución estructurada de problemas (análisis de causa raíz y acciones correctivas); entrega en plazo y con calidad de la documentación PPAP.   Calidad de proveedor:  apoyo a homologación, desarrollo y seguimiento de proveedores; colaboración con Compras e Ingeniería en la gestión de riesgos; participación en auditorías y seguimiento de acciones correctivas.   Calidad de proceso y producto:  aplicación de APQP, FMEA (DFMEA/PFMEA) y Planes de Control; análisis de riesgos y poka-yoke; soporte a industrialización y cambios de ingeniería.   Sistema de Gestión de Calidad:  mantenimiento y mejora del SGC según IATF 16949 y requisitos específicos de cliente; preparación y liderazgo de auditorías internas, externas y de certificación. Colaboración transversal:  trabajo estrecho con Producción, Ingeniería, Compras y Logística; formación y sensibilización en estándares de calidad.       Requisitos    Ingeniería (Industrial, Mecánica, de Fabricación o similar).  Experiencia en roles de calidad en automoción (valorable), con background en SQA / Calidad de Cliente / Calidad de Proceso.  Experiencia trabajando con OEMs y clientes Tier 1.  Conocimiento de IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, FMEA y 8D.  Capacidad para leer e interpretar planos y especificaciones técnicas.   Inglés fluido (imprescindible).   Valorable: formación adicional en Calidad, Lean o Six Sigma.       Qué ofrecemos    Rol de liderazgo con alta visibilidad e impacto en el negocio.  Entorno de automoción dinámico y con clientes internacionales.  Desarrollo profesional en una organización orientada a la calidad.  Paquete retributivo competitivo acorde a la experiencia.

title: Head of Quality
description: Si ricerca un Head of Quality, a diretto riporto della Direzione Generale, che coordinerà il sistema di gestione della qualità aziendale e guiderà il team della Qualità di Gruppo.     La risorsa avrà come principale responsabilità la gestione e lo sviluppo delle attività Qualità delle società italiane del Gruppo, garantendo il presidio dei processi, delle procedure e degli standard qualitativi, e fornirà inoltre supporto alle società estere in termini di metodologie e procedure.     In parallelo, collaborerà con il team Qualità di Gruppo contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi e delle iniziative trasversali, favorendo l’allineamento delle best practice e delle strategie qualitative a livello internazionale.     Il candidato si occuperà di garantire politiche di qualità delle società italiane e di definire procedure che assicurino la conformità alle normative; collaborerà con le varie funzioni aziendali per assicurare che i prodotti soddisfino le aspettative dei clienti; condurrà audit interni ed esterni per la gestione delle non conformità, l’implementazione delle azioni correttive e l’omologazione di nuovi fornitori.     Inoltre, la risorsa monitorerà i KPI di qualità, redigerà report periodici per la direzione e proporrà strategie per il miglioramento delle performance di qualità.     Si richiede che il candidato abbia una laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Scienze della Qualità o discipline affini, esperienza di almeno 10 anni in un ruolo di gestione della qualità, preferibilmente in aziende del settore industriale o manifatturiero.     È indispensabile la conoscenza approfondita degli standard di qualità (ISO 9001), delle metodologie di auditing, delle tecniche di problem-solving e degli strumenti di miglioramento continuo (es. Lean, Six Sigma).     Sono richieste nozioni specifiche in tema di metallurgia degli acciai alto resistenziali, fusioni in acciaio e ghisa, saldatura a filo continuo (mig-mag), idraulica, oltre alla capacità di lettura del disegno tecnico e a conoscenze in materia di carpenteria.     Completano il profilo eccellenti capacità analitiche, forte orientamento ai dettagli, capacità di leadership e gestione del gruppo, oltre a ottime doti comunicative e relazionali.     È necessaria la conoscenza fluente della lingua inglese.      NOTE CONTRATTUALI:    Sede di lavoro : Albino, Via Roma 110   Orario : full time   Ccnl : Metalmeccanico industria      RETRIBUZIONE : Assegnazione di un trattamento retributivo minimo inziale non inferiore a 80.000 € lordi annui, incrementabile in relazione a competenze trasversali o ad altri fattori pertinenti alla mansione che saranno discussi in fase preassuntiva. Maggiori dettagli anche relativi ai trattamenti aggiuntivi eventualmente applicati saranno forniti in sede di colloquio.      Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, e a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03.

title: Funktionsleder til Kvalitet, Regionsapoteket Midtjylland
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for kvaliteten bag kritiske lægemidler til Region Midtjyllands borgere ?   På Regionsapoteket Midtjylland arbejder vi hver dag for, at patienterne får den rigtige medicin i den rigtige kvalitet og til tiden. Kvalitetsfunktionen spiller en central rolle i denne opgave. Nu søger vi en funktionsleder, der kan stå i spidsen for funktionen og være med til at sætte retning og styrke samarbejdet med produktionsfunktionerne og resten af Regionsapoteket.     Du får ansvar for en fagligt stærk funktion med en central rolle i forhold til kvalitetssikring, frigivelse, afvigelseshåndtering og faglig sparring. Samtidig træder du ind i en funktion, hvor der er behov for en leder, som kan skabe retning, stabile rammer og stærke samarbejdsrelationer.      Din rolle i en livsvigtig opgave   I Kvalitet arbejder vi for at sikre, at vi på Regionsapoteket producerer, leverer og rådgiver om lægemidler i overensstemmelse med gældende lovgivning. Funktionen understøtter hver eneste dag en livsvigtig opgave, hvor patientsikkerhed og faglig kvalitet er nødvendig for, at patienter og hospitalspersonale kan have tillid til lægemiddelbehandlingen.     Kvalitetsfunktionen består af 24 medarbejdere, som arbejder inden for både kvalitetskontrol (QC) og kvalitetssikring (QA). Medarbejdergruppen rummer både akademikere med naturvidenskabelig baggrund, farmakonomer, laboranter og en serviceassistent. Funktionen understøtter Regionsapoteket og arbejder i en reguleret kontekst, hvor kravene til kvalitet, dokumentation og patientsikkerhed er høje.      "Regionsapotekets strategiske ambition er at sikre sammenhæng og kvalitet i borgernes medicinske behandling. Det stiller krav til stærkt samarbejde, meningsfuld kvalitetssikring og løbende udvikling på tværs af apoteket. Derfor søger vi en funktionsleder, der kan oversætte og formidle retning for en fagligt stærk funktion og samtidig møde opgaven med en åben, pragmatisk, udviklende og samarbejdende tilgang til både medarbejdere, drift og resten af apoteket. Du kommer til at tegne og agere som rollemodel for vores kvalitetsfunktion."    Charlotte Quist Bjørn, Chef for Kvalitet og IT. title: Test Architect
description: Jouw rol  Bij PGGM hebben we de ambitie om onze testvolwassenheid verder te vergroten. Je helpt de organisatie bij het ontwerpen en realiseren van een toekomstbestendige testaanpak. Je werkt op het snijvlak van architectuur, techniek en businessprocessen en zorgt ervoor dat onze teststrategie niet alleen goed bedacht is, maar ook daadwerkelijk werkt in de praktijk.  Je bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor onze DevOps teams (waaronder .NET, Outsystems, Dynamics, Front-end en Datateams), architecten en pensioenexperts. Je helpt teams bij het maken van de juiste technische keuzes rondom testautomatisering, testdata, testomgevingen en tooling. Daarnaast stel je richtlijnen en standaarden op die zorgen voor een consistente en schaalbare testaanpak binnen de organisatie.  Met een holistische blik op de gehele keten kijk je niet alleen naar individuele applicaties, maar vooral naar de samenhang tussen systemen en processen. Je analyseert hoe onze pensioenprocessen getest worden, waar overlap of hiaten zitten en helpt teams om de testdekking te verbeteren. Zo zorg je ervoor dat kritische processen end-to-end goed afgedekt zijn, zonder dat verschillende teams onnodig hetzelfde testen.  Daarnaast ondersteun je teams bij de selectie en implementatie van testtools en help je bij het opzetten van praktische oplossingen die ontwikkelteams ontzorgen. Je begrijpt hoe belangrijk het voor engineers is om wijzigingen snel en betrouwbaar geautomatiseerd te kunnen testen en bugs zo vroeg mogelijk te detecteren. Je hebt hierbij hands-on ervaring en kunt zelf laten zien hoe je verschillende tests optimaal kunt automatiseren.  Je combineert visie met pragmatisme~ je ontwikkelt kaders en richtlijnen, maar helpt teams ook actief bij de implementatie ervan. Volgens het principe “show me, don’t tell me” laat je zien hoe oplossingen werken en help je teams deze succesvol toe te passen.   Dit doe je ook~      Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de testarchitectuur en teststandaarden binnen PGGM.   Je helpt bij de professionalisering van testprocessen, testbeleid en testautomatisering.   Je brengt de testdekking van kritische pensioenprocessen en ketens in kaart en identificeert verbeterkansen.   Je bepaalt en adviseert over teststrategie, testarchitectuur en tooling.   Je helpt teams bij het implementeren van praktische oplossingen voor testautomatisering en kwaliteitsborging.     Uiteraard valt er nog veel meer te vertellen, dit doen we graag tijdens een kennismaking! title: Key Account Manager
description: Millainen rooli on kyseessä   Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä yhteistyötä Suomen suurimpien rakentamisen ja talotekniikan toimijoiden kanssa?  Key Account Managerina liityt Hilti Suomen avainasiakastiimiin ja vastaat nimetyistä suurasiakkuuksista Oulun alueella. Olet keskeisessä roolissa varmistamassa, että Hilti-ratkaisut ovat mukana asiakkaitesi arjessa – suunnittelusta toteutukseen. Panostamme kehittymiseesi kattavan perehdytyksen ja henkilökohtaisen kehityssuunnitelman avulla. Urapolkusi ei jää puheeksi: jopa 80 % esihenkilöistämme rekrytoidaan talon sisältä. Päämäärämme on tehdä rakentamisesta parempaa, ja pyrimme jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja kasvuun sekä löytämään uusia tapoja saada aikaan pysyvää vaikutusta. title: Customer Service Manager
description: At Zaver, we develop innovative payment solutions to accelerate the revolution of mobile payments and enable a frictionless shopping experience. Working with us you will make a real impact, both within the company and the industry. With the right mindset and ambition, you will find a lot of room to grow and thrive. Right now, we are growing rapidly and looking for customer-obsessed all-star players to join our teams. We’re a bunch of techy, passionate, and hard-working friendly people.      What You'll Do    Manage incoming cases to our customer support via phone, chat, and email  Manage operations of customer support: staffing, scheduling, escalations, and case management  Define, track, and improve customer health metrics and support KPIs  Build scalable processes, routines, and tooling as we grow into new markets  Be the voice of the customer; bring real customer insights to the product development team  Proactively identify friction points by analyzing customer transactions and case patterns  Turn our customers into super-ambassadors       Qualifications    You must be fluent in Swedish and English (written and spoken)  Proven experience in customer service, ideally with 2+ years in a leadership or team lead role  Track record of building or improving support processes, workflows, and metrics  Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where you build as you go      You'll own the customer experience end-to-end, with one goal: to keep our customer base happy while expanding. Your leadership, people skills and operational rigor is what will make a difference. You lead from the front - no issue is too small or too big, and you set the standard for doing whatever it takes to find a solution.     Let’s challenge legacy solutions together and make some waves within payments ⚡      Zaver is a Swedish fintech-startup founded in 2016. The mission is to challenge legacy giants within the industry, and develop innovative payment experiences in order to accelerate the movement towards mobile payments, both online and offline. Since we launched our product commercially in 2019, we’ve gone from zero, to  becoming a bank processing billions of SEK in transaction volumes  - a result of hard work, customer-oriented mindset, and passionate people who want to make some real impact.

title: Manager Service Market Sweden
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. Do you enjoy building relationships while challenging status quo to reach business objectives? Do you spread energy and contribute to a positive team spirit? If so, we might just have the right opening for you.   What We Can Offer You   Volvo Buses is on an inspiring journey, working together in a truly global and fast-paced environment to make a difference, being pioneers of sustainable transport solutions of the future. Volvo Buses encourage all employees to work cross-functionally to develop our business and ourselves as team members. We work together with continuous improvements to simplify our ways of working. Your positive proactive approach and teamwork attitude will therefore be a key asset for us.   Area of Responsibility    Service Market Sweden is a function within the Swedish Market Company at Volvo Buses. Responsibility also includes Denmark and Iceland.   Responsibilities   We are responsible to provide the best Service market support to our customers and dealers. The team consists of 10 highly skilled colleagues who are there for our customers and dealers and are not afraid of helping each other. We cover the whole Service Market business such as:    Technical support  Parts sales and support  Service contracts sales  Claims handling  Dealer development    Volvo Buses is now seeking an experienced Service Market Manager Sweden who has the drive and passion to contribute to Volvo Busses profitability and who sees that the key to success is to develop the organization and its people to meet future business challenges.   You    To excel in this role, we believe that you are truly passionate and interested in people, that you inspire, motivate, and empower employees around you. You are result oriented and have a proven ability to transform business objectives and visions to daily work and actions. You understand the power of teamwork and you are excellent in partnerships and building strong and long-term relationships with our customers, dealers, partners, and other stakeholders.    You are convinced that diverse, empowered and teams high in trust act with speed and accountability.   You combine technical skills with commercial thinking.  You have strong communications skills in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.  Experience from working with dealers and customers before is valuable.     The position reports to the Managing Director of Volvo Buses Sweden and is a member of the Swedish market team.  Curious about anything? Don’t hesitate to contact me! Last application date is the 27th of August.  Martin

title: Afdelingsleder til Kundeservice, Porten og P-hus, Salling Aarhus
description: Brænder du for ledelse og kundeservice? Og er det naturligt for dig at gå forrest og have mange bolde i luften?    Så er det dig vi søger til en stilling som leder i Kundeservice i Salling!   Din primære opgave bliver at sikre, at vores Kundeservice i stormagasinet og på salling.dk leverer en god service overfor kunder, såvel som overfor interne kolleger, interessenter og øvrige samarbejdspartnere. Du skal samtidig sikre en hør trivsel og god motivation på tværs af alle teams.  Som Leder i kundeservice vil du få et spændende job med et mix af opgaver indenfor kundeservice, ledelse samt praktiske, administrative opgaver. Du vil få en hverdag hvor du prioritere og koordinere opgaver, og hvor du selv er på gulvet med dine medarbejdere.   Kundeservice i Salling løser et væld af forskellige opgaver, f.eks.:     Kundeservice for salling.dk (herunder reklamationsbehandling, kundehenvendelser, Trustpilot og kommunikation med vores lager)  Kundeservice for Club Salling  Kundeservice for Salling stormagasin (herunder pengehåndtering og differencer, kontrol af svindel, håndtering af abonnementskunder i p-huset, forsikringssager, mm.)  Portnerfunktion (Åbne og lukke stormagasinet, forvaltning samt personaleindgang)  Vagt og detektiv koordinering  P-hus bemanding og opgaver hermed  Rengøring af stormagasinet (kontakt til eksternt firma)    Som Leder i Kundeservice, vil du skulle sikre koordinering og udførsel af ovenstående opgaver. Du vil desuden have ansvaret for vagtplanlægning, ansættelser og medarbejdersamtaler for at sikre et team med høj trivsel.  Arbejdstiden er fordelt på hverdage i tidsrummet kl. 8.00-20.00 samt hver anden weekend.   Vi forventer, at du:     har en smittende, positiv energi  er ambitiøs og målrettet  er serviceminded og udadvendt  er arbejdsom og fleksibel  har et positivt mindset  tager ansvaret for at koordinere og prioritere afdelingens mange opgaver  har erfaring fra lignende servicefunktioner  behersker Office – pakken.    I Salling tilbyder vi velordnede forhold og gode karrieremuligheder. Som Leder i Salling får du mulighed for, at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt. Du får mulighed for at deltage på interne kurser hvor du kan forbedre dine evner indenfor f.eks. ledelse, kommunikation, salg og drift.   Tiltrædelse   Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.   Ansøgningsfrist   Vi holder løbende samtaler og tager opslaget ned, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat – så vent ikke med at søge stillingen.   Har du spørgsmål til stillingen?   Så ræk ud til Operations & Service Manager Louise Øllgaard på louise.oellgaard@salling.dk

title: Lead Customer Experience & Support (m/w/d) 100% Remote
description: Die Alparis GmbH mit Sitz in Bottighofen am Bodensee betreibt Revitera, eine junge Marke für Nahrungsergänzung im Direktvertrieb an Endkundinnen und Endkunden. Unser Shop läuft auf Shopify. Der Schwerpunkt unserer Kundschaft liegt heute im deutschsprachigen Raum, längst aber nicht mehr ausschliesslich: Wir skalieren gerade in weitere europäische Märkte und bereiten den Schritt nach Amerika vor.   Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und ohne Konzernstrukturen. Was hier entschieden wird, ist am selben Tag live. Gerade bauen wir unseren Kundenservice technisch neu auf: eine eigene Software, die einen wachsenden Teil der Kommunikation automatisiert und die wir zusammen mit unserer IT laufend weiterentwickeln.   Für diesen Bereich suchen wir die Person, die bei uns die Kundenzufriedenheit verantwortet. Diese Rolle ist die Schnittstelle zwischen allen Teams und unseren Kundinnen und Kunden. Wer sie ausfüllt, kennt unsere Kundschaft besser als alle anderen im Haus, kennt die Produkte, die Strategie und die Ziele dahinter, und trägt dieses Wissen in jedes andere Team zurück. Entsprechend gross ist der Einfluss auf das, was wir bauen.  Aufgaben  • Du übernimmst die vollständige Verantwortung für die Kundenzufriedenheit bei Revitera und für alles, was daran hängt.   • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kundinnen und Kunden und allen internen Teams. Was du aus dem Kontakt lernst, spielst du strukturiert an Produkt, Shop, IT und Marketing zurück.   • Du lernst unsere Kundschaft wirklich kennen, sammelst Feedback systematisch ein und machst daraus verwertbare Erkenntnisse statt Bauchgefühl.   • Du baust den Kundensupport von Grund auf: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, Tonalität, Eskalationswege und die Struktur dahinter.   • Du entwickelst effiziente Systeme, mit denen die Kommunikation mit unserer Kundschaft besser, schneller und persönlicher wird.   • Du treibst die Automatisierung dieses Bereichs voran: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer IT an unserer eigenen Support-Software, testest sie, bringst deine Praxiserfahrung in die Weiterentwicklung des Algorithmus ein und entscheidest mit, was automatisiert wird und was in menschliche Hand gehört.   • Du verantwortest das Bewertungsmanagement, also Shop-Bewertungen, Bewertungsportale und öffentliche Rückmeldungen.   • Du führst die Kundensupport-Mitarbeitenden: Einarbeitung, Qualitätssicherung, Weiterentwicklung.   • Mittelfristig übernimmst du zusätzlich das E-Mail-Marketing und die gesamte Kundenkommunikation ausserhalb der bezahlten Werbung. Die Stelle ist bewusst als wachsende Bereichsleitung angelegt.   Woran wir den Erfolg dieser Rolle messen:   • Customer Retention, also wie viele Kundinnen und Kunden bei uns bleiben. Das ist die wichtigste Zahl.   • Kundenzufriedenheit über alle Kontaktpunkte hinweg.   • Möglichst viele positive und möglichst wenige negative Bewertungen, sowie ein aktives Bewertungsmanagement.   • Der Automatisierungsgrad im Kundenservice, also wie viel wir ohne Qualitätsverlust

title: Customer Engagement Manager
description: We're Civica and we make software that helps deliver critical services for citizens all around the world. From local to state government, to education, to health and care, over 5,000 public bodies across the globe use our software to help provide critical services to over 100 million citizens.  Our aspiration is to be a GovTech champion everywhere we work around the globe, supporting the needs of citizens and those that serve them every day. Building on 21 years of continuous growth and success, we're at a pivotal point on our journey to realise that aspiration.  As a company, we're passionate about what we do and the citizens we help to serve. If you too would like to help champion the use of technology in public services, to improve outcomes for citizens and public sector organisations, then Civica is the right place for you. We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve growth in your career whilst making a real difference to people and communities.    Why you'll love this opportunity as a Customer Engagement Manager at Civica   This role sits at the centre of Civica's customer strategy and directly influences how public sector organisations leverage technology to serve their communities. It provides the opportunity to partner with senior stakeholders across government, education, and health sectors, shaping long-term outcomes and delivering measurable impact.  The position offers broad exposure across Civica's solutions and business units, enabling deep understanding of how integrated technology ecosystems support critical services. It combines strategic relationship management with commercial accountability, creating a balance of customer advocacy and business growth.  Operating within a collaborative and purpose-driven environment, the role is supported by cross-functional teams spanning product, delivery, and customer support. It enables the development of high-impact engagement strategies, drives innovation in customer experience, and contributes to Civica's position as a trusted GovTech partner in the region.
